At HNTB, you can create a career that is meaningful to you while building communities that matter to all of us. For more than a century, we have been delivering solutions for some of the largest, most complex infrastructure projects across the country. With our historic growth, it is an exciting time to join our team of employee-owners.
  
  
This opportunity entails supporting technical staff by performing a variety of project-related coordination, tracking, and administrative duties such as tracking client deliverables and evaluation scores, maintaining schedules, organizing documents and documents requests, and technical editing and preparation of reports and minutes.

jobs.title: Retail Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Retail Project Coordinator

**GoldUnion US – Beverly Hills**

GoldUnion, a global leader in buying and selling precious metals, is rapidly expanding across California, with a goal of opening **25 locations by 2027**. We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Retail Project Coordinator to support and oversee our retail expansion efforts across the state.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working on-site, solving practical problems, and being directly involved in getting retail spaces ready for business.

**Position Overview**

As part of GoldUnion’s retail expansion team, the Retail Project Coordinator plays a key role in managing and supporting the build-out and launch of new branch locations. This position is focused on project coordination, vendor management, timeline tracking, and ensuring operational readiness from planning through grand opening.

This is a field-based role with a home base in **Beverly Hills, CA**, requiring **frequent travel** between branch locations throughout California. A company vehicle will be provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple retail expansion projects from pre-construction through store opening
* Work closely with contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure projects stay on schedule and meet company standards
* Track project timelines, deliverables, and milestones, ensuring timely completion of all phases
* Conduct site visits and walkthroughs to monitor progress, identify issues, and ensure quality control
* Serve as a point of contact between operations, construction teams, and external partners
* Assist in resolving on-site challenges and ensuring projects move forward efficiently
* Support final setup and readiness of new locations prior to opening
* Ensure each branch meets operational, safety, and brand standards before launch
* Travel between locations as needed to support multiple active projects

**Candidate Profile**

* Previous experience in project coordination, facilities coordination, construction, or retail build-outs preferred
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
* Experience working with contractors, vendors, or cross-functional teams
* Able to follow instructions, coordinate with others, and communicate clearly with internal teams
* Flexible schedule and willing to travel extensively across California
* Experience in retail expansion or construction project environments is a plus
* Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and willingness to learn are essential

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Salary:** $55,000 per year
* Company car provided
* Gas and hotels fully covered during travel

**Working Hours**

* Full-time, Monday through Friday 10am-6pm
* Occasional weekends based on business needs and branch opening schedules

**Location**

* Office currently based in **Beverly Hills, CA**
* Frequent travel to branch sites throughout California required

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial phone or video interview
* In-person interview with the operations leadership team

**Required Notices (California & Federal):**

GoldUnion is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available as required by law.

GoldUnion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act. Background screenings and applicant information are handled in accordance with applicable laws.

The listed pay range reflects GoldUnion’s good-faith estimate for this position. Actual pay may vary based on lawful job-related factors. Commission and incentive earnings are performance-based and not guaranteed.

Offers of employment are contingent upon applicable lawful onboarding requirements and screenings.

Pay: $20.00 - $26.44 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

* Do you have experience in project management in retail or construction?

Experience:

* Project management: 1 year (Required)

* 75% (Required)

jobs.company: Lundquist Institute For Biomedical Innovation At Harbor-ucla
jobs.title: Program Coordinator (Temporary)
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  
The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center is an independent, non-profit biomedical research organization located in Torrance, California. In dozens of laboratories throughout the campus, researchers are working to unravel the mysteries of heart and kidney disease, cardiac complications in newborns, chronic lung disease, skin cancer, sickle cell disease, disorders of the autoimmune system, and much more. Many of these projects are collaborative in nature, involving experts from different areas of specialization. Our discoveries have prevented blindness in newborns, enabled premature infants with fragile lungs to breathe and allowed children with rare, often fatal diseases to grow up healthy and strong.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in administration and/or office management in an academic healthcare setting. Desired experience with ACGME and other accrediting and regulatory bodies that affect resident and fellow education.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with absolute confidentiality.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Excellent organization skills with an ability to multitask and prioritize competing priorities.
* Must be comfortable working independently and in a collaborative team environment consisting of diverse
* populations of staff, faculty, resident/fellows and other administrative personnel.
* Must be able to adapt quickly to changes in work requirements and assignments in a proactive manner
* Strong critical and analytical thinking skills.

**Responsibilities:**

With oversight from the Program Director and Department Administrator, Medical Education, the Program Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day administration of the ACGME residency/fellowship program(s). The Program Coordinator (PC) assists the Graduate Medical Education (GME) office and Program Director (PD) in developing and maintaining the educational quality of the training program and ensuring compliance with ACGME accreditation standards and Institutional requirements. The PC functions as a liaison between the GME office, PD, residents/fellows, medical students, participating sites, and other departments. The PC will continually assess a wide range of programmatic issues including maintaining databases, communicating with faculty and trainees regarding a range of issues, and collaborating with the GME office to plan annual events including recruitment, orientation, graduation, faculty development events, and various program-related events.

Program Accreditation and Compliance

* Develop understanding of ACGME policies and procedures, including familiarity with the Common
* Program Requirements, Specialty-Specific requirements, and Institutional Requirements.
* Maintain all essential documents required for program accreditation and ensuring program faculty possess the appropriate credential indicated by the program’s Review Committee. This includes confirming that
* CVs containing a current list of publications and scholarly activity are logged in ACGME WebADS system as required by ACGME.
* Assist the PD in maintaining the program’s ACGME WebADS system; keep a working copy and make changes on an ongoing basis.
* Manage and coordinate ACGME site visits, including preparation of the site visit documentation. Along with the PD, help prepare program, faculty, and residents/fellows for site visit; arrangement meeting rooms;ensure required documents are available to the site visitor as requested; and serve as key participate in the site visit.
* Prepare Program Letters of Agreement (in coordination with GME office leadership) with participating institutions and training sites. Ensure agreements are revised as needed.
* Under the direction of the PD, preparing the documentation for the Annual Program Evaluation for submission to the Institutional Sponsor as part of the annual Institutional required, as required by ACGME.
* Administer New Innovations Residency Management System for the program(s), including maintaining resident/fellow demographic data; resident/fellow schedules, importing program and rotation goals and objectives; conferences attendance tracking; and ensuring timely completion of duty hour reports.
* Ensure residents/fellows submit case/procedure log data in appropriate systems as required by ACGME Review Committee.
* Distribution of required documents to faculty and resident, including rotation goals and objectives, program manuals, program policies, etc.
* Establish and ensure compliance with program-specific credentialing requirements (e.g., ACLS, PALS, ATLS, etc.)
* Ensure resident/fellow compliance with Institutional credentialing and HR requirements, including medical licensees, DEA licenses, employee health, mandatory education training, and other training as required.
* Complete surveys and ensure information is current in various GME systems.
* Coordinate and staff various committees, including residency management meetings, faculty curriculum. committee meetings, departmental meetings, meetings with PD, and with the resident/fellows, and follow up on action items as required.
* Manage administrative and planning for logistics for meetings and conferences, including monthly lecture series, conferences, grand rounds, journal club, M&M, ACLS courses, and in-service exams
* Compile and submit required data elements to the Specialty Boards and other professional organizations as required.
* Administration of Resident/Fellow Activities In consultation with the PD, develop and maintain resident/fellows schedules, including rotation schedules, call schedules, and clinic schedules; maintain current schedules into New Innovations and update as needed.
* Coordinate information and schedules with other services, sites, and departments, including rotation/call schedules, and evaluations.
* In collaboration with GME office

jobs.title: Beauty Store Sales and Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic, versatile, and customer-focused professional to join our team in a hybrid role that combines in-store sales and customer service with essential office and administrative responsibilities.

The ideal candidate will be a motivated and results-oriented sales professional with strong organizational and administrative skills. This individual should be comfortable working directly with customers on the sales floor while efficiently managing office responsibilities and supporting day-to-day store operations.

The successful candidate will be able to seamlessly transition between customer service, sales, and administrative tasks, while maintaining a professional demeanor, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to providing excellent service.

In-Store Sales Responsibilities

* Customer Service: Proactively greet, engage with, and assist customers to deliver exceptional shopping experience and build lasting customer relationships.
* Product Knowledge: Develop a thorough understanding of our product lines to provide personalized recommendations and help customers select products that meet their needs.
* POS and Transactions: Operate the Point of Sale (POS) system accurately and efficiently to process customer purchases, payments, and returns.
* Sales Performance: Work toward achieving and exceeding individual and store sales goals through proactive selling, product recommendations, and excellent customer service.
* Store Presentation: Maintain an organized, clean, and visually appealing sales floor by restocking shelves, arranging merchandise, and keeping product displays presentable.

Office & Administrative Responsibilities

* Scheduling and Communication: Manage scheduling, handle phone calls and email correspondence, and maintain organized digital and physical records.
* Bookkeeping Support: Assist with basic bookkeeping tasks, including processing invoices, and tracking daily sales.
* Inventory Management: Order, monitor, and maintain inventory of store merchandise and office supplies to ensure adequate stock levels.
* Administrative Support: Assist store management with preparing reports, maintaining records, and completing other administrative duties as needed.

Qualifications

* Retail Sales Experience: 3–4 years of proven retail sales experience, preferably in the beauty industry.
* Bilingual: Fluent in both English and Spanish.
* Customer Service: Friendly, approachable, and professional demeanor with a strong customer-first attitude.
* Professional Appearance: Well-groomed and maintains a professional appearance.
* Administrative Experience: Previous experience in an administrative or office support role.
* Technical Skills: Proficient in POS systems and Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, and Excel
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and team members.
* Organization and Time Management: Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and balance retail sales and administrative responsibilities.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $18.00 - $20.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

  

The Cell Therapy Account Manager is responsible for driving adoption and volume growth of the CareDx Cell Therapy & Transplant portfolio, including AlloHeme and associated molecular testing and digital solutions. Focusing primarily on blood and marrow transplant centers, cell therapy programs, hematology-oncology practices, and academic medical centers, the Cell Therapy Account Manager will educate providers on the clinical value of AlloHeme, support implementation of new testing programs, and drive ongoing utilization through strategic account management.

The Cell Therapy Account Manager will coordinate and collaborate with Clinical Liaisons, Medical Affairs, Customer Experience, Marketing, and Sales Operations to develop and execute account-specific growth strategies. * Demonstrated experience navigating multi-stakeholder decision-making environments involving physicians, laboratory leadership, administrators, procurement teams, and operational stakeholders

jobs.title: Inbound Licensing Coordinator
jobs.description:
CA EMPLOYEE PRIVACY RIGHTS: https://www.mgae.com/ca-employee-privacy-rights

**MGA Entertainment** is on a mission to inspire imagination and creativity through innovative toys, entertainment, and experiences that transform play into limitless possibilities. As the largest privately held toy and entertainment company in the U.S., MGA is a global leader in designing and delivering world-class consumer products that spark wonder and drive play forward. Headquartered in Los Angeles with offices worldwide, MGA’s portfolio spans a dynamic range of original and licensed brands — from toys, dolls, games, and electronics to fashion, home décor, and entertainment content including hit movies and TV series. The company is recognized for its bold approach to storytelling, trendsetting design, and deep commitment to quality. The award-winning MGA family includes fan-favorite brands such as L.O.L. Surprise!™, Little Tikes®, Rainbow High™, Bratz®, MGA’s Miniverse™, Yummiland™, CarTuned™, Wonder Factory™, BABY born®, and Zapf Creation®. To learn more, visit www.mgae.com and follow MGA on LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram and Facebook.

**Position Overview**

MGA Entertainment is seeking an organized, proactive Inbound Licensing Coordinator to manage the submission and approval process for licensed items across the business. Sitting within the Inbound Licensing team, this role will serve as a central point of coordination between Sales, Brand Marketing, Creative, external licensing partners and other key stakeholders. Working collaboratively with the Senior Director of Creative, Inbound Licensing, the Inbound Licensing Coordinator will ensure submissions are complete, feedback is communicated clearly and approvals progress efficiently to support product launches, marketing campaigns and commercial deadlines.

This role requires an understanding of both licensing and marketing, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholder relationships.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the submission, tracking and approval of licensed products, packaging, marketing materials, sales assets, digital content and other items requiring licensor approval.
* Liaise with Sales, Brand Marketing, Creative and other internal stakeholders together assets, confirm requirements and establish submission timelines.
* Prepare and submit approval requests through licensor portals and other agreed channels, ensuring each submission is accurate, complete and aligned with relevant guidelines.
* Work closely with the Senior Director of Creative, Inbound Licensing, to coordinate creative reviews, clarify feedback and support revisions.
* Act as the day-to-day contact for approval-related communication between internal teams and licensing partners.
* Traffic licensor feedback to the appropriate stakeholders, clarify required changes and follow up on revisions and resubmissions through to final approval.
* Maintain a central approvals tracker, providing clear visibility of submission status, outstanding actions, deadlines and potential delays.
* Proactively identify and escalate approval issues or conflicting feedback that could affect launch dates, production schedules or campaign delivery.
* Maintain accurate records of submissions, feedback, approved assets and final sign-offs, with clear version control.
* Communicate approval status and usage conditions so teams have the necessary sign-offs before production, publication or distribution.
* Help improve submission processes, briefing templates and communication practices to reduce rework and support timely approvals.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* A sound understanding of licensing and marketing, including licensor approval processes, brand guidelines and the development of marketing assets.
* Previous experience in marketing coordination, licensing, creative operations, project coordination or a similar role.
* Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple submissions, competing priorities and deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with internal stakeholders and external partners.
* High attention to detail when reviewing assets, consolidating feedback and maintaining approval records.
* A proactive, collaborative approach, with the confidence to follow up on outstanding actions and escalate issues appropriately.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project tracking tools; experience with licensor approval platforms is advantageous.
* Experience in toys, entertainment, consumer products or licensed brands is preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**

Complete and accurate submissions, clear stakeholder communication, current approval records and timely sign-offs that support MGA’s product launches and marketing activity.

jobs.title: Office Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**L.A. Hydro Jet & Rooter Services** is seeking a **Sales Coordinator** to join our team! With a family-friendly approach, we prioritize work-life balance—discover why leading businesses trust us and why you'll love working here!

**What Sets L.A. Hydro-Jet Apart:**

* **Competitive Pay:** $24.50 - $28.50 per hour, plus bonus program

* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Medical, vision, and dental
* **Retirement Plan:** 401K plan + match.

This position plays a critical role in driving revenue, supporting our field teams, and delivering an exceptional customer experience from the initial estimate through project completion.

**Position Summary**

The Sales Coordinator is responsible for scheduling approved estimates and bids for both the Jetting and Repair Departments. This role works closely with customers, technicians, dispatch, and management to ensure projects are scheduled efficiently and communicated effectively.

**WHAT L.A. HYDRO-JET NEEDS FROM YOU:**

* Review approved estimates and communicate project details with customers.
* Convert estimates into sold work and accurately document project requirements.
* Verify estimate pricing and scope accuracy prior to scheduling.
* Coordinate project scheduling with customers and property representatives.
* Maintain consistent follow-up communication through phone and email.
* Schedule pre-work inspections and coordinate project planning activities.
* Obtain permits and arrange DigAlert notifications when required.
* Ensure all customer notices and project-related communications are completed.
* Work closely with Dispatch to coordinate field staffing and project timelines.
* Respond to a high volume of inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Evaluate customer requests and prioritize emergency service needs.
* Assist in identifying plumbing service needs and routing work appropriately.

**What Sets You Apart:**

* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Excellent organizational and follow-up abilities.
* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Problem-solving skills and sound judgment.
* Ability to work collaboratively with field and office personnel.

L.A. Hydro-Jet and Rooter Service determines compensation based on labor market data across several U.S. geographic regions. The average earnings for this position range from **$24.50 - $28.50 per hour, plus bonus program**. Pay is influenced by factors including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.title: Quality Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
WelbeHealth is a value-based healthcare organization that's transforming the future of senior care by providing an all-inclusive care option to our most vulnerable senior population. We step in as the care provider and care planner that work to keep our participants within their communities, out of institutions, and cared for like family, all while receiving the healthcare and social services needed to thrive.

Under the supervision of the Quality Operations Supervisor, the Quality Operations Coordinator (QOC) will be responsible for delivering excellent support and service to our PACE market operations through a process of record review to ensure a complete and accurate participant medical record. Responsibilities will include collecting data, auditing participant electronic health records by utilizing comprehensive tools specific to the area of quality improvement, complete reporting and confirming all regulatory required elements. This role collaborates effectively with colleagues and stakeholders to promote the WelbeHealth values, team culture and mission.

**This role is different because the Quality Operations Coordinator at WelbeHealth:**

* Plays a direct role in the quality and accuracy of participant care, ensuring medical records are complete, accurate, timely, and compliant with regulatory requirements. Your work helps identify gaps in documentation and supports our care teams in maintaining the highest standards of quality for our participants.
* Combines quality auditing with meaningful process improvement, giving you the opportunity to identify trends and deficiencies, investigate root causes, and collaborate with clinical and operational teams to strengthen processes, improve documentation, and support regulatory readiness across the PACE organization.

**We care about our team members. That's why we offer:**

* Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days
* 401K savings + match
* Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus
* And additional benefits!

**On the day-to-day, you will:**

* Identify potential deficiencies, facilitate, and monitor appropriate corrections to ensure data integrity in the EHR. Monitor participant medical records for complete and timely documentation and promptly report to Quality Operations Supervisor when policies and procedures are not being followed
* Participate in team documentation, process improvements and other QO team initiatives
* Conduct medical records audits to ensure all required documentation is timely and accurate
* Assist with WelbeHealth audits by preparing documents for desk review submission (universe lists) as well as assist with EMR navigation and impact analysis
* Review and reconcile assigned regulatory logs
* Complete all required tasks in a timely and accurate manner
* Complete required investigations and notifications

**Job requirements include:**

* Associate's degree preferred; may substitute three years' experience in lieu of education
* Minimum two (2) years' work experience in a healthcare setting or related areas
* Familiarity with healthcare quality standards, auditing, regulatory requirements, documentation, and maintaining operational controls in a regulated environment
* Experience working with grievances, complaints, appeals, or member/provider issues within a healthcare, health plan, managed care, PACE, or other regulated healthcare environment is highly desired
* Bilingual is a plus
* Ability to multi-task in a challenging environment is necessary; Excellent communication, listening, and organization skills
* Extensive MS office suite experience (Intermediate to advanced level proficiency is desired)

If you're detail-oriented and passionate about healthcare quality, auditing, and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you!

**COVID-19 Vaccination Policy**

At WelbeHealth, our mission is to unlock the full potential of our vulnerable seniors. In this spirit, please note that we have a vaccination policy for all our employees and proof of vaccination, or a vaccine declination form will be required prior to employment. WelbeHealth maintains required infection control and PPE standards and has requirements relevant to all team members regarding vaccinations.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**

At WelbeHealth, we embrace and cherish the diversity of our team members, and we're committed to building a culture of inclusion and belonging. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. People seeking employment at WelbeHealth are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), pregnancy or other status protected by applicable law.

  

**Beware of Scams**

Please ensure your application is being submitted through a WelbeHealth sponsored site only. Our emails will come from @welbehealth.com email addresses. You will never be asked to purchase your own employment equipment. You can report suspected scam activity to fraud.report@welbehealth.com

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Hematology/Oncology (Santa Monica)
jobs.description:
**Description**

The Clinical Research Coordinator supports the operational management of clinical research activities throughout the study lifecycle, including design, start-up, conduct, and closeout. This role is responsible for implementing and managing research activities for one or more studies, prioritizing tasks to meet required deadlines. The Coordinator plans and organizes study activities to ensure compliance with study protocols and applicable regulations, including institutional policies, FDA Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), and ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP). The role involves close collaboration with the Principal Investigator, ancillary departments, central research teams, sponsors, and external institutions to support compliant study conduct, financial management, and adequate staffing.

Hourly salary range: $38.19 - $61.45

  
Pay range: $38.19 - $61.45 an hour  
  
**Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimally 2+ years of previous study coordination or clinical research coordination experience
* Interpersonal skills to effectively communicate information in a timely, professional manner and establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with students, staff, faculty, external collaborators and administration and to work as a member of a team.
* Ability to effectively communicate to and interact with patients in a compassionate and kind manner.
* Ability to set priorities and complete ongoing tasks with competing deadlines, with frequent interruptions, to meet the programmatic and department needs, while complying with applicable University policies and federal and state regulations.
* Analytical skills to assess clinical research protocols and regulatory requirements, define problems, formulate logical solutions, develop alternative solutions, make recommendations, and initiate corrective actions.
* Close attention to detail to ensure accuracy in a fast-paced, fluctuating workload environment.
* Organization skills to create and maintain administrative and regulatory files effectively as well as independently balance the various tasks to ensure deadlines are met.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Adobe and Microsoft suite software, especially Excel, to perform daily tasks efficiently and accurately.
* A learning and professional growth mentality so that new software tools, systems, and processes can be adopted quickly and efficiently
* Working knowledge of clinical research concepts, policies and procedures, and human safety protection regulations and laws.
* Knowledge of and experience working with a variety of local and external IRBs, scientific review and other research committees, national cooperative group sponsors, industry sponsors, federal and foundation funding organizations, etc.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively establish rapport, building collaborative relationships, and communicate complex concepts and ideas in an easy-to-understand manner.
* Ability to adapt to changing job demands and priorities, remain flexible including working flexible hours to accommodate research deadlines.
* High degree of concentration and focus in a work environment that contains distracting stimuli, competing deadlines, and work delegated by more than one individual
* Availability to work in more than one environment, travelling to various clinic sites, meetings, conferences, etc.

jobs.title: FP Movement Associate Community Manager
jobs.description:
Role Summary:

We’re looking for an energetic, highly organized **Associate Community Manager** to help bring our community strategy to life across events, ambassador programming, and community activations.

This person will be a key day-to-day partner to the Associate Director of Community + Special Events, helping turn ideas into thoughtful, strategic experiences that deepen relationships with our community. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable coordinating the details behind the scenes and representing the brand on the ground IRL.

You’ll help manage community touchpoints ranging from run days and walk clubs to ambassador programming, special events, and other grassroots activations across the US and beyond.

Role Responsibilities:

**Community Programming**
-------------------------

* ### Support the planning and execution of a strategic community programming calendar, including run days, walk clubs, ambassador activations, special events, and other community experiences.
* ### Own the community programming budget, including planning, forecasting, allocation, vendor management, and tracking spend against program goals.
* ### Coordinate event logistics, vendors, supplies, timelines, and staffing support plans across Marketing/ Retail/ Social, and other cross-functional partners.
* ### Partner closely with cross-functional teams to ensure broader brand priorities, product launches, campaigns, and cultural moments are thoughtfully integrated into community programming in an authentic way.
* ### Be hands-on at events and activations, ensuring every detail of the experience feels intentional, elevated, and on-brand.
* ### Analyze participation, engagement, attendance, and other program performance data to understand what is working, where there are opportunities for growth, and how we should strategically evolve our programming.
* ### Identify opportunities to expand the reach and impact of community programming, using data, audience insights, and emerging trends to inform where and how we invest.
* ### Continuously challenge the community strategy to make programming more engaging, inclusive, relevant, and impactful.

**Ambassador Program**
----------------------

* ### Help build and evolve a robust, scalable ambassador program that strengthens relationships with key community leaders and creates meaningful brand advocacy.
* ### Support the day-to-day management of the ambassador community, including communications, activations, gifting, events, and ongoing engagement.
* ### Help develop and execute ambassador recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and retention strategies.
* ### Cultivate strong, authentic relationships with ambassadors and serve as a trusted point of contact and extension of the brand.
* ### Track and analyze ambassador participation, engagement, performance, and program deliverables to understand impact and identify opportunities for growth.
* ### Use program insights and community data to continuously refine the ambassador experience and strengthen the overall program strategy.
* ### Identify emerging community leaders, creators, and advocates who can help expand our reach and deepen our connection within priority communities.
* ### Partner with Social, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for ambassadors to authentically support larger brand initiatives, product moments, storytelling, and launches.

Role Qualifications:

* 2–4 years of experience in community, events, experiential marketing, partnerships, hospitality, fitness/wellness, or a related field
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through
* Naturally outgoing, warm, and relationship-oriented
* Comfortable interacting with a wide range of people and building authentic relationships
* Able to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
* Willingness to work occasional evenings and weekends for community events
* A genuine interest in movement, wellness, culture, and building community

### **Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Community programming runs smoothly, consistently, and thoughtfully
* Ambassadors feel connected, supported, and engaged
* Events feel authentic to the brand rather than simply promotional
* Community members increasingly recognize the brand as a place they belong
* The Associate Director has a strong operational partner who can take an idea and independently move it toward execution

This role is based in Los Angeles, CA.

The wage range for this role is $75,000 - $80,000. Wages are based on several factors including but not limited to experience, education, geographic location, etc

At Baker Electric we are energized by truly living our values - Team Builders, Relentless Follow Through, All-In, and Care for Others. When our team members work together with these things in mind, we do great things both individually and as an organization. Being an employee-owned company shows our drive for sustainable, long-term growth while enhancing the lives of our team members.
  
  
**SUMMARY:** The Assistant Project Manager is responsible for providing a higher level of technical support to the Project Managers and with limited direction, will manage small to mid-size projects. The Assistant Project Manager interacts with the customer and field on a more regular basis and provides direction to Project Engineers as requested. This is an exempt position that is an individual contributor and may be temporarily positioned on a project site.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Assumes job duties and responsibilities of the Project Engineer II
* Actively manage small to mid-size projects with limited oversight of a PM/Sr. PM/PX up to a certain dollar amount and risk level
* Generate and quality control all aspects of project documentation including submittals, RFIs, change orders and project meeting minutes
* Responsible for material requisition, submittal compilation, purchase orders, on-site job walks, negotiation of change orders, request for information, pay application support and close-out documents
* Assist in directing overall project activities as assigned by the Project Manager including planning and coordinating, circumventing/resolving problem areas, ensuring all company/project policies, procedures and standards are maintained, etc.
* Ensure that the project quality control plan is in effect and followed
* Interacts with Subcontractors to make certain that we have obtained the correct documentation and drawings for the projects
* Monitor other contractors’ activities and progress
* Provides information to field on behalf of Project Manager as requested
* Assume total project supervision responsibilities in Project Manager's absence
* Provide technical support to the Project Manager and Superintendent, and act as the secondary point of contact with clients, architects, consultants, subcontractors, and suppliers regarding status reports, updates, and addressing customer needs
* Assist with the management of the bid process, analyze blueprints/specifications, review proposals/project requirements and coordinate materials procurement
* Assist with bidding, conducting material take-offs, and soliciting quotes from subcontractors and suppliers
* Attend pre-job walks and develop material lists and provide job site observations relative to obstructions, level of difficulty, and any information required to assist the estimator with the completion of a project estimate
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies and federal/state laws; provide status updates and maintain documentation records
* Assist with project delivery from pre-construction through commissioning, focused on achieving high quality, site safety, and aggressive schedules
* Assist with negotiating subcontracts, subcontractor and vendor buyout, preparation and tracking of contracts and procurement of submittals and materials.
* Assists PM and Superintendent with monitoring job costs and production versus budget. Under supervision of PM, provides inputs and submits accurate and timely monthly cost, income, cash flow projections, and generates client billings.
* Attend networking and industry events

**EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION:**  

* 2 – 4 years of experience in an electrical project support role (Project Coordinator, Project Engineer, and/or Estimator)
* Capable of managing an assigned portfolio of projects of low risk/value
* Proven ability to analyze electrical terminology, drawings, theory, etc. is required
* Successful graduation from an accredited electrical apprenticeship program, long-term experience in the electrical industry in a variety of capacities and/or Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Construction Management or related degree
* Ability and eagerness to learn new technology
* Proficiency in MS Office / O365 applications
* Proficiency in Procore (or related project management software) and Accubid Change Order (or related estimating software)

At Baker, we are proud to be an employee-owned company. When you join, you will have the opportunity for a great career and the financial benefits of being an owner. Through our ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan), eligible employees can become part owners of the company. Instead of just receiving a paycheck, you will be given shares of the company's stock over time. As the company prospers, the value of these shares can increase, providing you with a potential wealth-building opportunity in addition to a competitive compensation package. The ESOP will enable you to share the company's success and growth. For more information regarding employee ownership at Baker Electric and its significant potential, click here:
  
Employee Stock Ownership Program | Baker Electric (baker-electric.com)

The starting salary for this opportunity range is listed. Baker provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, an Employee-Owned Program (ESOP), paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO). A candidate’s salary history will not be used in compensation decisions. Please note that the compensation information is a good-faith estimate for this position. It assumes a rate based on location and experience.

jobs.title: Major Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.

Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.

This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.

We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.

What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.

If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.

 **Job Description**

What We Are Looking For

Check Point is looking for a high-impact Major Account Manager ready to win new strategic logos and unlock growth across a focused portfolio of approximately 20 existing customers and prospects. In this role, you will shape bold, multi-year account strategies, lead complex deals with senior decision-makers, and bring together a virtual account team to deliver meaningful outcomes for customers in a channel-friendly environment. This is an opportunity to own a critical territory, build trusted executive relationships, and help some of the world’s leading organizations stay secure as they accelerate their digital and AI transformation.

Key Responsibilities

* Drive new, expansion and renewal opportunities across all accounts
* Acquire new strategic logos while farming and expanding existing accounts
* Build executive relationships and secure senior-level access
* Develop and execute major account plans with multi-year view
* Lead complex, multi-stakeholder deal orchestration
* Lead contract and pricing negotiations
* Prioritize effectively across a large book of business
* Use Check Point tools to manage accounts, pipelines and forecast
* Coordinate a virtual account team (specialists, SE, etc)

 **Qualifications**

What You'll Need to Succeed

* 5+ years of B2B sales experience (2+ years in cyber security)
* Proven hunter-farmer mindset: able to open new doors, land strategic logos, and expand existing accounts.
* Consistent overperformance, including 110%+ net revenue retention and meaningful multi-product growth.
* Experience navigating complex enterprise accounts and influencing buying committees of 5–10+ stakeholders.
* Strong executive presence, with the ability to build trust, multi-thread relationships, and create senior-level access.
* Sharp operator with disciplined account planning, accurate forecasting, and strong cross-functional orchestration.
* Channel-savvy seller with industry relationships that can accelerate momentum.

Equal Opportunity

Check Point Software Technologies is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

* Must be eligible to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

**EOE M/F/Veterans/Disabled**

The wage range for this position takes into consideration a variety of factors in determining your pay. We'll consider your location, experience, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The wage disclosure has not been adjusted for applicable geographic differentials associated with the location at which this position may be filled. A reasonable estimate of the current base wage range for this role is $140,000 - $165,000. In addition to the base compensation, certain roles are eligible for additional compensation, including an annual bonus or sales incentive based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee’s role. These awards are allocated based on individual performance. Benefits/perks listed here may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Check Point Software Technologies and the country/state where you work. US-based employees gain access to healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan and company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, stock awards and an employee stock purchasing plan.

 **Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Retail Big Box
jobs.description:
**This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.**

Do you thrive on building strong relationships and driving sales performance within retail environments? As an Account Manager for Retail Big Box at Spectrum, you will manage partnerships with leading retailers, maximize sales opportunities, and ensure Spectrum's brand is represented with excellence. Your expertise will directly influence customer satisfaction and business growth, making a lasting impact on the retail landscape.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

  

* Manage daily relationships with assigned Big Box Retailers and third-party vendors to maximize sales opportunities and uphold Spectrum's brand standards
* Execute strategies, conduct field sales operations, and support partners through audits, training, business reviews, and product knowledge sessions
* Lead regular meetings and trainings to ensure partners meet sales targets, maintain quality standards, and achieve key performance indicators
* Deliver comprehensive product, promotion, and offering information to partners to drive awareness and sales
* Collaborate with partner owners to develop and manage growth plans that align with Spectrum’s objectives
* Work closely with Operations, Strategy, and divisional teams to ensure departmental alignment and successful implementation of initiatives
* Coordinate special events, oversee staffing and merchandising, and facilitate sales execution to maximize retail performance
* Monitor sales metrics, identify areas for improvement, and implement strategies to enhance partner performance
* Provide actionable reports and feedback to channel leadership to influence sales strategy and resolve challenges
* Prospect and onboard new business partners to expand Spectrum’s retail footprint and drive incremental sales

**Working Conditions**

  

* Spend approximately 20 percent of your time in the office and 80 percent in the field with weekly visits to assigned partners and retail locations
* Participate in occasional division-wide travel as required

**What You’ll Bring to Spectrum**

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university or equivalent experience

**Experience**

* 5+ years of related experience or equivalent combination of education and training

**Skills**

* Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English
* Strong sales presentation and problem-solving skills with demonstrated initiative
* Effective written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
* Ability to work independently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
* Flexibility to work retail hours and adjust schedule as needed to maximize sales opportunities
* Reliable transportation
* Valid and active state driver’s license with a safe driving record
* Willingness to travel frequently within assigned territory

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 5+ years of strong sales experience with a proven track record

**Skills**

* Bilingual is a plus

jobs.title: Business Development Account Manager - Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description:
**Before you apply to a job, select your language preference from the options available at the top right of this page.**

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

**Job Description:**

*This position will support a territory including Los Angeles, CA, Glendale, CA and Burbank, CA*

**Summary**
-----------

As a Business Development Account Manager, you will play a crucial role in driving our company's growth by identifying and acquiring new business opportunities. You will be responsible for developing and implementing effective sales strategies to reach and exceed sales targets. This role requires a combination of strong interpersonal skills, strategic thinking, and a results-oriented mindset.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Prospecting and Lead Generation**

* Identify and research potential clients through various channels.
* Generate new leads and opportunities through cold calling, networking, and other outreach methods.
* Collaborate with marketing teams to leverage inbound leads and campaigns.

### **Value Analysis and Presentation**

* Conduct compelling presentations to showcase our products/services and highlight their value proposition.
* Effectively communicate the benefits of our solutions to potential clients.

### **Market and Product Communication**

* Understand clients' needs and tailor solutions to meet their specific requirements.
* Demonstrates comprehensive understanding of product components, design, features and benefits when communicating product features or design and tailoring the message to meet customer needs.

### **Sales Strategy and Planning**

* Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to achieve and exceed sales targets.
* Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify new opportunities.

### **Negotiation and Closing**

* Negotiate terms and conditions with potential clients to secure new business.
* Close deals efficiently while ensuring customer satisfaction.

### **Collaboration**

* Work closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product development, and customer support, to ensure a seamless client experience.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Proven track record of success in B2B sales, with a focus on new business acquisition.
* Strong understanding of logistics and the ability to articulate our value proposition effectively.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Self-motivated with a results-oriented mindset.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.
* Willing to travel.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred).
* Applicants must be currently located in the same geographic area as the position or willing to self-relocate, as relocation assistance is not available.

**Employee Type:**

Permanent

UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

**Other Criteria:**

UPS is an equal opportunity employer. UPS does not discriminate on the basis of race/color/religion/sex/national origin/veteran/disability/age/sexual orientation/gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

UPS does consider job applicants with prior criminal convictions

**Basic Qualifications:**

Must be a U.S. Citizen or National of the U.S., an alien lawfully admitted for permanent residence, or an alien authorized to work in the U.S. for this employer.

**Pay Range:**

The salary range for this position is $60.660,00/year to $106.200,00/year. Actual compensation is based on various factors such as location, job-related knowledge, skills, education/training, and work experience. This position is eligible for our sales incentive plan and offers the annual management incentive plan, subject to applicable eligibility requirements. Incentives are not guaranteed and are dependent upon individual and/or company performance. Our company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements. Medical/prescription drug coverage, Dental & Vision Benefits, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, Basic and Supplemental Life Insurance & Accidental Death and Dismemberment, Disability Income Protection Plan, Employee Assistance Program, Educational Assistance Program, 401(k) retirement program, Vacation, Paid Holidays and Personal time, Paid Sick/Family and Medical Leave time as required by law, Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Program.

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Since 2018, the dedicated team at Natural Green Technology (NGT) has been committed to providing top-quality packaging solutions, including Mylar bags, labels, shrink wraps, and boxes, to the Cosmetics, Food & Beverage, Pet, Tobacco, Medicine/Pharmaceuticals, Cannabis industries.

We control the entire manufacturing process which allows us to be able to produce any type of packaging idea for businesses- if you can imagine it, we can create it.

We’re excited to welcome an experienced Territory Sales Manager to grow our business!

The ideal candidate will have B2B selling experience and be well informed about our business. Previous custom packaging selling experience and a book of business is required.

***This position requires on site attendance 5 days a week from 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM.***

**Only 2 candidates will be selected, submit your resume today.**

**What we’re offering:**

* Extensive training on our CRM systems along with chances to share the areas you’d like further development
* Dedicated support with an assigned designer and sales assistant, resolving any issues within 24 hours
* Clearly defined sales territory and strict territory protection
* Warm leads- waiting to hear from you
* Networking opportunities and trade show admission
* Office snacks, tea, coffee and refreshments
* A collaborative, positive company culture
* PTO, sick, holidays and medical insurance for full-time employees

**Job Duties:**

* Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve revenue goals for packaging products
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and repeat business.
* Attend and represent the company at trade shows, networking events, and industry conferences
* Prepare and deliver sales presentations, product demos, and proposals to prospective clients.
* Negotiate terms, close sales contracts, and manage the sales pipeline effectively.
* Travel within the region to meet clients, attend trade shows, and build relationships across industries
* Other duties assigned by management

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in any field of study or 3 years of relevant experience
* 3-5 years’ experience in sales within the packaging industry or sales experience in Cosmetics, Food & Beverage, Pet, Tobacco, Medicine/Pharmaceuticals, Cannabis, and Hemp industries
* Ability to travel by air unrestricted
* Ability to legally operate a passenger vehicle
* **MAC COMPUTER PROFICIENCY IS REQUIRED**

Pay: $71,000.00 - $72,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Rate your Mac OS computer skills from 1-10.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Anaheim, CA 92807

jobs.description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits.

Provide clinical demonstrations and instruction for use of company products in pre-sale, implementation, and post-sale situations in formal educational as well as small-group or individual presentations in patient-care areas throughout a healthcare facility, to gain or increase acceptance of company’s products and technology.

Responsibilities

* Provide information through formal presentations to Physicians, and Administration customers that detail the clinical and/or financial benefits of company’s devices as related to the group.
* Evaluate new products or enhancements to devices to provide information and feedback to the Product Development and Marketing departments.
* Works with customers to introduce, promote, and increase the usage of products throughout a customer facility.
* Assist with the collection and dissemination of information or feedback provided by customers.
* Represent company at various trade shows or educational meetings and complete all necessary reports.
* Provide product support and education to users either in person, in-service or by written or verbal means.
* Continuously increases knowledge of new developments within the assigned market as well as company products to perform as a subject matter expert.
* Develop and disseminate information to internal executives and staff regarding issues related to customer acceptance of company’s technology and products during the pre-sale and evaluation process.

Qualifications

* BS degree preferred in related field or 6 years demonstrated successful sales experience.
* Minimum of 4 years related medical device experience.
* Great communication skills.
* Maintain all Certifications and Vendor Credentials.
* Ability to work independently with little or no direct supervision.
* Demonstrate effective educational and presentation skills in diverse settings from one-on-one to formal large group situations.
* Apply critical thinking skills to solve complex clinical problems.
* Excellent command of the English language with comprehensive written and verbal communication, interpersonal, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Must have the ability to concentrate on detail and work independently and meet deadlines with strong attention to detail.
* Demonstrated experience of strong influential skills and followership.
* Must have desire to participate in a healthcare team in the treatment of patients and anticipate needs of others.
* Comprehensive computer skills with experience in Microsoft Office with ability to develop presentation materials.
* Strong sales and business acumen.
* Demonstrate clinical expertise and case excellence.

Preferred

* Preferred experience in endovascular/OR space.
* Clinical acumen is preferred.

**Sales Commission only:** This role is 100% commission and is eligible for bonuses + benefits.

Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD&D insurance, and short-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About us:** emrgonline.com

EMRG is an award-winning Digital Marketing Agency based in Los Angeles. With a team of experienced professionals for each service line, we offer a wide range of digital marketing solutions that are customized to meet the unique needs of each client. We are renowned for our outstanding customer service and ability to deliver exceptional results. As a leading agency in the industry, we have established ourselves as a reliable partner for businesses looking to grow and expand their online presence.

As our company continues to grow, we are also committed to expanding our philanthropic goals and supporting children in need worldwide.

**Job Summary:**

We need an experienced Account Manager with a general understanding of digital marketing and a passion for perfect execution. jobs.title: National Account Manager
jobs.description:
Creative Outdoor Advertising of America Inc. has been a leader in outdoor signage for over 40 years. Our well-established business is seeking a highly driven, results focused National/Regional Business Development Manager to join our National Sales Team. This role will lead revenue growth across the Westcoast region. We are looking for a true hunter—someone energized by prospecting, opening new doors, and building long term client partnerships.

**Compensation & Location:** Annual salary of $80,000 plus 6% commission on all new sales. The schedule is Monday – Friday 8:30 am to 5:00 pm. The role is based in Los Angeles. The position is remote - working predominantly from your home office but also in the field. There will be regular travel throughout the Los Angeles sales region and on occasion to other areas – a valid passport and flexibility to travel are a must.

**Position Overview:** This position focuses on developing new business, building relationships with direct retail and regional brand clients, and engaging regional agency media strategists and buyers. COA Group is one of the nation’s leaders in street level OOH media, delivering impactful advertising opportunities across transit shelters, benches, and kiosks throughout the U.S. and Canada.

**What will set you apart?** With an entrepreneurial mindset and a passion for building businesses from the ground up, you bring a competitive, goal-oriented drive focused on closing deals. You are a resourceful and proactive professional, capable of independently managing fast-paced territories with high levels of integrity and client service excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

New Business Development (Primary Focus)

* Conduct proactive outreach—including in person meetings, cold calling, email campaigns, and industry networking—to secure new advertising partners
* Aggressively prospect, identify, and acquire new regional national accounts across Los Angeles
* Build and manage a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities with weekly and monthly activity targets
* Present COA’s full portfolio of OOH products, data capabilities, and market insights

Sales Strategy & Account Growth

* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accurate inventory availability, competitive pricing, and client satisfaction
* Develop tailored proposals, packages, and presentations aligned with client objectives and marketing strategies
* Analyze market trends and competitive activity to drive strategic positioning and new revenue opportunities
* Maintain strong relationships with agencies, brand direct clients, media planners, and buyers

Territory Leadership

* Serve as the primary business development lead for the Los Angeles markets while contributing to national account initiatives
* Provide insights into market demand, emerging categories, and regional growth strategies
* Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and client engagements

Forecasting & Reporting

* Deliver regular updates on pipeline status, revenue projections, and client activities
* Maintain accurate CRM documentation and forecasting
* Meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets

**Our ideal candidate**

Required

* Proven ability to pitch, negotiate, and close deals with senior level decision makers at large and mid size businesses
* Proficiency with technology, including internal inventory management systems and CRM platforms (Salesforce)
* 3–10+ years of successful B2B sales experience, preferably in similar or nontraditional OOH advertising media
* Demonstrated hunter mentality—persistent, self motivated, disciplined, and enthusiastic about prospecting
* Strong network of midsize agency and regional brand contacts in the West Coast (LA preferred)
* Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills

Preferred

* Experience selling media—especially nontraditional OOH, transit advertising, or street level media assets
* Ability to analyze data, audience metrics, and market research to inform sales strategies
* Knowledge of the Los Angeles advertising marketplace and Westcoast regional dynamics

**We Provide**

* Comprehensive introductory training (including Health & Safety) and ongoing support
* Eligibility for flexible ICHRA medical benefits after 3 months, with options for dental, vision, life, and disability insurance

jobs.title: National Account Manager
jobs.description:
About Kole Imports

Kole Imports is a leading wholesale importer and distributor of general merchandise, serving retailers throughout the United States for more than 40 years. Our extensive product assortment includes housewares, electronics, toys, seasonal merchandise, beauty, sporting goods, apparel, home décor, and other high-volume consumer products.

We work with retailers ranging from independent businesses to major regional and national chains, providing competitive pricing, a constantly changing product assortment, and opportunities across both everyday merchandise and closeout inventory.

We are looking for an experienced, driven **National Account Manager** to develop and manage relationships with major retail accounts and help expand Kole Imports' presence with national and regional retailers.

Position Overview

The National Account Manager will be responsible for developing new business, growing existing strategic accounts, and building long-term relationships with retail buyers and decision-makers.

This is a sales-focused position for someone who knows how to identify opportunities, present products effectively, negotiate deals, and turn relationships into meaningful, recurring business.

The ideal candidate is comfortable managing large accounts while actively prospecting for new opportunities.

Responsibilities

* Develop and manage relationships with national and regional retail accounts
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities with major retailers, distributors, e-commerce companies, and other high-volume customers
* Build relationships with buyers, category managers, purchasing teams, and senior decision-makers
* Present new products, closeouts, promotional opportunities, and category programs to customers
* Develop account-specific sales strategies to increase revenue and expand product penetration
* Conduct regular sales presentations, buyer meetings, and product reviews
* Negotiate pricing, programs, quantities, and other deal terms
* Manage the sales process from initial prospecting through order placement and ongoing account development
* Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects and existing customers
* Work closely with purchasing, operations, logistics, marketing, and other internal departments to support customer needs
* Analyze sales performance and identify opportunities for additional growth within existing accounts
* Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, and sales pipeline information
* Attend trade shows, customer meetings, and industry events as needed
* Consistently work toward individual and company sales goals

Qualifications

* Experience managing large, regional, national, or key accounts strongly preferred
* Demonstrated ability to prospect and develop new business
* Strong negotiation and closing skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong relationship-building and account management abilities
* Comfortable presenting products and sales programs to buyers and senior-level decision-makers
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities simultaneously
* Self-motivated, competitive, and results-oriented
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced sales environment with a large and constantly changing product assortment
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM/sales management systems
* Ability to travel for customer meetings and trade shows as needed
* Background in wholesale, consumer goods, general merchandise, closeouts, off-price retail, importing, distribution, or related industries is a plus

Why Join Kole Imports?

* Established company with decades of experience in the wholesale industry
* Extensive assortment across numerous consumer product categories
* Opportunities to sell both everyday merchandise and unique closeout deals
* Existing relationships throughout the retail industry
* Fast-moving environment where strong salespeople can make a meaningful impact
* Opportunity to develop relationships with major regional and national retailers
* Support from an experienced purchasing, operations, logistics, marketing, and sales organization

Pay: $60,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
Introduction:

Since 1973, East West Bank has served as a pathway to success. With over 110 locations across the U.S. and Asia, we are the premier financial bridge between the East and West. Our teams of experienced, multi-cultural professionals help guide businesses and community members on both sides of the Pacific looking to explore new markets and create new opportunities, and our sustained growth and expertise in industries like real estate, entertainment and media, private equity and venture capital, and high-tech help build sustainable businesses and expand our associates’ potential for career advancement.

Headquartered in California, East West Bank (Nasdaq: EWBC) is a top-performing commercial bank with a strong foundation, an enterprising spirit and a commitment to absolute integrity. East West Bank gives people the confidence to reach further.

Overview:

The Social Media & Digital Engagement Manager will lead the Bank’s enterprise social media strategy, governance, content, creator partnerships, and engagement across English and Chinese-language platforms. This strategic, hands-on leader will use owned and external channels to strengthen brand equity, customer relationships, executive visibility, and business growth.

The role will manage a social media team and collaborate with Brand Marketing, Public Relations, Media & Advertising, Business Lines, Legal, Compliance, Risk Management, and Executive Leadership. English and Mandarin Chinese bilingual proficiency is highly desirable.

Responsibilities:

**Social Media Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and execute an enterprise social media strategy across English and Chinese-language platforms, with clear channel priorities, governance, performance goals, and alignment to brand and business objectives.
* Lead key platforms, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, WeChat, RedNote, and emerging channels, with culturally relevant and consistent content.
* Develop the social media team and manage agency and vendor partners while building audience engagement, affinity, and customer relationships.

**Brand Storytelling & Content Strategy**

* Lead content planning and editorial strategy across social channels, ensuring alignment with the Bank’s brand voice, values, and priorities.
* Develop content that highlights expertise, customer impact, community involvement, sponsorships, culture, and thought leadership.
* Build and manage a creator strategy aligned with the Bank’s brand, audiences, and business objectives to extend campaign reach, strengthen credibility, and support customer acquisition and conversion.

**Executive Visibility & Thought Leadership**

* Amplify executive perspectives, company achievements, business initiatives, community engagement, and corporate milestones to strengthen thought leadership across social platforms.

**Reputation Management**

* Monitor conversations, sentiment, reputation, risks, and opportunities across social channels.
* Develop response and escalation protocols with Corporate Communications, Legal, Compliance, and Risk Management.

**Revenue Support & Demand Generation**

* Partner with business line and media teams to align organic and paid social efforts that support awareness, consideration, customer growth, and campaign performance.

**Employee Advocacy & Social Governance**

* Establish social media policies, governance, and employee education covering brand standards, regulatory requirements, and appropriate practices.
* Partner with Enterprise Risk Management, Compliance, Legal, Human Resources, and Public Relations to mitigate reputational and regulatory risk.

**Analytics & Performance Optimization**

* Define KPIs and monitor audience growth, engagement, sentiment, share of voice, reputation, and business performance.
* Provide executive insights and use performance trends to optimize content, channels, and engagement.

Qualifications:

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Business, or related field.

* 10+ years of progressive experience in social media, digital or brand marketing, corporate communications, or related disciplines, including 3+ years of people leadership.
* Demonstrated success building enterprise social strategies and executive thought leadership programs.
* Strong knowledge of social platforms, content strategy, audience engagement, analytics, and reputation management.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, analytical, strategic planning, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience in a highly regulated industry, preferably financial services.

**Preferred**

* Bilingual in English and Chinese (Mandarin preferred).
* Experience managing WeChat, RedNote, and multicultural marketing initiatives.
* Experience within banking, financial services, wealth management, fintech, or related industries.
* Experience with social listening and social media management platforms such as Sprinklr, Brand watch, Meltwater, Sprout Social, or similar tools.
* Experience managing agency partners and external vendors, with preference for candidates who have worked at a creator agency, talent or creator management firm, social platform, or brand-side influencer marketing program.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Compensation: The base pay range for this position is USD $100,000.00/Yr. - USD $135,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.
