jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Summerfield Tea Bar has been serving handcrafted tea and munchies across Southern California since 2015. We're growing fast, with six locations and more on the way, and we're looking for a creative, outgoing storyteller to become the face of our brand online.

**About the Role**

This isn't a behind-the-desk social media job. You'll be in front of the camera as much as behind it: interviewing customers, hosting videos, capturing the energy at our events, and turning it all into content that grows our community. You'll own our presence across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn, keeping every account active, current, and on-brand. If you light up a room, love talking to people, and know your way around a camera, we want to meet you.

**What You'll Do**

* Be the on-camera personality for Summerfield, hosting videos, conducting customer interviews, and creating content that feels fun and authentic.
* Plan, film, and edit short-form video for Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, with YouTube and other platforms as opportunities grow.
* Manage and maintain all brand accounts (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn), making sure profiles, bios, links, highlights, and store info are up to date and accounted for.
* Drive follower growth and engagement through consistent posting, trends, community interaction, and creative ideas.
* Attend off-site events and pop-ups to capture behind-the-scenes footage, talk with guests, and create content on the spot.
* Engage with customers in person and online, representing our brand with warmth and hospitality.
* Photograph drinks, stores, events, and people for social and marketing use.
* Track what's working and share ideas to keep improving our content and reach.

**What We're Looking For**

* Hands-on experience filming and editing video in CapCut and Adobe Premiere Pro.
* Experience creating and posting content on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.
* Background in photography and/or videography is a plus.
* A working knowledge of camera basics, including shutter speed, aperture, ISO, framing, and lighting. You don't need to be an expert; we'll help you grow the rest.
* A big, outgoing personality and total comfort being on camera.
* Natural people skills: you enjoy talking to strangers, putting customers at ease, and drawing out great stories.
* A hospitable, positive attitude that reflects our brand.
* Availability to work off-site events, including some evenings and weekends.
* Reliable transportation to travel between our SoCal locations and event sites.

**Big Pluses**

* Your own camera gear (camera, lenses, mics, lighting, gimbal). This is a major plus, not required.
* Experience with YouTube, LinkedIn, or other platforms.
* A portfolio or personal social account that shows your on-camera presence and editing style.
* Experience in food and beverage, hospitality, or lifestyle content.
* A love of boba and tea culture.

**Work Setup & Flexibility**

This is a hybrid role based out of our office in Brea, CA. You'll split your time between the office, our store locations, off-site events, and working remotely when it makes sense. We believe great content comes from people who feel balanced and energized, so we offer a very flexible schedule and real support for work-life balance. Event days may include some evenings and weekends, and we'll work with you to keep your overall schedule manageable.

Pay: $21.00 - $22.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Brea, CA 92821

jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative (1099)
jobs.description:
**Territory Sales Representative**  
**(1099)**

Small & Medium-Sized Business Sales + Multi-Dwelling Units (Internet services)

  

About WeLink

WeLink is a next-generation wireless internet service provider using advanced millimeter wave technology, including our own custom radios, and a proprietary approach to network deployment. Our technology allows us to deliver fast, reliable, fiber-like internet while expanding into markets more quickly and cost-effectively than traditional providers.

Founded by experienced fixed-wireless professionals, WeLink is building an alternative to traditional cable and telecom providers. We are focused on providing businesses and communities with better connectivity, competitive pricing, and a customer experience they can rely on.

Position Overview

We are looking for a motivated Territory Sales Representative to help grow WeLink's small and medium-sized business customer base.

In this role, you will take ownership of assigned leads and be responsible for executing on new business opportunities, developing relationships with local businesses, and growing WeLink's presence within the market. You will spend much of your time in the field meeting business owners, managers, and decision-makers, understanding their connectivity needs, and introducing them to WeLink's business internet solutions.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys building a territory, opening new accounts, and creating business where it didn't exist before. As WeLink expands its SMB division, your work will play an important role in establishing new markets and driving long-term growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Take ownership of an assigned geographic territory and develop a strategy for growing SMB sales.
* Identify businesses and commercial areas that represent new sales opportunities.
* Build a consistent pipeline of potential new customers
* Establish WeLink's presence within new markets by developing relationships with local businesses and decision-makers.

* Meet directly with business owners, managers, and other decision-makers to understand their internet and connectivity needs.
* Introduce WeLink's business internet solutions and explain the value and benefits of switching providers.
* Conduct sales presentations, answer questions, overcome objections, and close new accounts.

* Work with sales leadership and internal teams to develop effective approaches for entering and growing new markets.

* Coordinate with internal teams to help ensure a smooth transition from sale through installation and activation.
* Maintain positive relationships with customers and represent WeLink professionally within the business community.
* Identify opportunities for additional services, referrals, or future business growth.

Qualifications & Skills

* 2+ years previous experience in outside sales, B2B sales, business development, telecommunications, or a related field preferred.
* Comfortable approaching businesses and starting conversations with owners and decision-makers.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently in a field-based environment.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to learn technical products and clearly explain them to customers.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

Pay and Perks:

* 6 figure earning potential
* Paid Training: $110/day for up to 5 days.
* Monthly stipend of $2,000 for first 90-days to get you through the ramp period
* Uncapped commissions, paid out weekly
* Flexible Schedule: Work whatever days/hours make sense for you
* Quick sales cycle

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our workforce. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, or any other status protected by applicable law.*

jobs.title: Executive Assistant - Product & Tech Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
**\*\*This role sits in our Burbank, CA offices, and this person is required to be on-site 4 days/ week\*\***

**About the Role & Team**

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touchpoints serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

* **Building the future of Disney’s media**: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
* **Reach, Scale & Impact**: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.
* **Innovation**: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

The Business Operations team helps guide and articulate technology strategy and research, and is responsible for driving the day-to-day operation of the Product & Technology organization, including: project and portfolio management and tracking; organization-level capital, space, and resource management and allocation; process management; technical incident management; and our administrative and workplace experience support team.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**

* At least three (3) years of relevant experience required
* Mastery of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
* Mastery of administrative functions and processes.
* Expert verbal and written communication skills with an ability to communicate at all levels within the organization.
* Proven ability to work with confidential information, while exercising sound judgment and decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, make decisions and change course of action quickly.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven knowledge of enterprise Disney processes, structure, and practices
* Working knowledge of programs such as SAP, COUPA, Airtable, Concur, Loop, and AI platforms
* Administrative experience in a corporate environment with proven success interacting, partnering, and networking with all levels of management, including executives (directors and vice presidents) in a fast-paced dynamic environment

* High school diploma required
* College degree preferred

jobs.description:
**At April Housing, we’re building a team of bold, mission-driven professionals who are motivated by meaningful work and energized by collaboration.** Our work supports a clear purpose of expanding access to high-quality housing, and each role plays an important part in advancing that mission.

You’ll collaborate shoulder‑to‑shoulder with some of the most talented experts in the industry, gaining hands-on exposure that helps you grow your skills and broaden your perspective from the day one. Our environment is dynamic, fast paced and evolving, designed to support curious, ambitious people as they take on new challenges and develop capabilities that translate throughout their careers.

**April Housing** is a leading owner and operator of high‑quality affordable housing across the United States. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Los Angeles, we are a portfolio company of Blackstone Real Estate, supporting the affordable housing and LIHTC (Low-Income Housing Tax Credit) portfolio. Our mission is clear: preserve critical affordable housing stock while delivering exceptional management and high‑quality homes to the communities we serve. We are committed to being a fair, transparent, and responsible owner.

Backed by Blackstone Real Estate enabling us to invest in the creation and preservation of affordable housing for the long run. We are making a bold commitment to preserving affordable housing across the country. April Housing is dedicated to ensuring our assets aligned with high standards of excellence, including ongoing property improvements and elevated resident services.

We’re looking for individuals who share our commitment to excellence and believe in the impact that thoughtful, well-executed work can have on communities. **If you’re driven by purpose, value collaboration, and are excited to grow while contributing to something meaningful, April Housing offers a place to build experience, expand your impact, and do work that matters.**

The Assistant Project Manager’s primary responsibility is to support the Preservation and Investment departments (under direction of Resyndication Project Managers and Head of Preservation) to complete Year 15 resyndications/acquisition and rehabilitation transactions.

* Provides support to several Project Managers as needed in connection with acquisition/rehabilitation transactions, developing systems and processes to manage and track necessary documents and letters; communication across with internal staff; management of relevant consultants; management of construction and permanent loan closing due diligence and internal document review.
* Identifies necessary information and assembles tax credit and tax-exempt bond applications and bond inducement packages.
* Prepares and submits funding draws to various financial institutions during the rehabilitation stage.
* Performs relevant aspects of due diligence review including reviewing preliminary title reports, appraisals, market studies, Physical Needs Assessments, and relocation plans. Manages due diligence portion of closings.
* Gathers data required to analyze preliminary financial projections for potential transactions; updates projections as needed.
* Prepares construction bidding and contract materials.
* Analyzes funding competition and scoring of competitive applicants in connection with various sources.
* Manages aspects of tenant relocation process (in collaboration with asset management, property management, and relocation consultants).
* Provides input, analysis, and recommendations for development team member selection, including contractors and construction managers.
* Represents April Housing at certain industry conferences.

Qualifications:

* Qualified candidates must have a Bachelor’s degree and some related work or field work experience in matters related to affordable housing development such as residential architecture, finance, planning, construction, etc.
* Exposure to private and public debt financing.
* At least one successful LIHTC financial construction closing a plus.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator I : Research Cancer
jobs.description:
**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

Reporting to the Clinical Research Supervisor, Clinical Research Manager, or Director of Clinical Research Operations, the Clinical Research Coordinator I (CRC-I) is responsible for all aspects of clinical research activities and works in close cooperation with study physicians, inter- and intradepartmental stakeholders, and sponsors. The CRC-I provides support, coordination for FDA regulated research including data, blood and tissue collection studies that may involve industry-sponsored, government funded and/or investigator initiated clinical research trials.

The CRC-I is involved in all aspects of research clinical process including, but not limited to protocol review, preparation and administration of the informed consent, completion of study related visit forms, ensuring protocol required assessments are completed per study guidelines, processing of lab samples per IATA standards, regular communication with study sponsors and their collaborators, and data entry into study systems within study required timeframes.

The CRC I will ensure accurate completion of case report forms (CRFs), adverse event/serious adverse event (SAE) reporting, scheduled subject follow-up, and maintenance of regulatory binders. Discusses research study with potential study subjects and answers any questions (may refer questions to Principal Investigator or Sub-Investigator when appropriate) while obtaining informed consent as well as assisting in scheduling follow-up visits for enrolled subjects.

Responsible for development of study flow sheets, prepare study source documentation, gather study data, and assess subject for study eligibility (inclusion/exclusion). In addition, the CRC-I will record protocol specific assessments and ensure collection and shipment of samples, complete study forms to submit to sponsors and/or appropriate agencies, collect, enters and clean data into study database while maintaining data quality. He/she will host study team meetings, attend site initiation visits (SIVs) and perform other duties as assigned. Performs other duties as assigned.

Must be knowledgeable of Good Clinical Practices, protection of human subjects in research practices, and FDA regulatory guidelines regarding clinical research.

  

**Education and Experience**

* High School Diploma with sufficient experience and demonstrated skills to successfully perform the assigned duties and responsibilities; and/or equivalent experience/training.
* Excellent verbal and written communications and presentation skills; excellent organizational skills; and excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively in a diverse team.
* Attention to details.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Windows.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-based environment; project management and coordination skills; ability to prioritize tasks and meet multiple deadlines on concurrent projects.
* Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with patients, co-workers, & physicians.

**Preferred:**

* Medical terminology required. Working knowledge of FDA, NIH and OHRP regulatory requirements and ICH GCP guidelines.
* Understanding of clinical trial methodologies and experience filing Institutional Review Board documents.
* Ability to abstract data from medical records and transfer it to data collection forms or directly into databases.
* International Air Transport Association (IATA) Certification
* Current ACRP or SoCRA Certification.

Custom Flavors is hiring a field-based Account Manager to grow our customer relationships across Utah, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, and Wyoming. You'll be the main commercial contact for customers in the region, working with our R&D and Applications teams in San Clemente to bring their products to market. Candidates must live within the territory, and the Salt Lake City area is strongly preferred.

**Position Summary and Purpose:** The Account Manager is responsible for retaining and growing revenue within an assigned territory or account portfolio by maintaining existing customer accounts, developing new business with current customers, and prospecting new customer accounts. The Account Manager serves as the primary commercial contact for assigned customers and partners with R&D, the Applications Lab, Regulatory, Quality Assurance, and Customer Service to deliver flavor solutions for food, beverage, and supplement applications. Role Overview

  

At Experian, we believe great work happens when people come together. We're focused on attracting talent in and around our designated hub locations who are open to collaborating with colleagues in person. Aligning employees to these talent markets help foster collaboration, strengthen team connections, and support long-term career growth within Experian. Events Marketing Specialist *(internally titled Senior Events Specialist)* You will report to the Marketing Manager and reside in or near one of our collaboration hubs:

* **Costa Mesa, California**
* **Allen, Texas**
* **Austin, Texas**

Are you passionate about creating events that promote brand visibility and achieve business growth? As an Events Marketing Specialist, you'll lead strategic events and sponsorships, partner with executive team members, and manage end-to-end event execution. You'll navigate competing demands, budgets, and timelines while delivering experiences that strengthen customer engagement and support business growth.

Main Responsibilities

* Lead the execution, and measurement of trade shows, conferences, client events, sponsorships, speaking engagements, and executive programs to achieve business growth, customer engagement, and brand visibility.
* Work with executives, Sales, Marketing, and important partners to develop event strategies, influence decisions, promote agreement, and create measurable impact.
* Develop and deliver executive communications, partner briefings, planning updates, and post-event business reviews.
* Manage multiple concurrent events and projects, overseeing timelines, logistics, vendors, contracts, budgets, risks, and onsite execution.
* Measure event performance, Return on investment, attendee engagement, and growth to improve and maximize value.
* Oversee event operations, marketing programs, and onsite execution, applying best practices to improve efficiency and event outcomes.

  
  

Experience and Skills

  

* Five+ years of experience within a corporate or B2B environment.
* Experience presenting to high-level partners with the ability to influence outcomes.
* Project management skills with experience delivering complex projects on time and within budget. Experience driving strategic plans and outcomes.
* Experience ensuring accurate execution across event planning, budgeting, and logistics.
* Experience with tradeshow and event production requirements, timelines, logistics, and execution best practices.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Renewals
jobs.description:
Douglas Adams once said, **"Technology is a word that describes something that doesn't work yet."** Funny, because it's true. So much so that it sparked our unrelenting mission to increase the positive impact of technology on people's lives.

From robot vacuums and voice assistants to banking apps, smart toys, and backyard grills, Centercode has helped shape countless products in virtually every household, and chances are good we've impacted your life already. We're full of people who take pride in striving toward our goals and having a blast while doing it. We're always on the lookout for enthusiastic, like-minded people to join us in making everyday life better through technology.

As a **Renewal Account Manager**, you'll play a key role in protecting and growing recurring revenue from your book of mid-market accounts. Your focus will be on renewal execution, retention health, and relationship management, ensuring customer success and contract continuity year over year. This position emphasizes consistent renewal performance, operational excellence, and customer advocacy.

  

**What You'll Do as a Renewal Account Manager**

*Renewal and Retention Execution*

* Own the full renewal lifecycle for assigned mid-market accounts
* Drive proactive portfolio management to ensure high renewal rates
* Coordinate and execute 120-day renewal engagement plans to mitigate risk of churn
* Negotiate terms and timing with customer contacts and stakeholders

*Customer Relationship Management*

* Deepen relationships with key stakeholders to ensure consistent value realization and product adoption
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers on product utilization, goals, and outcomes
* Connect with Customer Success and Support internally to solve customer challenges

*Performance and Metrics*

  

* Deliver against **Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)** and **Net Revenue Retention (NRR)** targets

  + Example targets: 90%-95% GRR and 102%-105% NRR annually
* Keep renewal forecasts and pipeline accurate and up to date
* Analyze churn drivers and surface insights for cross-team improvement

*Collaboration*

  

* Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and RevOps to align strategy and customer outcomes
* Facilitate handoffs to senior account managers and support expansion opportunities
* Drive internal communication on risk indicators and renewal planning
* Surface customer feedback to our Product and Services teams, shaping what we build and deliver

**What You Need** **to Do the Job**

*Experience and Skills*

* 3-5 years in SaaS account management, renewals, or customer success
* Strong relationship-building skills and negotiation experience
* Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) and renewal tracking processes
* Confidence working with mid-market customers, multiple stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
* Experience coordinating with procurement and legal teams to navigate renewals and approvals
* Fluency with and frequent use of modern AI tools and practices

*Mindsets and Traits*

* Customer-centric and proactive, anticipating needs before problems arise
* Organized, analytical, and metrics-driven
* Skilled at guiding timing and value conversations with clarity

**The Nitty-Gritty**

* Compensation: $90k-$100k annually (not commission-based)
* This is a full-time, hybrid position
* Candidate must live within commuting distance of HQ office (Mission Viejo, California)
* Candidate must be willing and able to travel up to 10%
* Sorry, recruiters: We're not open to working with you on this role
* We require a satisfactory background check following offer acceptance

**More About Us**

We're an innovative tech company, and we're always evolving. Our weird and wonderful work culture is unified by geeking out hard over tech: the old, the new, and the yet-to-exist. We value adaptability over perfectionism and productivity over long hours. Also, towels. They're very important to us.

**You'll Fit Right In If**

* You *love* emerging tech: using it, talking about it, tinkering with it
* You're obsessed with using AI to amplify your productivity
* You're not afraid to ask (or answer) *stupid* questions
* You're a strong communicator but your an even better listener
* You were triggered by the grammar in that last bullet
* Your coworkers speak highly of you and your work
* You know your biggest weakness, and it isn't that you're a perfectionist
* You're a builder with a track record to prove it
* You're willing to admit when you screw up (it happens to the best of us)
* You know the answer to the Ultimate Question

**The Typical Perks You'd Expect**

* Medical + FSA
* Voluntary Dental + Vision
* 3 weeks of PTO annually ✈️ (plus more the longer you're with the company)
* 401(k) matching
Other voluntary insurance: life, disability, pet, etc.* ️

**Plus a Few Pleasant Surprises**

* We pay for your phone (unlimited data!)
* We pay for your home internet (unlimited cat videos!)
* $1,000 budget to turn your at-home workspace into a temple of productivity
* Raise and bonus opportunities every year (treat yo self )
* Stock options
* Discounts on fitness, electronics, entertainment, and more
* IRL team-building events and parties in sunny Southern California

**Description**

  
  
  
**At Xe, we live currencies**. Founded in 1993, Xe is a global leader in currency exchange and international money transfers. What began as a simple currency converter has grown into a platform trusted by over 300 million people each year. We provide a comprehensive range of currency services and products, including our real-time exchange rates, Currency Converter, Market Analysis, Currency Data API, supporting 130+ currencies across 190+ countries with quick, easy, secure Money Transfers for individuals and businesses. Xe is profitable, product-led, and focused on building reliable, user-first tools that make moving money across borders easier for everyone.  
  
**Our Principles**  
At Xe, we value people who take initiative, think big, and follow through. We’re curious by nature and not afraid to ask what if or try something new. Everyone’s voice matters here. * Quality and consistency of outbound activity.
* Accepted meetings booked.
* Progression in discovery and qualification capability.

* Competitive salary + performance-based commission and incentives.
* 3 weeks paid vacation + personal days + sick time + holidays.
* Health, dental, vision and life insurance.
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

TP North America runs roughly ~70 events a year. Trade shows and industry conferences, executive roundtables, hosted customer experiences, client visits to the TIEC, territory field campaigns, and internal and sales kickoffs. The Event Marketing Coordinator keeps our program moving.

This is a hands-on execution role supporting a team of Event Marketing Managers aligned to our industry verticals and service horizontals. You help own the logistics, the deadlines, the shipments, the inventory, and the purchasing and contracting paperwork that make each event land clean. You are the person who knows where the booth is, when the deadline hits, what the PO number is, and how many polos are left in the crate.

Every event we run is measured on revenue generated, pipeline influenced, leads generated, and meetings booked. Your work is what protects those outcomes, working closely with Event Managers.

**This position is** **a** **hybrid** **role****. Please expect** **primarily** **work** **at home and** **occasional** **onsite****at** **the Santa Clara** **location.**

Event logistics execution

* Coordinate logistics across trade shows, conferences, roundtables, and hosted customer events, including booth assets, shipping and return handling, exhibitor services, registration, room blocks, staffing schedules, signage, and setup.
* Track exhibitor deadlines, registration windows, speaker and abstract submissions, and internal handoffs against each event timeline, and flag slippage early rather than reporting it late.
* Prepare and submit event materials to vendors and organizers, including logos, boilerplate, speaker bios, booth graphics, and lead retrieval orders.

Calendar, budget, and purchasing operations

* Maintain the master event calendar as the single source of truth for dates, owner, line of business, status, and key milestones.
* Open purchase orders, process invoices, and move vendor paperwork through procurement and legal on a timeline that does not put an event at risk.
* Keep the budget tracker current for every event, reconcile actuals against plan, and surface variances before they become surprises.
* Maintain vendor records, contracts, certificates of insurance, and shared event files in a structure where the current version is easy to find and gaps are visible.
* Support the intake process for new event requests, capturing the detail the team needs to evaluate and prioritize.

Swag, inventory, and brand standards

* Manage promotional inventory end to end, including stock levels, reorder points, storage, kitting, and shipping to and from event sites.
* Run intake for internal swag requests and coordinate ordering, holding the line on quantity, timing, and approved spend.
* Apply brand standards to booth graphics, collateral, and giveaways so every event looks like the same company showed up.
* Support vendor sourcing and comparison for swag and collateral, and track what performs and what does not.

* 1 to 3 years of experience in event coordination, marketing coordination, or a comparable operations role. Agency, in-house, association, or hospitality experience all count.
* Demonstrated ownership of the logistics for at least one event from planning through delivery.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field preferred.

* Working knowledge of purchasing basics, including POs, invoices, and vendor onboarding, or the appetite to learn them fast.

Description:

**DEPARTMENT:** Marketing and Communications

**POSITION:** Marketing and Communications Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** Associate Director of Marketing

**CLASIFICATION:** Annual full-time, non-exempt

**WORK SCHEDULE:** Monday-Friday, some nights and weekends required

**SALARY & BENEFITS:** $26.78 per hour; benefits eligible after 90 days

**Position Overview**

The Marketing and Communications Coordinator keeps Berkeley Rep’s marketing department organized and on schedule, connecting the people, vendors, and deadlines behind every production’s campaign. The Marketing and Communications Coordinator reports to the Associate Director of Marketing and manages departmental administration, including invoices, budget tracking, meetings, and shared inboxes. The position traffics ad materials to media vendors and partners, writes copy for media partners, and supports the printed show programs by gathering bios, headshots, credits, and scheduling Positioning and Editorial meetings.

The Marketing and Communications Coordinator also provides hands-on support for show campaigns, partnerships, and audience surveys and coordinates Berkeley Rep’s social media presence. On content, brand voice, and tone, the Marketing and Communications Coordinator works closely with, and under the guidance of, the Director of Marketing and Audience Services. This position also works closely with the Communications Manager, who provides editorial guidance and proofing, and with the annual Marketing Fellow, who contributes to social media and campaign support.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and curious early-career marketer who loves theatre. You can track a dozen deadlines without dropping one, and you follow up until every item is in. You keep a department’s details in order so your colleagues can focus on the big picture. You write clearly, you’re fluent in social media, and you can put personality into a caption. You’re comfortable working with designers, videographers, vendors, and colleagues across the organization. You want a hands-on role where you’ll learn how every part of a major regional theatre’s marketing comes together.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

***Departmental Administration***

* Process vendor invoices, ensuring timely payment, and record entries in the departmental budget tracking sheet.
* Schedule and attend department meetings, take detailed notes, and distribute notes and action items promptly.
* Check shared departmental inboxes in Outlook and Gmail daily, and make sure actionable messages are answered or forwarded to the right person.
* Traffic ad materials to media vendors and partners, tracking specs and deadlines, and write copy for media partners as needed.

***Printed Program Support***

* Solicit bios and headshots from each show’s cast, creative team, and staff, following up until every submission is in.
* Collect show credits from Production departments.
* Schedule Positioning and Editorial meetings with internal departments and external creative teams and distribute notes and action items promptly.
* Hand off collected materials to the Communications Manager, who manages program production, writing, and proofing.
* Assist the Communications Manager with proofing and gathering approvals as needed.

***Campaign and Show Support***

* Work with the Director of Marketing and Audience Services and the Community Engagement and Partnerships Manager to identify, solicit, and contract social media influencers and outside partners for each show.
* Create an external media kit for each show with the Marketing Fellow, and solicit cross-promotions from local theatre, arts, cultural, and affinity organizations.
* Work with the Communications Manager to create pre- and post-show emails for each show. This includes building the post-show survey in SurveyMonkey and distributing survey dashboards to relevant stakeholders.
* Manage in-person distribution of flyers, posters, and collateral as needed, including participation in the TBA Postcard Distribution Network.

***Social Media Coordination***

* Coordinate Berkeley Rep’s social media channels (currently Meta [Facebook, Instagram, and Threads], TikTok, and LinkedIn) in collaboration with the annual Marketing Fellow, under the guidance of the Director of Marketing and Audience Services on content, brand voice, and tone.
* Maintain the social media calendar in Asana, aligned with production schedules, campaigns, and department priorities.
* Request, brief, track, and review content assets from the Creative team, and create some video and graphic content with Creative’s guidance.
* Develop social copy with the Communications Manager.
* Get approval from the Director of Marketing and Audience Services or a designee before posting to Berkeley Rep’s main channels, then schedule and post approved content.
* Reply to comments and messages and monitor channels for questions and feedback. Escalate sensitive, negative, or time-critical issues rather than responding on Berkeley Rep’s behalf.
* Report on social media performance using each platform’s native analytics and Hootsuite, identifying what resonates with audiences.

***Other Responsibilities***

* Actively participate in workshops and training, including harassment prevention, bystander intervention, and antiracism, equity, diversity, inclusion, and access initiatives.
* Demonstrate a high degree of coachability and ability to integrate feedback into daily workflows and processes.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**Required**

* 1–3 years of experience in marketing, communications, administration, or social media, preferably in the arts or entertainment.
* Exceptional organizational and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage calendars, deadlines, and many concurrent projects.
* Strong writing and proofreading skills, with the ability to write engaging copy in a consistent brand voice.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

**Recruitment Coordinator**

**Location –** Palo Alto, CA (Hybrid – on-site as needed for candidate interviews; remote on other days). This role will be 30-40 hours per week with benefits.

**About GondolaBio**

GondolaBio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing breakthrough therapeutics for genetic diseases. GondolaBio is an independent sister company to BridgeBio, originally carved out in 2024 after securing $300M in private financing from external investors. GondolaBio aims to leverage cutting-edge biological research to discover, create, test, and deliver transformative medicines to treat patients who suffer from genetic diseases.

**Position Overview:**

GondolaBio is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Recruitment Coordinator to join our Talent Acquisition team on a full time basis. In this role, you will serve as a critical partner to recruiters and hiring managers, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for every candidate throughout the interview process. You will be responsible for coordinating both remote and on-site interviews, managing logistics for domestic and international candidates, and maintaining data integrity within our Applicant Tracking System.

**Responsibilities**

* Schedule and coordinate remote video interviews and on-site interviews, ensuring a smooth and professional experience for all candidates
* Be present on-site during candidate interview days to oversee logistics, greet candidates, and ensure the day runs seamlessly from start to finish
* Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates during the interview process, acting as a hospitality-focused ambassador for the GondolaBio brand
* Manage all logistics for on-site candidate visits, including creating detailed interview schedules, securing conference rooms, and arranging domestic and international travel
* Collect and track candidate NDAs prior to on-site visits
* Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to move candidates efficiently through each stage of the interview process, including interview scheduling, feedback collection, and reference coordination
* Utilize our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) to document and log all candidate activity, including updating job postings, uploading resumes, advancing interview stages, adding notes, and requesting feedback to maintain data integrity
* Proactively communicate scheduling updates and logistics details to all interview participants
* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance the candidate experience and team efficiency

Requirements:

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in a recruiting coordination, administrative, or executive support role; experience in a biotech or life sciences environment a plus
* Proficiency with an ATS strongly preferred
* Experience coordinating complex interview schedules across multiple time zones, including international candidates
* Exceptionally detail-oriented and thorough — someone who catches what others miss and takes ownership of every logistical detail
* Thrives in a fast-paced environment and can manage shifting priorities without losing accuracy or composure
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a candidate-first mindset
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously across a dynamic, ever-evolving organization
* Comfortable working both independently in a remote setting and on-site when candidate visits require your presence
* Familiarity with video conferencing platforms (Zoom, Teams)

**No** **matter** **your role at** **GondolaBio, successful team members are**

* **Patient Champions** who put patients first, uphold strict ethical standards, and anchor decisions in clinical and scientific integrity.
* **Entrepreneurial Operators** who take ownership and drive toward practical solutions, while exercising sound judgment, respecting established processes, and aligning with teammates and leadership.
* **Truth Seekers** who are rigorous, detail-oriented, and intellectually honest—comfortable challenging assumptions, engaging with data, and updating their views based on evidence.
* **Collaborative Thinkers** who work effectively in data-driven, interdisciplinary environments; listen actively; and welcome questions, debate, and constructive challenge as essential to better decision-making.
* **Individuals Who Inspire Excellence** in themselves and those around them.
* **High-quality Executors** who deliver against goals and milestones with precision, accountability, and appropriate urgency—without compromising scientific rigor or team alignment.

**What We Offer**

* Patient Days, where we are fortunate to hear directly from individuals living with the conditions we are seeking to impact throughout the year and learn how we can improve our efforts
* A culture inspired by our values: put patients first, think independently, be radically transparent, every minute counts, and let the science speak
* An unyielding commitment to always putting patients first
* A de-centralized model that enables our program teams to focus on advancing science and helping patients. Our affiliate structure is designed to eliminate bureaucracy and put decision-making power in the hands of those closest to the science
* A place where you own the vision – both for your program and your own career path
* A collaborative, fast-paced, data-driven environment where we inspire ourselves and each other to always perform at the top of our game
* Access to learning and development resources to help you get in the best professional shape of your life
* Flexible PTO

The base pay range for this position is $70,000 to $80,000 per year. The actual compensation offered will be determined based on a number of job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

GondolaBio ServiceCo is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex,

Position Summary

The Sales Coordinator provides comprehensive administrative, operational, and client-service support to the Sales & Marketing team. The position serves as a central liaison between sales leadership, event management, clients, reservations, front office, banquet operations, and other hotel departments.

Sales & Administrative Support

· Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to the Director of Sales, Senior Sales Manager, Event Manager, and broader Sales & Marketing team.

· Handle incoming sales calls and inquiries, assist with lead qualification, document opportunities, and route qualified business to the appropriate sales manager.

· Maintain accurate client, account, group, event, reservation, rate, and operational information across hotel systems.

· Prepare meeting materials, reports, correspondence, documentation, and other materials required for sales and operational meetings.

· Coordinate schedules, site tours, meetings, and time-sensitive requests across multiple departments and stakeholders.

· Maintain organized records and follow through on outstanding action items to ensure group and event details are completed accurately and on schedule.

* Help organize and execute all community sales events
* Submit all catering worksheets to Dining Services Director at least two weeks before event.
* Participate in each event and conduct tours as needed and directed by Sales Director.
* Participate in the setup and take-down of events.

**CRM Expectations**  

* Use the CRM to follow-up with leads in database with goal of scheduling new and repeat tours at the community.
* Follow-up with existing leads in CRM and reach out immediately to all leads that inquire through CRM or directly to the community.

**Schedule**  

* This position is a Sunday-Thursday position, depending on current schedules at the community.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

* Excellent verbal, problem-solving, and written communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Comfortable with ambiguity; can extract relevant components from complex situations to connect the dots, make sound decisions, and work with minimal direction.
* Understand the sales function and assigned community and make recommendations as business needs evolve.
* Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines and maintain consistent and regular attendance.

* Proficient with Microsoft Office, customer relationship management (CRM) software, and other business-related software.

* Minimum High School Diploma or GED. Prior customer service experience in the customer-facing industry.

jobs.description:
**Who are we:**  
At SSA, we believe our work matters because the people do. For more than 50 years, we've helped create experiences that leave people feeling connected, inspired, and reminded that fun still matters.
  
Whether you're looking for your first job, building your career, or bringing years of experience to a new role, you'll be part of a team that values your ideas, supports your growth, and encourages you to make an impact. More than 54% of our leaders are promoted from within, reflecting our commitment to investing in people and creating opportunities to succeed.
  
  
**Job Title:** Catering & Events Coordinator
  
**Department:** Catering & Events
  
**Location:** San Francisco Zoo & Gardens, Onsite
  
**Reports to:** General Manager, Assistant General Manager, (Sr). Director of Catering Operations, (Sr.) Director Catering/Event Sales, (Sr.) Manager of Catering Operations, or (Sr.) Manger Catering/Event Sales
  
**Revenue Responsibility:** $50,000+
  
WHO ARE WE
  
For more than 50 years, SSA has partnered with cultural attractions to design the hospitality experience journey, freeing our partners to remain mission-focused.
  
We bring together admissions, culinary, and retail with innovation and human connection to shape a seamless guest journey.
  
Our focus is on people, innovation, and operational intelligence as a means to create special moments with lasting impact. We call it 452 Hospitality, the foundation of how we serve our partners and their communities.
  
JOB SUMMARY
  
The Catering & Events Coordinator is responsible for driving catering sales and ensuring the seamless execution of events. This hybrid role requires an individual with fundamental knowledge of both sales strategies and event logistics. This position requires a dynamic individual with communication, negotiation, and organizational skills, dedicated to delivering exceptional client experiences.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
Job Requirements
  

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills across all levels of an organization.
* Fundamental leadership skills with an understanding of the importance of team building/development, while fostering partnerships.
* Exceptional problem solving/decision making skills combined with the ability to be organized.
* Demonstrates financial management, analytical, and planning skills.
* Demonstrates the ability to remain flexible in a fast-paced environment.
* Computer knowledge and skill level for basic office functions.
* Physical ability to stand for extended periods and to move and handle boxes (35lbs) as necessary to operation, which entails lifting, and perform all functions as set forth above.
* Ability to work varied hours/days, including nights, weekends and holidays, as needed.

Previous Experience
  

* No prior experience is required, however knowledge of catering sales, operations and/or event planning management in off-site catering, hotel or cultural attraction catering venue preferred.
* Although no prior work experience is required for this position, candidates with one (1) or more years of experience will be given stronger consideration.
* Working knowledge of Tripleseat is a plus.
* All education backgrounds eligible, must be 18 or older.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Catering Sales Strategies
  

* Secure signed agreements and create BEOs for assigned incoming leads and bookings.
* Where applicable, accompany venue sales team or catering operations team, on site tours for prospective clients.
* Implement designated strategies to sell, and upsell, catering services to new and returning clients.
* Respond to client requests promptly and ensure client satisfaction.
* Serve as onsite contact for events sold by the Area Sales Manager.

Event Planning & Execution
  

* Implement plans for catering events, including event orders, pull sheets, execution timelines, staffing schedules, visual appeal and logistics layouts.
* Oversee the setup, execution, and breakdown of assigned events, ensuring all aspects run smoothly and efficiently.
* Ensure all equipment, supplies, and materials are available and in good working condition for events.
* Walk event spaces with Venue Sales Team before events to ensure everything is in working order and address any issues promptly.
* Communicate and collaborate effectively with the Area Sales Team, Culinary Team, and other departments, including location partners, involved in events, implementing new strategies and procedures where necessary to ensure events are executed flawlessly. Including, but not limited to:
* Lead weekly BEO meetings to review all upcoming events, addressing concerns and needs to each event.
* Distribute Operations Plan revisions to key stakeholders when necessary.
* Advise Area Sales Manager on any outstanding balances due post event.
* Collaborate with Sales Team on floor plans and event flow.
* Coordinate the need for cross-utilized products/equipment.
* Create eye-catching and innovative F&B displays in collaboration with the Culinary Team.
* Oversee quality, product levels, and inventory of Catering products.
* Facilitate the maintenance and repairs of Catering equipment as necessary.

Client Relationship Management
  

* Prepare and manage Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), diagrams, and other necessary documents.
* Maintain strong, positive relationships with internal and external clients to encourage repeat business.
* Proactively and transparently communicate with clients throughout the sales and detailing process.
* Work closely with clients to understand their needs, provide tailored solutions and address any concerns promptly.
* Conduct pre-event meetings with internal stakeholders to finalize details and post-event follow-ups to gather feedback and foster continued development.
* Conduct post-event follow-ups to engage clients and foster continued development.
* Collaborate with Area Sales team to understand event and client needs.
* Participate in client transitions for seamless execution.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
The world needs 3 TW of new solar capacity every year. The legacy approach of developing and building infrastructure is mathematically incapable of catching up.

Planted is the autonomous power deployment company. We transform power plants from bespoke construction projects into manufactured products. By integrating planning software, high-density arrays, energy storage, and field robots, we deliver more power where it's needed most.

The physics are solved; what remains is relentless execution. Led by repeat founders and an engineering core from SpaceX and Tesla, we are backed by Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Piva Capital, Google, Gigascale Capital, Khosla Ventures, and RA Capital Management.

We’re scaling fast and looking for operators and engineers who want to own real pieces of the system. You don't need a traditional energy background; we care whether you can finish hard things. Come build with us.

**About The Role**
------------------

We are looking for an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to support our workplace, people, and administrative operations. Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will serve as the first point of contact for our Oakland headquarters, maintain smooth day-to-day office and workplace operations, champion a positive and inclusive team experience, and support hiring and onboarding for our growing team. This is an in-person role at our Oakland headquarters. It is ideal for someone eager to learn startup operations, wear multiple hats, and support our team in delivering impactful climate solutions faster.

The salary range for this full-time position is $70,000 - $90,000 plus stock options and benefits. Pay within the range is based on candidate experience, job-specific skills, education, and work location. The target experience for the position is 1-3+ years in administrative support, office coordination, or startup operations.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Office & Workplace Operations

* Serve as the primary point of contact for general office requests and inquiries, incoming calls, and facilities issues; route or escalate to the Operations Manager as needed.
* Own office and kitchen supplies, snacks, and amenities, including tracking inventory, placing orders, and receiving deliveries; organize and track lunch deliveries.
* Manage office services, such as janitorial service and coordination with property management regarding established services.
* Maintain organized physical and digital filing systems for facilities, office documentation, and vendor records.
* Support logistics for office reconfigurations and expansions and workplace safety initiatives.

Administrative Support

* Assist with purchasing for team members and tracking receipts.
* Maintain NDA log, including visitor NDAs.
* Issue Certificates of Insurance (COI) to vendors and customers as requested.

People Operations & Hiring Support

* Support recruiting and hiring efforts by scheduling interviews and coordinating travel arrangements for candidates.
* Prepare and route offer letters through DocuSign for new hires in coordination with CEO and Head of Finance.
* Complete employee onboarding and offboarding tasks and own onboarding experience to ensure a welcoming experience for all new hires.
* Organize team events, offsites, meet-ups, and branded company gifts to promote a cohesive company culture.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 1+ years of experience in administrative support, office coordination, people operations, or equivalent operations coordination.
* Demonstrated track record of organization, extreme attention to detail, project management, and ability to execute independently.
* Positive, can-do attitude with a bias towards action, hands-on aptitude, and resourcefulness.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills across internal and external channels.
* Tech-savvy and adept with tools like Google Workspace, Confluence, Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), and accounting software like QuickBooks.
* Desire to be full-time in person at our Oakland headquarters.
* High integrity with a passion for building inclusive candidate and employee experiences.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Professional experience preferably in a startup or fast-paced environment.
* Experience with streamlining operational processes with tools such as Google Apps Script and Claude AI.

* A note on qualifications: Many people only apply for jobs if they believe they can perform every task in the job description. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job and will consider equivalent combinations of knowledge, skills, education, and experience to meet minimum qualifications. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role.

**PHYSICAL AND SENSORY REQUIREMENTS**

* A combination of desk work and light physical activity to facilitate shipping, receiving, inventory, and office management.
* Ability to lift 40 lbs.

**Philosophy On Qualifications And Compensation**
-------------------------------------------------

Many people only apply for jobs if they believe they can perform every task in the job description. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job and will consider equivalent combinations of knowledge, skills, education, and experience. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role.

Additionally, we believe compensation should reflect the value people bring and give them a real stake in what we're building. Our total compensation package includes a base salary, meaningful equity through stock options, and benefits including company holidays, paid time off (PTO), and in-office lunches. Individual pay may vary within the posted range and is determined by a number of factors including relevant experience, skills, and location.

**How We Work**

jobs.title: Care Coordination & Office Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About TLC Nurse Solutions**

TLC Nurse Solutions is a women-owned California nurse registry thoughtfully coordinating experienced independent Registered Nurses (RNs) and Licensed Vocational Nurses (LVNs) with private-pay clients and healthcare partners throughout California.

Our Care Coordination & Office Operations Team is at the heart of that work. We coordinate referrals, schedules, communication, documentation, credentialing, and billing support while helping clients, nurses, and healthcare partners feel informed and well supported.

**About the Position**

This is a hands-on role within a collaborative, growing small business. Priorities can shift throughout the day as new referrals arrive, schedules change, or a client or nurse needs timely assistance. The right person enjoys bringing calm and organization to a responsive environment, takes genuine ownership of their work, and follows important details through to completion.

Every team member is cross-trained in TLC's core operations so we can support one another, provide dependable coverage, and continue improving how we work.

**What You Will Do**

· Coordinate new and ongoing nursing referrals, schedules, and coverage needs.

· Communicate professionally and compassionately with clients, families, independent nurses, specialty pharmacies, physicians, healthcare facilities, case managers, discharge planners, and other referral partners.

· Respond to phone calls, emails, text messages, and faxes in a timely and organized manner.

· Manage schedule changes, cancellations, urgent coverage requests, and other time-sensitive needs.

· Review nursing documentation for completeness and process it promptly.

· Assist with client invoicing, contractor invoice processing, and related follow-up.

· Maintain accurate scheduling, credentialing, compliance, and operational records.

· Follow written Standard Operating Procedures while helping identify practical workflow improvements.

· Support teammates and participate in shared evening, weekend, and holiday on-call coverage.

**Who Thrives Here**

People who thrive at TLC care about doing things well, helping others, and contributing to the organization as a whole. They tend to:

· Take ownership, show initiative, and follow responsibilities through to completion.

· Stay organized, responsive, and attentive to details while managing multiple priorities.

· Enjoy figuring things out, connecting the pieces, and learning how different parts of the work fit together.

· Communicate clearly, warmly, kindly, and proactively with clients, nurses, healthcare partners, and teammates.

· Remain calm, thoughtful, and solution-focused when circumstances change or something unexpected comes up.

· Use sound judgment, make confident routine decisions, and ask thoughtful questions when collaboration is helpful.

· Notice what needs attention and help move it forward rather than waiting for every next step to be assigned.

· Take pride in becoming knowledgeable, capable, and dependable in their work.

· Bring a positive, helpful attitude and genuinely enjoy contributing to a collaborative team.

· Value teamwork, flexibility, accountability, continuous learning, and exceptional client service.

**Qualifications**

· **Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) preferred.**

· Strong organizational, written communication, and verbal communication skills.

· Comfort managing multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.

· Ability to work independently and contribute to a close, collaborative team.

· Comfort learning scheduling, credentialing, documentation, communication, and office systems.

· Healthcare administration, care coordination, scheduling, office operations, or customer service experience is helpful.

Healthcare experience is valuable, and we place equal importance on judgment, emotional intelligence, professionalism, adaptability, curiosity, and a genuine sense of responsibility.

**Schedule, Compensation & Benefits**

· Full-time position starting at $33-$35 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.

· Flexible scheduling with a thoughtful combination of office and remote work when appropriate.

· Shared evening, weekend, and holiday on-call support; working hours may be adjusted to help maintain balance and keep schedules within 40 hours per week.

· Health insurance benefits and retirement savings plan.

· Structured training, written SOPs, cross-training, and opportunities to take on greater responsibility as TLC grows.

**Apply**

We would be happy to meet dependable, thoughtful candidates who enjoy helping others and want to grow with TLC. Above all, client care comes first in everything we do.

Pay: $33.00 - $35.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Application Question(s):

* Do you currently hold an active California LVN license?
* Are you available to participate in shared evening, weekend, and holiday on-call coverage, with working hours adjusted to help keep your schedule within 40 hours per week?
* Please briefly describe your experience with care coordination, healthcare scheduling, credentialing, documentation review, billing support, or other medical office operations.

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Founded in 1971, Delta is a global leader in power electronics and energy-efficient solutions, delivering advanced switching power supplies, thermal management systems, and critical infrastructure technologies.

With operations across five continents and nearly 200 global locations, Delta supports industries including data center infrastructure, industrial automation, telecom power, renewable energy, and EV charging.

Guided by our mission — *“To provide innovative, clean, and energy-efficient solutions for a better tomorrow”* — Delta combines engineering excellence with a strong commitment to sustainability and long-term value creation.

**Position Overview**

**Location: Open**

**Compensation:** $130K - $155K (commensurate on experience)

**Bonus:** Eligible

**Travel:** Up to 50%

**Work Authorization:** This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Delta Electronics is seeking a motivated and growth-oriented **Account Manager** to support strategic customer initiatives within the Verizon account environment. This role is designed as a development opportunity, partnering closely with senior leadership and an established account leader with deep Verizon customer relationships and industry expertise.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career sales professional, MBA graduate, inside sales representative, or customer-facing business professional looking to transition into enterprise account management and outside sales. The organization is open to developing high-potential talent with strong communication skills, business acumen, professionalism, and the desire to learn the telecommunications and infrastructure industry.

The ideal candidate is polished, highly driven, relationship-oriented, and eager to grow within a customer-facing commercial environment.

  
Key Responsibilities:

* Support account management activities for strategic Verizon customer initiatives and programs.
* Partner closely with senior account leadership to learn customer operations, relationship management, and sales strategy execution within the Verizon ecosystem.
* Lead project management initiatives including; customer communications, internal coordination, reporting, account updates, and follow-up activities.
* Identify opportunities to support revenue growth, customer engagement, and operational alignment.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with internal Sales, Operations, Program Management, Supply Chain, and Customer Support teams.
* Participate in customer meetings, business reviews, and onsite engagement activities as needed.
* Develop a strong understanding of telecommunications, infrastructure, connectivity, and customer solution environments.
* Support pipeline tracking, CRM updates, forecasting activities, and account documentation.
* Travel up to 50% to support customer engagement activities.

Minimum Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s Degree required; MBA strongly preferred.
* Approximately 8+ years of professional experience within sales, business development, inside sales, account coordination, customer operations, or related commercial environments.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with polished professional presence.
* Highly motivated, coachable, and eager to learn within a fast-paced business environment.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Comfortable traveling up to 50% as business needs require.

  
Pay Range: USD $130,000.00 - USD $155,000.00 /Yr. Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience selling to the Telecom or Cable Operators.
* Experience supporting telecommunications, technology, infrastructure, manufacturing, or enterprise customer environments.
* Previous exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce.
* Exposure to telecommunications industry experience.

Benefit at Delta Electronics Americas:

Delta Electronics offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well-being. Employees can choose from multiple medical plan options, including employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts, along with dental and vision coverage. Delta also provides a competitive 401(k) plan with company match, life and disability insurance, and a range of voluntary benefits. Additional resources such as flexible spending accounts, mental health support, and an Employee Assistance Program are available to help employees and their families thrive both personally and professionally.

Life at Delta

EEO Statement:

*Delta Electronics Americas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Delta Electronics America is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*

Benefits include health coverage, wellness resources, retirement savings plan, paid time off, and other company‑sponsored programs; parental leave is provided in accordance with applicable law.*

**Meet Vestis®:** For the People Who Make It All Work
  
At Vestis®, we provide uniforms, workplace supplies, and professional cleaning that help businesses simplify their workday and keep their teams safe, confident, and focused on what matters most. More than a provider, we are a partner in productivity, trusted to keep you running.
  
Join us and build a career supporting the people who make it all work.
  
  
**Job Overview:**  
The Account Manager (AM) focuses on identifying and developing new product opportunities within the existing customer base. This role involves prospecting, presenting programs, and meeting sales quotas.
  
  
**Responsibilities/Essential Functions:**  

* The AM is expected to penetrate the current customer base and generate revenue through additional category adds – Uniforms, Workplace Supplies, Managed Restroom Services, First Aid and Direct Sales.
* The AM will also focus on securing contract renewals.
* Key responsibilities include documenting customer information, maintaining sales reports, and communicating product details to the service department.
* The AM is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with customers to drive sales and identify new opportunities.
* Drive a systematic sampling program that leads to proposal generation.
* As a direct report to the Sales Manager, this position will collaborate with the Sales and Operations teams to sell into the current customer base.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**  

* Must be customer oriented and able to communicate effectively
* Ability to provide a high quality service within a fast-paced and physically challenging environment
* Goal driven and self-motivated to include problem solving skills
* Knowledgeable in Microsoft Office applications (including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Internet/Intranet)

**Experience/Qualifications:**  

* High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor’s/Associates Degree preferred
* Prior experience in Route Sales and/or Business to Business (B2B) sales preferred

* Valid Driver's License required

Safely lift and carry up to 30 lbs consistently

**About Us:**

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

**How We Work:**

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values:

**Bold** in how we dream and innovate

**Responsive** to feedback, challenges and opportunities

**Accountable** for results and best in class outcomes

**Visionary** in future focused problem-solving

**Exceptional** in execution and impact

We seek an experienced Account Manager to join our growing Commercial Add-On team based out of our Sunnyvale office. In this role you will focus on expanding our product footprint with our existing customer base. By joining our already successful team, you will be an instrumental part of our consistent year over year revenue growth!

Your day-to-day

* This is a Hybrid role requiring you to be in the Sunnyvale office 4 days a week. Monday-Thursday.
* The Account Manager will be responsible for working with our existing customers in a consultative manner to identify additional solutions from the Proofpoint portfolio
* Drive the entire sales process from start to finish including opportunity identification, introductory meetings, product demonstration, customer Q&A, as well as negotiation and closing
* Develop, customize, and utilize effective close plans to navigate and manage the sales process
* Team up with our world class Sales Engineering team to devise and execute account strategies and plans

• Engage with our rapidly expanding channel partner network to educate, inform, and drive incremental revenue • Interact with the management team in 1-1, team meetings and via forecasting and reporting to provide critical updates, and strategic account planning

* Provide outstanding and high touch customer service, including escalation and coordination of support issues as needed
* Become a perpetual student of Proofpoint products, and the ever-changing Cybersecurity industry!
* You can achieve your quota, but quite frankly we would love you to blow it out of the water!
* May require modified work hours to cover accounts in other time zones, and occasional travel for key accounts What you bring to the team
* Minimum 3 years of solution sales experience, focused on generating net new or add-on revenue
* Must have experience selling to the C-suite, extensive experience selling to CISO, CIO, CTO preferred
* Consistent track record of meeting and/or exceeding quota goals
* Experience managing longer sales cycles (2-6 months) from prospecting stage through negotiation and closing
* Experience or training in established sales methodologies such as SPIN, Sandler, Miller Heiman, Value Selling or The Challenger Sale is preferred
* Competitive nature, operating within a team environment
* Ability to present and discuss highly technical information, as well as aptitude to learn new concepts quickly
* Strong presentation skills, both in person and via phone/online
* Security or SaaS sales experience a plus
* Capable of providing great customer care while continuing to identify new revenue opportunities
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

#LI-JD1

**Why Proofpoint?**

At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us:

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits
* Career success on your terms
* Flexible work environment
* Annual wellness and community outreach days
* Always on recognition for your contributions
* Global collaboration and networking opportunities

**Our Culture:**

Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success-every day, for everyone.

We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com.
