jobs.title: Sales and Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

As a Sales & Account Manager, you will primarily support the Company's sales and business development efforts, with secondary responsibility for account coordination and operational support. This is a hybrid role focused primarily on identifying and closing new commercial cleaning accounts, developing client relationships, and supporting the transition of new accounts into operations. You will be expected to follow all Company policies, procedures, safety requirements, client-site requirements, and applicable laws.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following:

**Sales & Business Development (70%)**

* Identify and develop new commercial cleaning business opportunities.
* Prospect for potential commercial customers through calls, emails, networking, referrals, and other approved methods.
* Research and identify potential customers and decision-makers.
* Schedule and participate in prospect meetings, client meetings, and property walkthroughs.
* Understand prospective customers' cleaning needs and coordinate appropriate service proposals.
* Prepare and present proposals and service quotations in accordance with Company pricing and approval requirements.
* Follow up with prospective customers throughout the sales process.
* Maintain an organized and up-to-date sales pipeline.
* Coordinate the sales process from initial prospect contact through contract execution.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with prospective and existing customers.
* Work toward established Company sales goals and new-account targets.
* Maintain accurate records of prospects, proposals, customer communications, and sales activities.

**Account & Operations Support (30%)**

* Assist with onboarding new commercial cleaning accounts.
* Coordinate with the operations team to support successful transitions of newly acquired accounts.
* Assist with customer communications and follow-up regarding service needs.
* Support management with account information, supplies coordination, scheduling coordination, and other operational matters as assigned.
* Assist in maintaining accurate customer and account records.
* Provide other reasonable administrative and operational support as assigned by management.

**Compensation:**

**Base Pay + Commission — Base compensation will be determined based on experience and qualifications.**

This position offers a base compensation package with commission opportunities tied to sales performance and new business development.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Rafael, CA 94903

jobs.title: Internal Account Manager (INS852)
jobs.description:
We're looking for an **Internal Account Manager** to own client relationships at Hire Overseas, a fast-moving offshore staffing and HR platform placing vetted global talent into U.S. companies. You will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of clients, keeping placements on track, resolving issues before they escalate, and ensuring clients stay engaged and satisfied long after the initial hire.

This is a small business. There is no large team behind you and no playbook for every situation. You will have a high degree of ownership and autonomy, which means you make real decisions, handle real problems, and have a direct impact on whether clients stay and grow. If you are a confident communicator who takes ownership instinctively, moves fast when something needs attention, and wants a role where your judgment actually matters, this role is a strong fit.

**Why You'll Want to Join**

* **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive
* This role requires availability during **US business hours**
* Work directly with founders at a growing offshore staffing company with real traction and a strong client base
* High-ownership role with full autonomy over how you manage and grow your client portfolio

**What You'll Work On**

**Client Relationship Management**

* Own a portfolio of client accounts as the primary point of contact from placement through ongoing engagement
* Build strong, trust-based relationships that make clients feel supported and well-served
* Conduct regular check-ins and proactively surface any issues, risks, or opportunities before they become problems
* Keep clients informed, engaged, and confident in their placements without waiting for them to reach out first

**Issue Resolution and Escalation**

* Handle client concerns quickly and professionally, taking ownership of resolution rather than routing everything to someone else
* Identify patterns in client feedback and flag systemic issues to leadership with recommended fixes
* Coordinate internally across recruiting, operations, and leadership to resolve complex client situations
* Make judgment calls on when to escalate and when to handle directly

**Retention and Growth**

* Drive client retention by delivering a consistently high-quality account management experience
* Identify opportunities to expand relationships including additional placements, new roles, or expanded scope
* Track account health and flag at-risk clients early with a clear plan of action

**Reporting and Communication**

* Maintain accurate and current records of all client interactions, account status, and open items
* Provide regular internal updates on portfolio health, client sentiment, and key risks
* Communicate clearly and professionally in writing and on calls across all client and internal interactions

**What You Bring**

* Proven experience in account management, client success, or a similar client-facing role in a B2B environment
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills with a professional and responsive style
* High ownership mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes rather than passing problems up or sideways
* Comfortable operating with autonomy in a small business environment where processes are still being built and the answers are not always obvious
* Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously without losing track of anything
* Proactive and fast-moving with a bias toward action over deliberation when clients need support

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in staffing, recruiting, HR services, or workforce management
* Background working at a small business, startup, or founder-led company
* Familiarity with offshore or global hiring and the dynamics of remote contractor placements
* Experience with CRM tools for tracking client interactions and account health

**How to Apply**

Please include:

* Your **updated resume**
* A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your account management or client success experience, and walking through how you handle a situation where a client is unhappy and you have to resolve it without escalating to leadership

**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**

If you want full ownership over a client portfolio at a fast-moving company where your decisions actually matter and your impact is directly visible, this role gives you the autonomy and the scope to do your best work.

**Application Process Overview**

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

* **Initial Application** - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
* **Video Introduction** - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
* **Role-Specific Assessment** - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
* **Recruitment Interview** - Initial screening with our talent team
* **Executive Interview** - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
* **Client Interview** - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
* **Background & Reference Check** - Professional reference verification
* **Job Offer** - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.title: Major Account Manager, Northern California
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.

Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.

This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.

We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.

What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.

If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.

 **Job Description**

What We Are Looking For

Check Point is looking for a high-impact Major Account Manager ready to win new strategic logos and unlock growth across a focused portfolio of approximately 20 existing customers and prospects. In this role, you will shape bold, multi-year account strategies, lead complex deals with senior decision-makers, and bring together a virtual account team to deliver meaningful outcomes for customers in a channel-friendly environment. This is an opportunity to own a critical territory, build trusted executive relationships, and help some of the world’s leading organizations stay secure as they accelerate their digital and AI transformation.

Key Responsibilities

* Drive new, expansion and renewal opportunities across all accounts
* Acquire new strategic logos while farming and expanding existing accounts
* Build executive relationships and secure senior-level access
* Develop and execute major account plans with multi-year view
* Lead complex, multi-stakeholder deal orchestration
* Lead contract and pricing negotiations
* Prioritize effectively across a large book of business
* Use Check Point tools to manage accounts, pipelines and forecast
* Coordinate a virtual account team (specialists, SE, etc)

 **Qualifications**

What You'll Need to Succeed

* 5+ years of B2B sales experience (2+ years in cyber security)
* Proven hunter-farmer mindset: able to open new doors, land strategic logos, and expand existing accounts.
* Consistent overperformance, including 110%+ net revenue retention and meaningful multi-product growth.
* Experience navigating complex enterprise accounts and influencing buying committees of 5–10+ stakeholders.
* Strong executive presence, with the ability to build trust, multi-thread relationships, and create senior-level access.
* Sharp operator with disciplined account planning, accurate forecasting, and strong cross-functional orchestration.
* Channel-savvy seller with industry relationships that can accelerate momentum.

Equal Opportunity

Check Point Software Technologies is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

* Must be eligible to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

**EOE M/F/Veterans/Disabled**

The wage range for this position takes into consideration a variety of factors in determining your pay. We'll consider your location, experience, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The wage disclosure has not been adjusted for applicable geographic differentials associated with the location at which this position may be filled. A reasonable estimate of the current base wage range for this role is $140,000 - $165,000. In addition to the base compensation, certain roles are eligible for additional compensation, including an annual bonus or sales incentive based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee’s role. These awards are allocated based on individual performance. Benefits/perks listed here may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Check Point Software Technologies and the country/state where you work. US-based employees gain access to healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan and company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, stock awards and an employee stock purchasing plan.

 **Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
TIMEPROOFUSA was founded by some of the home remodeling industry's most respected leaders. We have quickly become America's fastest-growing home improvement company—providing premium **roofing, bathroom remodeling, and siding solutions** to homeowners across the country. Our rapid growth is driven by one mission: to deliver uncompromising quality, dependable service, and lasting peace of mind to every customer we serve.

As an Outside Sales Representative, you'll run pre-set, qualified appointments, educate homeowners on our roofing, bathroom remodeling, or siding solutions and close projects in-home.

**$4,000 SIGN-ON BONUS**

**What You'll Do**

* Run pre-set, qualified appointments with homeowners—no cold calling or lead generation required.
* Conduct professional in-home design consultations, design custom showers using proprietary rendering software, provide same-day estimates, and execute a one-sit close.
* Partner with your Sales Manager and team for ongoing coaching, joint appointments, weekly meetings, and skill development.

**What's In It for You**

* 100% commission W-2 role with uncapped earnings + monthly bonuses.
* On target earnings between $150K–$320K+ annually.
* Pre-set qualified leads—focus on closing, not prospecting.
* 4 weeks paid training at $1,000/week, plus earn full commission — not a draw.
* Full benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k).
* $4,000 Sign-On Bonus.
* Monthly car allowance
* Cell phone allowance & company provided iPad

**What It Takes To Succeed**

* Resilience and ability to handle rejection without being discouraged.
* Ability to drive 100 miles a day on average.
* Availability to work evenings and weekends.
* Comfortable working in a commission-based role.
* Technological proficiency in using an iPad.
* Submit to a background screening.
* Valid driver's license and vehicle insurance.

**More About TIMEPROOFUSA**

TIMEPROOFUSA is redefining the future of roofing. With fire-safe materials, sustainable technology, and a leadership team backed by decades of success in home remodeling, we're building smarter, safer homes that stand the test of time.

Our core values—People First, Innovation, Customer Obsession, Integrity & Craftsmanship, and Profit Fuels Our Future—aren't just words on a wall. They drive how we build, lead, and win together.

If you're the kind of person who thrives on challenge, takes pride in excellence, and wants to be part of a team that's changing the industry, this is your moment.

Apply today, take the next step in your career, and let's build something extraordinary together.

jobs.title: Global Workplace Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

The Workplace Experience team powers and connects the workday for all Perplexity employees across our global offices.

We are hospitality and experience-driven at the core. We are made up of People people, meaning that we love supporting each other and all of the People in our workplace. We take on the good and the bad with optimism and with a positive, kind approach to solving problems, dealing with the obstacles handed to us, and proactively creating good around us. We think about each moment through the lens of our colleagues (our customers) so that we can create thoughtful and memorable experiences no matter what task we have at hand.

As our Global Workplace Business Operations Lead, you will manage the business operations and cross-functional program delivery that enable our global Workplace Experience team to scale. In collaboration with the Head of Workplace Experience, you will set the operating framework for your areas, make decisions within agreed priorities and approval limits, and remain hands-on in delivering results. You will own the effectiveness of portfolio operating processes and internal project delivery.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Own the Workplace operating framework:** Lead annual and quarterly planning for your areas, translate team strategy into priorities and resource plans, and establish clear decision rights, delivery commitments and measures of success. Resolve sequencing and capacity trade-offs within agreed parameters and recommend when to add people, vendors or technology.
* **Lead internal capital-project delivery:** Take accountability for integrated delivery plans across office openings, refreshes and other capital initiatives. Direct the work of external PMs within agreed scopes, align internal workstreams, resolve delivery issues and hold partners accountable for schedule, cost, quality and operational readiness.
* **Own portfolio controls and insight:** Establish dependable lease administration, obligation tracking, space and occupancy information, and portfolio reporting. Set data and control standards, ensure actions have owners, and turn trends and risks into recommendations before deadlines or capacity constraints become problems.
* **Drive financial planning and performance:** Own the processes and quality of operating and capital forecasts, commitments, actuals and variance analysis in partnership with Finance. Challenge assumptions, recommend corrective actions and investment trade-offs, and give the Head of Workplace Experience a reliable basis for budget and commitment decisions.
* **Set the systems and reporting roadmap:** Own business requirements, governance and improvement priorities for workplace tools such as Envoy. Establish useful performance measures, improve data quality, and automate repeatable work while maintaining appropriate controls and keeping processes practical for the team.
* **Lead EHS program governance:** Establish a risk-based plan, clear responsibilities and a review cadence with qualified vendors and internal teams. Drive follow-through on assessed obligations and remediation across offices and remote populations, maintain evidence of completion, and escalate material risks without substituting for specialist advice.
* **Set standards for delivery and handover:** Own the development and use of project playbooks, planning processes and operational-readiness criteria. Bring together design standards and occupancy requirements, and ensure completed projects transfer to local operations with the documentation, training, vendor arrangements and issue ownership needed to run well.
* **Serve as a senior operating partner:** Lead cross-functional operating and project reviews, surface decisions with clear recommendations, and represent your areas with internal and external partners. Drive resolution within your authority, escalate material changes with options, and build accountability without adding unnecessary layers.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* **Senior functional leadership:** 8+ years in workplace business operations, corporate real estate, facilities programs or a closely related field, with increasing responsibility for complex, multi-site programs and their outcomes. You have operated with substantial autonomy, not only administered plans set by others.
* **Project and program management expertise:** You are a project manager at the core. You are quick and agile, but methodical when it comes to planning for, organizing, tracking, and executing on a project in a way that keeps everything and everyone aligned and on task.
* **Relevant delivery depth:** You have a record of delivering office buildouts, relocations or capital improvements as an internal owner, with accountability for scope, financial performance, schedules, change control and external delivery partners.
* **Strong financial and analytical judgment:** You have experience driving forecasting and reporting processes, challenging assumptions and translating portfolio data into resource or investment recommendations; strong spreadsheet and analytical skills.
* **Experience building an operating framework:** You have established planning, governance, performance measures and systems that helped a growing function deliver more predictably. You know when structure improves execution and when it becomes unnecessary process.
* **Leadership across organizational boundaries:** You can secure commitments, challenge constructively and resolve competing priorities across teams and vendors. You communicate risks and recommendations credibly to senior leaders and know which decisions to make independently and which to escalate.
* **Hands-on ownership and sound judgment:** You can move between portfolio-level trade-offs and project details, deliver through others without losing accountability, handle sensitive information responsibly, and maintain a kind, service-oriented approach under pressure.

jobs.title: Assistant Community Manager
jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Asset Living is a third-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

  

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

**ASSISTANT COMMUNITY MANAGER**

The Assistant Community Manager is responsible for overseeing, under the supervision of the Community Manager, the everyday operations and financial functions of the housing community. As the Assistant Community Manager, you will play a vital role in the delinquency and collection of rent to optimize the property's cash flow and financial position. As an Assistant Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration & risk management in the absence of the Community Manager. As an onsite leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with the company's policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

Financial Management

* Responsible for posting all payments and income received from all applicants, current residents, and non-current residents accurately, timely, and efficiently.
* Responsible for processing and reconciling daily all account receivables.
* Monitor and follow up on bad debt to include preparation of late notices, resident and guarantor contact, and filing evictions.
* Responsible for helping the property meet budgeted revenues, expenses, and Net Operating Income.
* Responsible for posting of all charges to resident and non-current resident accounts; to also include bill back of utilities where applicable.
* Responsible for all end-of-the-month closing procedures and reporting.
* Maintain accurate and organized records; audit resident files to ensure accurate records.
* Responsible for walking units and posting all move-out charges, statements, and security deposit refunds.

Personnel Management

* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques & company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop onsite staff.
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership.
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures.
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Implement marketing strategies & systems put in place by the annual marketing plan.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction.
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents.

Administrative Management

* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Assist with supervision of all business functions related to operations.
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)

**Education/Experience**

* High School Diploma or Equivalent; Bachelor’s degree preferred or two years experience in the housing industry; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Ability to understand and perform all onsite software functions; basic computer skills required.
* Must have basic knowledge of Fair Housing Laws and OSHA requirements.

jobs.description:
ADP is hiring a **Sales Representative, Small Business Services.**

* *Are you ready to build a rewarding future? Uncapped commissions, lavish incentive trips, and career advancement are some of the ways.*
* *Do you want to join a Fortune 250 company with industry-leading sales training and the latest sales technology to help you achieve success**?*
* *Are you looking to join a fast-paced, inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?*

If so, this may be the opportunity you've been searching for. Read on and decide for yourself.

In this role, you will work within a defined geographic territory that targets clients and prospects with 1-49 employees. You will identify and sign new clients for payroll, tax, human resources, benefits, and more and sell additional solutions to existing clients. Daily, you will cultivate relationships, set appointments, gather leads from established business partners, assess client or prospect needs to present the best ADP solutions, and spend your time in the field closing business. Don't worry if you have no prior sales experience; we are known for our high-quality sales training and will teach you how to use the latest sales technology to set you up for success.

Integrity, resilience, positivity, and a refuse to lose attitude are must-haves in this job. As with any role in sales, you will experience ebbs and flows. However, challenges should ignite your determination and invigorate you to thrive, not weigh you down. In return, you'll be rewarded with uncapped commissions, incentive trips, and opportunities to advance your career in a fun and friendly environment - all while gaining serious credibility as part of an industry-leading sales team in a stable and highly respected tech company.

Ready to #MakeYourMark? **Apply now!**

**To learn more about Sales at ADP**, watch here: http://adp.careers/Sales\_Videos

**What you'll do:** *Responsibilities*

* **Grow Our Business While Growing Yours.** You will work independently and collaboratively as part of various teams within your assigned geography to close sales, win business, and reach sales goals.
* **Turn Prospects into Loyal Clients and Raving Fans.** You will implement a sales strategy targeted to decision-makers and business owners to build a network and capture new business.
* **Deepen** **Relationships Across the ADP Family.** In addition to selling cloud-based human resources solutions, you will strategically cultivate additional business within existing accounts. But it's not all business; you will make life-long friendships here.
* **Collaborate** **Daily.** You will serve as a trusted advisor, partner, and ADP ambassador to your clients, internal partners, and overall network while demonstrating grace under pressure and the highest ethical standards.

**TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE****:** *Required Qualifications*

* **Positive Self-Starter****.** You have an upbeat, persistent style and the ability to cold call without fear of rejection, manage your time well, and can present your ideas in a clear professional manner on paper, in-person, and over the phone.
* **Agile Solution Seeker****.** You're a problem solver who can find an answer, or a solution, even in times of fast-paced change.
* **Continuous Learner****.** You're always learning, growing, and questioning how things were done in the past to make them even better.

A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include:

* One to two years of prior work experience or internships in Retail, Marketing, Business Development, Food Service, Insurance Sales, or another relevant industry, OR
* Military experience We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.

**Bonus points for these:** *Preferred Qualifications*

* Prior quota-carrying experience
* Ability to successfully build a network and effectively use social media for sales

**YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:**

* **Be yourself** in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
* **Belong** by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
* **Grow your career** in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
* **Continuously learn** through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities.
* **Be your healthiest.** Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
* **Balance work and life.** Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
* **Focus on your mental health and well-being.** We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
* **Join a company committed to giving back** and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
* **Get paid to pay it forward.** Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.

What are you waiting for? **Apply today!**

**#LI-AB1**

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Us:** Checkbook is a leading FinTech company revolutionizing the way businesses send and receive digital payments. Our innovative platform enables businesses to send and receive checks securely and instantly without the need for physical checks or any manual intervention. We are dedicated to providing simple, reliable, and cost-effective payment solutions to our clients. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a skilled Business Development Representative to join our dynamic team.

**Role:** As a Business Development Representative at Checkbook, you will play a crucial role in driving our company's growth and expanding our client base. You will be responsible for generating new business opportunities by identifying and reaching out to potential customers. Your primary focus will be on qualifying leads, conducting initial outreach, and nurturing relationships with prospects to move them through the sales pipeline.

**Responsibilities:**

* Identify and research potential clients within the target market.
* Conduct outbound prospecting activities, including cold-calling, emailing, and social selling, to generate new business opportunities.
* Qualify leads and assess their suitability for the company's products and services.
* Understand customer needs and pain points to effectively communicate the value proposition of Checkbook.io's solutions.
* Collaborate closely with the sales team to transition qualified leads into the sales pipeline.
* Manage and maintain accurate records of all interactions and lead progress in HubSpot or other CRM systems.
* Provide timely and regular updates to management on lead generation activities and progress against targets.
* Stay up-to-date with industry trends, competitor offerings, and market changes to identify new business opportunities.
* Attend industry events and networking functions to represent Checkbook.io and build relationships with potential clients.

**Requirements & Skills**:

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Business Development Representative or in a similar sales role.
* Strong understanding of FinTech products, payments, and financial technologies.
* Prior experience using HubSpot or a similar CRM tool is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with prospects and build rapport.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Goal-oriented and results-driven with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Adaptability and a willingness to learn and stay updated on industry trends and product developments.
* A proactive and self-motivated attitude with a passion for driving business growth.

**Who you are:**

* 3+ years of relevant experience, ideally at a B2B startup
* Proven ability to operate in a fast paced environment and adapt to dynamic targets
* Understanding of the BDR / Sales process
* Consistent, methodical, and organized
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Bonus points if you have experience in the payments space**

**Benefits & Perks**

* Insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision, LTD and a variety of other programs)
* 401k
* Equity

**Variable Base + Commission + Equity (based on experience)**

jobs.title: Business Development Associate (Early Career)
jobs.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

**About Futureforce University Recruiting**

Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.

**Job Category**

Sales

**Job Details**

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**Start Date: November 2, 2026**  
*Relocation is not provided for this opportunity.*  
  
**Overview of the Role:**  
As a Business Development Associate at Salesforce, you aren't just starting a career in sales. You are joining the #1 AI CRM to redefine how business is done. This role is a unique hybrid of active sales development and operational excellence. You will serve as the engine of our SMB (Small & Medium Business) team, tasked with both proactively hunting new business through targeted outbound prospecting and leveraging cutting-edge AI tools to streamline workflows. You will be the operational backbone of the team, using data-driven insights to refine our outreach strategies while building the foundational skills to become a world-class Sales Development Representative.
  
  
The Salesforce Business Development Associate Program is a fast-track, high-impact initiative. You will work at the intersection of human creativity and Agentic AI, mastering our Customer 360 platform to identify high-value opportunities, optimize lead flows, and drive scalable growth for our customers.
  
  
**Career Acceleration:** Successful completion of this 3-5 month program positions you to advance to the Sales Development Representative role, equipped with a technical and operational edge that sets you apart in the industry.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* **Pipeline Development:** Qualify inbound and outbound leads via phone outreach to prioritize high-potential SMB opportunities.
* **Strategic Prospecting:** Master the art of the hunt by identifying SMB prospects and executing personalized outreach. You’ll be supported by proven playbooks and tools, with an expectation to provide input on what’s working to help us continuously sharpen our approach.
* **Operations & Process Optimization:** Drive organizational efficiency by maintaining Salesforce data integrity and deploying AI-powered insights to streamline workflows, improve pipeline hygiene, and scale sales productivity.

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

**What we are looking for**

Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all. We’re searching for an Executive Assistant.

**In this role, you will**

* **Manage complex, dynamic calendars:** Plan, coordinate, and safeguard executive schedules, striking the ideal balance between "gatekeeper" and "gateway."
* **Prioritize commitments:** Exercise sound judgment to optimize leaders' time across competing internal and external demands.
* **Oversee end-to-end travel:** Book and manage flights, lodging, and ground transportation; handle last-minute adjustments seamlessly while ensuring compliance with corporate travel policy.
* **Drive meeting efficiency:** Gather agenda topics, participate in leadership-level meetings, and record concise, high-level notes that synthesize key decisions and drive clear task ownership.
* **Ensure thorough follow-through:** Proactively take ownership of post-meeting action items and follow up with cross-functional teams with minimal direction.
* **Prepare communications and materials:** Assist with the development of presentation decks, internal documentation, and executive communications.
* **Optimize candidate scheduling:** Assess necessity, urgency, and interview frequency when coordinating candidate meetings with leaders.
* **Manage expenses:** Prepare and submit executive expense reports; review and approve team expenses to ensure alignment with company policy.
* **Coordinate events and logistics:** Plan and execute team offsites, onsites, and special events.
* **Provide guest hospitality:** Warmly greet and accommodate visitors with a professional and welcoming demeanor.
* **Support onboarding:** Assist with the smooth onboarding of new hires reporting directly to executives.
* **Serve as a strategic liaison:** Act as a trusted partner, facilitator, and central point of contact for leaders, their teams, and the broader organization.
* **Navigate ambiguity and anticipate needs:** Proactively identify team priorities, stay ahead of shifting schedules, and adapt swiftly in a fast-paced environment.
* **Uphold confidentiality and transparency:** Handle sensitive information with utmost discretion while fostering an open, collaborative culture.
* **Drive process improvements:** Identify inefficiencies and introduce new operational workflows when appropriate.
* **Lead special initiatives:** Drive or support key projects for executive leaders and the broader Administration (EA) Department.
* **Foster culture:** Champion team-building initiatives, boost morale, and exemplify core company values.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Calendar Management:** Proven track record of managing complex executive calendars across multiple time zones.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interface confidently with executives and external partners.
* **Attention to Detail:** High precision in document preparation, meeting logistics, and task tracking.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Quick learner with expertise in modern productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Slack, spreadsheet analysis, slide decks).
* **Problem-Solving & Initiative:** Creative problem-solver and proactive self-starter who thrives in high-autonomy environments.
* **Composure Under Pressure:** Ability to remain calm, collaborative, and decisive under tight deadlines or high-stress situations.
* **Strategic Foresight & Judgment:** Strong business acumen, active foresight, and sound decision-making abilities.
* **Professionalism & Discretion:** Exemplary professionalism, executive presence, and utmost discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information.
* **Team Collaboration & Autonomy:** Highly resourceful team player who operates effectively both independently and as part of a distributed team.
* **Project Coordination:** Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional projects and offsite events.
* **Flexibility:** Willingness to provide occasional off-hours support as urgent business needs arise.
* **Travel:** Willingness to travel occasionally for company offsites or team gatherings.

*For roles based in Mountain View, CA:* The salary range for this position is $96,000 - $172,000 per year.

*For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA:* The salary range for this position is $87,000 - $155,000 per year.
  
  
Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits.

At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks.

We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational need

As part of the City's Cycling and Micromobility Network Expansion Program, Traffic Control & Engineering is seeking a City Planner Level III to support the planning, development, and implementation of projects that expand and improve New York City's protected bike lane and micromobility network. jobs.title: Graduate Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Graduate Program Coordinator

**Required Qualifications (as evidenced by an attached resume):**  
Bachelor's Degree (foreign equivalent or higher). Two (2) years of full-time administrative experience in a college or university setting. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace applications.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  
Master's Degree (foreign equivalent or higher). Three (3) or more years of full-time administrative experience working with graduate and/or undergraduate students and faculty in a university setting. Demonstrated experience supporting graduate admissions, student services, or academic program coordination. Familiarity with graduate arts programs, MFA programs, or other graduate-level academic environments. Evidence of tracking progress using multiple data sets and systems with adherence to governing policies. Experience with any of the following campus systems: Slate, PeopleSoft, DegreeWorks, Navigate, SBU Reporting, Concur, Zoom, Modern Campus CMS, Canva. Knowledge of SUNY Graduate School policies and procedures, including GTA contracts and funding packages. Experience supervising Graduate Assistants or Teaching Assistants. Experience managing delegated email inboxes and composing clear, timely responses to student, faculty, and public queries. Experience with website content management systems. Experience with event planning, logistics coordination, or AV/technology support.  
  
**Brief Description of Duties:**  
The Graduate Program Coordinator provides administrative support for three MFA programs in Creative Writing, in Film, and in Television Writing at the Manhattan Center. The Graduate Program Coordinator will coordinate all aspects of graduate admissions and recruiting; support program directors, faculty, and current students; advise and track students through degree completion; and manage on-site events and logistics. The successful candidate will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple programs, and demonstrated comfort with university administrative systems and technology. The position requires methodically managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment with attention to detail. Position requires flexibility in supporting underlying academic programs.

* Graduate Recruitment and Admissions:

  + Assist Admissions Committees and MFA Directors with recruiting and admitting new students to the Manhattan Center and other locations. Work with MFA Directors and Marketing & Communications to place and monitor marketing campaigns, printed materials, social media, and other advertising; report on campaign results.
  + Coordinate recruiting events including open houses, information sessions, and virtual activities. Working with other professionals and multiple systems track submission materials, confirm status with appropriate committees, compile files, and update committees and the Graduate School on new admits, declines, and deferrals.
  + Proactively communicate with applicants, admitted students, students on leave, and deferrals as well as respond to queries. Capture and track data from inquiries, open houses, decision letters, admissions response forms, informational packets, and other communications in compliance with Graduate School guidelines.
  + Track Graduate Assistant lines awarded, Graduate Tuition scholarships, and all other scholarships and awards from offer letters. Serve as the primary liaison between the graduate programs and the Graduate School. Develop expertise in PeopleSoft, and SBU Reporting.
* Graduate Academics:

  + Track and advise current students on their progress through degree requirements in coordination with MFA Directors. Working with other administrative professionals, assist with class scheduling, running scheduling reports, monitoring course enrollment, processing permissions, and other processes within PeopleSoft. Advise students on registration issues, academic policies, leaves-of-absence, and change-of-status forms, including impacts on funding, in compliance with Graduate School policies and forms.
  + Advise program directors and faculty on student eligibility for TA appointments and additional compensation; troubleshoot GTA contract issues including parking passes, health insurance, and stipend questions. Collaborate directly with Program Directors, the Graduate School, and Human Resources to accurately identify, record, and track graduate assistant (GA) and teaching assistant (TA) appointments for both funded and unfunded students. In coordination with Human Resources, the incumbent is responsible for initiating and managing electronic documentation and appointments for eligible students using such systems as Docusign, WolfieOne, or other programs.
  + Serving as a key departmental liaison, this role consults regularly with Program Directors regarding student status, while taking ownership of ensuring that assignments, stipend amounts, Graduate Tuition Scholarships (GTS), and course underloads are reported to the Graduate School and other departments in a timely manner. Coordinate thesis committee formation, milestone documentation, and scheduling of thesis presentations and film screenings.
  + Coordinate degree clearances for CWL, FLM, and TVW graduates; maintain student records; resolve grade discrepancies and transcript issues in coordination with the Registrar. Monitor GAs, who work 4–20 hours per week in their first and second years, conduct regular check-ins and maintain ongoing communication with faculty responsible for GA assignments to ensure workloads are appropriate. Schedule GAs for the 6–9 PM bullpen shifts and any other off-hours coverage as needed.
* Faculty and Office Support:

  + Provide administrative support to department senior leadership and other assigned faculty and staff. Serve as the initial point of contact for the Manhattan Center community, answering queries in person

New York City Mayor Eric Adams is head of the executive branch of New York City's government. **Job Description**

Within the NYC Health Department, the Bureau of Workforce Development and Training works to increase the knowledge and skills of the current and future workforce by providing opportunities for professional development, career counseling, mentorship, and traineeships. The Bureau seeks a Workforce Development Coordinator to support the bureau’s Office of Experiential Learning. The Office of Experiential Learning works to strengthen the capacity of the current and future public health workforce through relevant experiential, classroom and online opportunities.
  
  
Reporting to the Senior Director of the Office of Experiential Learning, the Workforce Development Coordinator will work collaboratively across the to support the continued professional development of DOHMH staff.
  
  
DUTIES WILL INCLUDE BUT NOT BE LIMITED TO:
  

* Conduct research, investigations and analysis which may include literature reviews to determine best practices and inform curriculum design to support workforce development activities for agency staff
* Assist with and conduct training needs assessments to understand current and emerging training needs through survey and questionnaire design and implementation, and data analysis
* Assist in the coordination of information gathering and other research efforts to support the work of the Office and contribute to public health knowledge via abstracts and peer reviewed journals as appropriate
* Research and identify internal or external facilitators to deliver training sessions
* Maintain correspondence with facilitators through the development, delivery, and post-evaluation of the course
* Assist with the development of training curriculum
* Coordinate training logistics such as developing course schedules, preparing and disseminating training materials
* Develop, disseminate, analyze evaluation tools; and prepare summary reports
* Serve as liaison with internal and external partners as necessary
* Create and execute a communication strategy which ensures staff are aware of workforce development opportunities
* Develop and/or update plans, protocols, and procedures.
* Maintain program and training records and files
* Support the other units within the Office as needed
* Support the Bureau and Division as needed

* Knowledge and interest in workforce development and training
* Demonstrated knowledge of instructional design, online instructional design, and adult learning theory
* Strong relationship-builder; ability to build and maintain effective working relationships
* Professional, analytical, creative, flexible, and able to meet tight deadlines and able to manage projects from all stages

* Solid working knowledge of Excel and other MS Office software

o a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement.
  
o a tax-deferred savings program and
  
o a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers.

- Job Security - you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work.
  
  
Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. We provide a wide array of programs and services focused on food and nutrition, anti-tobacco support, chronic disease prevention, HIV/AIDS treatment, family and child health, environmental health, mental health, and social justice initiatives. As the primary population health strategist and policy authority for NYC, with a rich history of public health initiatives and scientific advancements, from addressing the 1822 yellow fever outbreak to the COVID-19 pandemic, we serve as a global leader in public health innovation and expertise.
  
  
Come join us and help to continue our efforts in making a difference in the lives of all New Yorkers!

**Job Description**
-------------------

Civil Service Title- Community Coordinator
  
  
The New York City Department of Transportation, Division of Bridges is responsible for managing the full life cycle of over 800 bridges and tunnels and over 600 retaining walls, ensuring safety of the public and ensuring mobility for all users. Team members may work on major project designs, oversee construction, oversee maintenance activities, perform engineering reviews and quality assurance tasks on some of the most iconic and complex projects in the City.  
  
  
  
The Community Coordinator will support the Executive Director, Director, and Program Manager of Community Affairs in planning, coordinating, and delivering community outreach for multiple, simultaneous NYC Department of Transportation Division of Bridges capital and maintenance projects throughout the five boroughs.
  
  
The selected candidate will help ensure that residents, businesses, elected officials, community boards, government agencies, and other stakeholders receive accurate and timely information regarding bridge rehabilitation, reconstruction, painting, maintenance, and other infrastructure activities.
  
  
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  
  
Develop and implement community outreach strategies for bridge rehabilitation, reconstruction, painting, maintenance, and other municipal infrastructure projects.
  
Provide guidance, coordination, and administrative support to Community Construction Liaisons assigned to projects in one or more boroughs.
  
Assist with onboarding and training new Community Construction Liaisons on agency policies, outreach procedures, reporting requirements, documentation standards, and communication protocols.
  
Review, edit, and track important notices, construction bulletins, brochures, presentations, fact sheets, detour information, and other public-facing materials.
  
Verify that public notifications accurately reflect construction schedules, traffic changes, pedestrian and bicycle impacts, parking restrictions, detours, work hours, and other project conditions.
  
Coordinate the timely review, approval, translation, printing, and distribution of project notices, flyers, brochures, and No Parking signs.
  
Monitor project schedules, construction updates, and two-week look-ahead reports to identify upcoming activities requiring public notification or stakeholder coordination.
  
Attend construction progress meetings, all-agency meetings, community board meetings, elected officials’ meetings, and other stakeholder engagements.
  
Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, talking points, correspondence, meeting minutes, action items, and project summaries.
  
Respond to inquiries and complaints from residents, businesses, property owners, elected officials, community boards, civic organizations, and other stakeholders.
  
Coordinate with project managers, resident engineers, consultants, contractors, and agency personnel to research concerns, obtain accurate information, develop appropriate responses, and track issues through resolution.
  
Conduct field visits to project sites and surrounding communities to evaluate construction impacts, verify the placement of notices and signage, distribute outreach materials, and engage affected stakeholders.
  
Establish and maintain working relationships with elected officials, community boards, government agencies, first responders, Business Improvement Districts, civic associations, businesses, schools, houses of worship, property managers, and other community organizations.
  
Maintain and regularly update stakeholder databases, project contact lists, inquiry and complaint logs, outreach records, distribution lists, and other tracking systems.
  
Maintain current contact information for elected officials, key agency personnel, regional organizations, Business Improvement Districts, community groups, and other project stakeholders.
  
Maintain and analyze records of bridge-strike incidents involving commercial vehicles and assist with related research and community coordination.
  
Maintain records of snow-, ice-, and winter-related complaints and research reported locations to determine whether they are included in applicable snow-removal plans.
  
Research, document, and track inquiries received through the DOT’s ARTS system and other approved inquiry-management platforms.
  
Assist with preparing and distributing project updates through email, printed materials, presentations, websites, and approved social media platforms.
  
Develop content for approved social media platforms and monitor online activity for project-related questions, concerns, and emerging community issues.
  
Review outreach materials for accuracy, consistency, grammar, formatting, accessibility, and compliance with agency standards.
  
Track outreach commitments, outstanding inquiries, meeting action items, and project deliverables to ensure timely follow-up and completion.
  
Assist with coordinating public information sessions, community meetings, special events, and other outreach activities.
  
Prepare and maintain records of stakeholder engagement activities, including meetings, telephone calls, emails, field visits, and material distributions.
  
Manage multiple assignments, competing priorities, and time-sensitive requests while meeting established deadlines.
  
Provide coverage for assigned projects and Community Construction Liaisons, as necessary.
  
Perform special assignments and other related duties, as required.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Nine Orchard is a 113-room hotel in the restored 1912 bank building at the corner of Canal and Orchard on Manhattan's Lower East Side. The property is design-forward and service-driven, with a notable food and beverage program that draws equally from hotel guests and neighborhood regulars. Nine Orchard operates with the intimacy of a small property and the rigor of a top-tier hotel.

Nine Orchard is looking for a Sales & Marketing Coordinator who brings genuine passion for hospitality, a feel for the New York market, and the instincts to translate the hotel's identity into relationships and revenue.

This role is an important point of connection between prospective clients, the sales team, hotel operations, and food and beverage partners — supporting group business, corporate accounts, private events, and related revenue-generating opportunities from initial inquiry through contracting and post-event follow-up. You will work closely with hotel leadership to drive group, corporate, and leisure business while supporting the broader marketing presence of the property, from social content and partnerships to press inquiries and brand collateral. Reports to the Director of Sales & Marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Sales

* Manage inbound group, return guest, VIP and corporate inquiries from initial contact through contract, qualifying each opportunity
* Develop and maintain relationships with travel agents, corporate accounts, event planners, and local business contacts
* Enter group rooming lists with detail and accuracy
* Prepare proposals, presentations, contracts, and banquet event orders that reflect the hotel's voice and standards
* Follow up with inquiries in timely fashion

Sales operations & VIP coordination

* Prepare and distribute pre-arrival resumes for all VIP and group arrivals, ensuring Front Office, F&B, and Housekeeping are briefed and ready
* Collect, organize, and track artist and talent riders; coordinate fulfillment with relevant hotel departments ahead of arrival
* Manage amenity and room assignment coordination for VIP, celebrity, and high-touch guests in close partnership with Front Office and Housekeeping
* Maintain and update group and VIP arrival logs; track action items from the daily arrivals report and follow through on delivery
* Serve as the internal point of contact for group and VIP business from contract through departure; own the entire cycle from booking to post-stay
* Maintain account-level notes in the PMS and sales systems

Marketing

* Assist with email marketing campaigns, seasonal promotions, and partnerships
* Manage and update photography assets and brand collateral
* Coordinate with the F&B team on programming, events, and cross-promotional opportunities
* Support press and media inquiries in partnership with the hotel's PR contacts

Administration & operations

* Maintain the CRM and account database with accurate, up-to-date information
* Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports, comp set analyses, and market trend summaries
* Liaise with Front Office, F&B, and Events to ensure group and VIP arrivals are executed seamlessly
* Manage the sales calendar, including site inspections, client meetings, and trade show participation

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

* 2–4 years of experience in hospitality sales, marketing, or a related guest-facing role
* Background in a boutique, independent, or lifestyle hotel — you understand what makes properties like Nine Orchard different
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can write a compelling proposal and hold a room in a client meeting
* Comfortable working independently and across departments in a lean, fast-moving environment
* Organized, detail-oriented, and able to juggle multiple priorities without dropping the ball
* Flexible availability to support site visits, client events, and travel shows as needed

Preferred

* Existing relationships in the New York market: corporate accounts, travel trade, event planners, or media
* Familiarity with hotel sales systems (Delphi, Opera Sales & Catering, or similar)
* Experience with social media management tools and email marketing platforms
* Knowledge of the New York lifestyle, F&B, and events landscape
* Multilingual abilities

WHAT WE EXPECT IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS

* Sales inquiries, proposals, and client communications are handled promptly, accurately, and on-brand
* Operational teams reliably receive clear, complete information ahead of every group, event, and VIP arrival
* You've built genuine relationships with clients and key accounts, and the team can rely on your reporting and follow-through to help convert business and grow revenue

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

* Base pay: $ 65,000- $70,000 annually, commensurate with experience
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Unlimited Paid time off
* Paid parental leave
* Life and disability insurance
* Employee dining discounts

Our ideal candidate combines warm hospitality with commercial drive and a genuine passion for food. jobs.description:
**About the role**

Luckin Coffee US is looking for a highly creative, hands-on Social Media Manager and Content Creator to lead our Instagram and TikTok presence. You will turn product launches, everyday coffee occasions and NYC culture into content that makes people want to discover and try Luckin.

Creativity is central to this role. We want someone who brings original campaign ideas, writes compelling hooks and knows how to make a product relevant to our audience. You will own social campaigns from the first idea to the final post and use performance insights to improve what comes next.

You should be proactive, organized and quick to act. You can manage overlapping launches and content deadlines, make clear priority decisions and move projects forward without waiting for step-by-step direction.

**What you will do**

**Creative strategy and product launches**

* Own the social planning for product launches from concept and briefing through production, publishing and post-launch review. Align messaging and timing with the integrated marketing lead.
* Develop original social campaign concepts that connect product benefits to customer interests, NYC culture and occasions such as the morning commute or afternoon treat.
* Build launch sequences and recurring content series on social media that give people reasons to try new products and revisit core favorites.

**Hands-on content creation**

* Develop hooks, scripts and shot lists; film and edit short-form videos for Instagram and TikTok, including captions, audio and graphics.
* Direct employees on camera, and be comfortable appearing in content for street interviews
* Create social coverage for store openings, IPs, partnerships and events. Brief and review freelance or agency assets when additional production support is available.

**Trends and creative experimentation**

* Identify emerging trends early and decide which fit Luckin's products, audience and brand voice. Act quickly on relevant opportunities.
* Proactively test hooks, formats, storytelling approaches and new content series. Set a clear question for each test, review results and document what to repeat, change or stop.

**Channel & Community Ownership**

* Manage the content calendar, captions, scheduling and publishing. Check product information, offers, dates, calls to action and app instructions before posts go live.
* Monitor and engage in community conversations and customer questions; use them to inform content and route service issues to the appropriate team.

**Social media agency management, project management and influencer direction**

* Manage social media agencies and freelance creative partners, providing clear direction and monthly or campaign-specific briefs covering objectives, audience, messaging, content formats, deliverables and deadlines.
* Manage multiple launches and product campaigns with clear deadlines, asset requirements and approvals. Flag conflicts and blockers early, propose solutions and follow through.
* Define brief requirements and coordinate access with the designated marketing and operations owners.
* Set creator briefs, recommend creators and approve content. Guide influencer outreach, sampling coordination, deliverable tracking and analytics collection.

**Performance Reporting & Growth**

* Partner with the growth on campaign links, conversion measurement and adapting promising content for paid media to support new customer acquisition.
* Track reach, viewing behavior, shares, saves and trackable customer actions. Prepare social and campaign performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations

**What we are looking for**

* 4+ years in social media or content creation, with a portfolio showing original ideas and strong execution. Food and beverage, retail or consumer brand experience is a plus.
* Strong creative instincts and copywriting skills: you can explain the audience insight behind an idea and show how you developed it into effective content.
* Hands-on filming and editing skills using CapCut, Premiere or similar tools, with a strong understanding of Instagram and TikTok storytelling.
* Creative testing and performance analysis: Ability to design purposeful content experiments, interpret results and turn successful ideas into repeatable formats and content series.
* Familiarity with using AI tools and building AI-assisted creative workflows.
* Proven ownership and initiative: You bring ideas, take action and resolve problems without constant direction.
* Experience managing social media agencies or creative partners, writing effective briefs and providing clear creative and editing feedback.
* Excellent time management and prioritization across concurrent projects. You understand urgency and communicate tradeoffs clearly.
* Sound cultural and brand judgment, with curiosity and a willingness to experiment and learn from results.
* Cross-functional communication: Ability to communicate asset requirements clearly, manage feedback and approvals, and coordinate with HQ, operations, supplies and marketing partners to meet launch deadlines.

**Portfolio requirements**

Please share content you personally conceived and produced, one product or brand campaign, and one creative experiment. Explain your contribution, the insight behind the work, the results and what you changed afterward.

NOTE:

1. Influencer discovery, negotiation, contracts and community management (DM, comments, engagement) is outside this scope. We need to keep the social media intern next year in order to offload this scope from the manager to the intern.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Emerald**

Emerald’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce. We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in-person and digital platforms and channels. For more information, please visit http://www.emeraldx.com.

Forge is looking for a high-energy Business Development pro to help grow revenue across our portfolio of trade shows and conferences. You’ll be the person who finds the right companies to talk to, starts the conversation, and qualifies opportunities for our Account Executives to close.

If you like digging into research, testing what messaging works, and using tools like Gong and Salesforce to build a pipeline, you’ll fit right in. You’ll help create pipeline through modern outbound prospecting — combining research, signal-based targeting, and consultative outreach. This is a fast-paced, “learn by doing” role with clear coaching, measurable goals, and a strong path into an Account Executive career track.

**Location: Alpharetta, GA or New York, NY (Broadway) — hybrid options may be available based on team needs.**

Why this role matters: You’ll create the top of the funnel—turning target accounts into real conversations and qualified meetings that become event and sponsorship revenue.

**Responsibilities**

* Research net-new exhibitor and sponsor accounts using ZoomInfo industry intelligence, and signal-based prospecting (intent, trigger events, engagement signals.
* Build targeted lists and run multi-threaded outreach cadences (email, phone, social) while keeping clean notes and next steps in Salesforce.
* Qualify prospects through short discovery conversations—confirming fit, goals, decision process, and timing—so we focus on high-potential opportunities.
* Create personalized outreach that connects a prospect’s business goals to the value of Forge’s events (ROI, audience, leads, brand visibility).
* Partner closely with Account Executives for a smooth handoff—sharing research, key contacts, conversation notes, and recommended next steps.
* Collaborate with Marketing and attendee teams to share feedback on lead quality, personas, and campaigns—then adjust targeting and messaging accordingly.
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor events, and emerging categories; bring new ideas for who we should be selling to next.
* Occasionally support the close by stepping in to run pricing/package conversations when needed.

**What we’re looking for**

* 0–2 years of experience in sales, customer success, recruiting, fundraising, hospitality, or another role where you had to build relationships and hit goals (internships count).
* Comfortable with outbound outreach (calls + email) and willing to practice, iterate, and get better fast.
* Tech savvy: experience using Salesforce (or another CRM) and confidence learning new tools quickly.
* Organized and self-directed—you can manage a daily outreach plan, follow-ups, and deadlines without things slipping.
* Strong communication skills: you can write clear, professional messages and speak confidently with new people.
* Be a consultative partner! Understand basic discovery methods (BANT) business pain, priorities, stakeholders, and decision process.
* Ability to travel up to 30% (some events require on-site time).

**Success Metrics**

* You will be measured on pipeline created, qualified opportunities, conversion, target account penetration, activity effectiveness.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Gong, ZoomInfo, sales engagement tools, or list-building tools.
* Comfort with light data analysis (Excel/Google Sheets) to track activity and results.
* Interest in events, media, marketing, or B2B communities—and curiosity about how businesses grow.

**What success looks like (first 90 days)**

*First 30 Days*

* Learn markets, messaging, systems, and outreach standards.

*60 Days*

* Consistently execute outbound cadence and generate qualified meetings.

*90 Days*

* Create repeatable pipeline contribution and begin influencing targeting and messaging.

**About Emerald**

At Emerald, we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive community. We actively recruit and champion candidates who bring new perspectives from varied professional backgrounds and experiences, and we are intentional about ensuring a positive hiring experience for everyone. Our job postings don’t contain experience inflation, and most don’t require college degrees. Instead, they’re crafted to focus on outcomes and transferable experiences that are assessed in a structured interview process carried out by trained hiring teams.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Target Compensation: $60,000 plus Sales Incentive Plan eligible

Please note that this range reflects a reasonable estimate of the target compensation for this position. This range may ultimately vary based on a candidate’s qualifications and may be higher where required by applicable law.

We offer a competitive benefits package designed to strengthen our employees’ physical and mental health, including unlimited vacation for exempt employees, flexible working locations, 401(k) plan with a company match, medical/dental/vision coverage with inclusive provisions including transgender services and fertility benefits, parental and caregiver leave, dependent, commuter and FSA benefits, professional development programs like Toastmasters, and mental wellness tools.

If you need accommodation in our application process or have questions about our posted salary range, please email our Talent Acquisition team at Careers@EmeraldX.com.
