**TRAFFIC CONTROL COORDINATOR**

**Position Summary**

The Traffic Control Coordinator supports daily traffic control operations by coordinating scheduling, personnel records, fleet, inventory, training, equipment, jobsite documentation, and administrative functions. This position works closely with management, field personnel, clients, vendors, and internal teams to ensure jobs are properly staffed, equipped, documented, and billed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Scheduling & Administration:** Create and maintain schedules, fill open shifts, process call-offs and schedule changes, verify employee qualifications, review timecards, support payroll, monitor overtime, and maintain personnel records in Belfry.
* **Compliance & Training:** Track licenses, permits, certifications, and training expirations. Manage ATTSA Flagger Certification records, registrations, credential verification, and certification documentation.
* **Fleet Management:** Utilize Motive to monitor vehicles, mileage, GPS, fuel, driver activity, inspections, maintenance, and compliance. Maintain vehicle records and coordinate repairs, inspections, and required testing.
* **Inventory & Equipment:** Utilize Sortly to track equipment, tools, vehicles, and jobsite assets. Maintain accurate quantities, locations, assignments, transfers, returns, and damage records. Support procurement and equipment replenishment.
* **Jobsite/TCP Coordination:** Review TCPs and job requirements, verify equipment availability, coordinate shortages, create jobsite folders, schedule personnel, update Belfry and Outlook, and maintain required project documentation.
* **Job Closeout:** Verify equipment returns, document damaged or missing equipment, confirm employee hours for billing, and ensure checklists, quotes, Sortly reports, and supporting documents are uploaded and complete.
* **Communication & Reporting:** Coordinate with employees, Traffic Control Managers, clients, vendors, and management. Prepare operational/client reports and provide jobsite hours and information to Sales & Marketing.
* **Wanco Support:** Update Wanco message boards through the website when the Traffic Control Manager is not onsite.

**Qualifications**

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent communication and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple jobs, deadlines, and priorities.
* Proficient with Microsoft Outlook and comfortable learning technology platforms.
* Experience with Belfry, Motive, Sortly, or similar systems is a plus.
* Traffic control, scheduling, fleet, inventory, or operations experience preferred.
* Ability to maintain accurate records and confidential information.

**Ideal Candidate**

A dependable, detail-oriented team member who can coordinate multiple moving parts, communicate effectively, follow through on assignments, and keep personnel, equipment, vehicles, and job documentation organized and up to date.

Instant Financial is the industry-leading instant pay platform that is changing the way that millions of Americans get paid. With a push of a button on the Instant app, we give employees immediate access to their earned pay or tips after each shift, for free. Employers who pay with Instant significantly boost job applicants, cut turnover, and dramatically reduce absenteeism, transforming them into employers of choice. We're the instant pay platform that is designed for companies that value employee success and well-being, and that's what drives us each day.

### **About the Role**

Instant Financial is hiring a Marketing Coordinator to keep the marketing function running day to day, from event logistics to agency coordination to cross-functional support. This role is the connective tissue of the marketing team: equal parts hands-on execution and organized follow-through, working closely with the VP of Marketing and the Demand Generation Manager to keep projects, partners, and events moving.

### **Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution for all conferences, trade shows, and sponsorships, including venue logistics, branded materials, and post-event ROI analysis.

* Collaborative team environment - everyone has a voice and is encouraged to use it
* Flexible vacation time - we believe in healthy work and family life
* Retirement plan plus company match
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits

Description:

Atlanta, GA | Full-Time | Hybrid — in-office Tuesday–Thursday, remote Monday and Friday

Leapfrog Services is looking for an Account Manager who builds trust, communicates clearly, and follows through. You’ll own relationships with an assigned group of clients, helping them get value from their managed IT services while supporting client satisfaction, retention, and account growth.

You’ll work with clients and internal teams to lead quarterly business reviews, coordinate concerns and next steps, and keep account commitments moving forward. You should understand technology services well enough to ask thoughtful questions and translate information into clear, useful business updates.

We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, stays organized, welcomes feedback, and adapts their communication to the audience. You’ll have technical experts to partner with; your strength is connecting the right people, managing expectations, and making sure clients feel informed and supported.

**What You’ll Do**

* Manage assigned client relationships, including ongoing communication, satisfaction, retention, and appropriate account growth.
* Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding client business priorities, needs, risks, and goals.
* Build and maintain client account plans and technology roadmaps in partnership with internal technical and leadership teams.
* Lead quarterly business reviews with client executives and key stakeholders, as appropriate.
* Communicate client needs, risks, concerns, and opportunities to internal teams clearly and promptly.
* Coordinate client escalations by ensuring the right internal resources are engaged, communication is clear, and follow-up is completed.
* Tailor client communications based on business priorities, stakeholder audience, and appropriate level of detail.
* Maintain consistent follow-through on client commitments, open items, risks, and account-related action items.
* Identify opportunities for service alignment, renewals, account growth, or additional solutions in coordination with internal sales and technical teams.
* Support proposals, renewals, billing questions, contract items, and change requests by coordinating details, documentation, and follow-up.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, including client contacts, opportunities, notes, decisions, and follow-up items.
* Monitor client satisfaction, service trends, and potential relationship risks.

Requirements:

**What You’ll Bring**

* Experience in account management, client success, relationship management, consultative sales, or another client-facing business role.
* Strong ability to build trust with clients and manage expectations professionally.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills.
* Sound judgment in determining what information clients need, when to escalate concerns, and how to frame updates appropriately.
* Ability to communicate with executives, stakeholders, technical teams, and non-technical audiences.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple clients, follow-up items, and internal requests at the same time.
* Self-motivated, accountable, and receptive to coaching, feedback, and direction.
* Basic understanding of managed IT services, recurring revenue models, business operations, and client service delivery.
* Ability to work effectively with internal technical teams, service delivery, sales engineering, leadership, and client stakeholders.
* Professionalism, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive company and client information.
* Proficiency with Microsoft productivity tools.

**Preferred Experience & Qualifications**

* Previous experience working for an IT Managed Service Provider, MSP, technology services company, consulting firm, or other client-facing technical services environment.
* Experience conducting quarterly business reviews, account planning, renewals, forecasting, or client roadmap discussions.
* Experience working with executive-level client stakeholders.
* Experience with CRM, quoting, PSA, or account management tools such as HubSpot, QuoteWerks, Kaseya/Autotask, or similar platforms.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Technology, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Strong client satisfaction and retention.
* Timely, clear, and appropriately tailored client communication.
* Consistent follow-through on client commitments, open items, and internal action items.
* Accurate CRM records and current client documentation.
* Effective coordination with internal service, technical, leadership, and sales teams.
* Successful completion of QBRs, client updates, proposals, and assigned follow-up items.
* Growth of assigned accounts through appropriate service alignment and client trust.
* Demonstrated ownership of assigned accounts and responsiveness to coaching and direction.

**Why Leapfrog?**

We believe strong people deserve strong support. Here’s what you can expect:

* Competitive salary range of $65,000–$80,000 annually
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* HSA plan with company contribution
* 401(k) with company match
* Company-paid life and disability insurance
* Paid time off, paid holidays, and birthday off
* Telemedicine and virtual mental health support available from day one
* Professional development support
* Milestone anniversary rewards and long-term service recognition
* A collaborative, service-focused culture

**About Leapfrog Services**

Leapfrog Services has delivered managed IT and cybersecurity services since 1998. We’re serious about service, accountability, and doing things the right way — and we believe culture plays a meaningful role in performance.

We value ownership, professionalism, collaboration, and steady improvement. If you’re looking for a role where client relationships, clear communication, and thoughtful follow-through matter, this might be the Pond you’re looking for!

What we would like you to bring

* Solid understanding of import/export processes, security requirements, and forwarding systems
* Experience working across multiple business units and countries in a matrix environment

jobs.title: Internal Account Manager (INS852)
jobs.description:
We're looking for an **Internal Account Manager** to own client relationships at Hire Overseas, a fast-moving offshore staffing and HR platform placing vetted global talent into U.S. companies. You will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of clients, keeping placements on track, resolving issues before they escalate, and ensuring clients stay engaged and satisfied long after the initial hire.

This is a small business. There is no large team behind you and no playbook for every situation. You will have a high degree of ownership and autonomy, which means you make real decisions, handle real problems, and have a direct impact on whether clients stay and grow. If you are a confident communicator who takes ownership instinctively, moves fast when something needs attention, and wants a role where your judgment actually matters, this role is a strong fit.

**Why You'll Want to Join**

* **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive
* This role requires availability during **US business hours**
* Work directly with founders at a growing offshore staffing company with real traction and a strong client base
* High-ownership role with full autonomy over how you manage and grow your client portfolio

**What You'll Work On**

**Client Relationship Management**

* Own a portfolio of client accounts as the primary point of contact from placement through ongoing engagement
* Build strong, trust-based relationships that make clients feel supported and well-served
* Conduct regular check-ins and proactively surface any issues, risks, or opportunities before they become problems
* Keep clients informed, engaged, and confident in their placements without waiting for them to reach out first

**Issue Resolution and Escalation**

* Handle client concerns quickly and professionally, taking ownership of resolution rather than routing everything to someone else
* Identify patterns in client feedback and flag systemic issues to leadership with recommended fixes
* Coordinate internally across recruiting, operations, and leadership to resolve complex client situations
* Make judgment calls on when to escalate and when to handle directly

**Retention and Growth**

* Drive client retention by delivering a consistently high-quality account management experience
* Identify opportunities to expand relationships including additional placements, new roles, or expanded scope
* Track account health and flag at-risk clients early with a clear plan of action

**Reporting and Communication**

* Maintain accurate and current records of all client interactions, account status, and open items
* Provide regular internal updates on portfolio health, client sentiment, and key risks
* Communicate clearly and professionally in writing and on calls across all client and internal interactions

**What You Bring**

* Proven experience in account management, client success, or a similar client-facing role in a B2B environment
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills with a professional and responsive style
* High ownership mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes rather than passing problems up or sideways
* Comfortable operating with autonomy in a small business environment where processes are still being built and the answers are not always obvious
* Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously without losing track of anything
* Proactive and fast-moving with a bias toward action over deliberation when clients need support

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in staffing, recruiting, HR services, or workforce management
* Background working at a small business, startup, or founder-led company
* Familiarity with offshore or global hiring and the dynamics of remote contractor placements
* Experience with CRM tools for tracking client interactions and account health

**How to Apply**

Please include:

* Your **updated resume**
* A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your account management or client success experience, and walking through how you handle a situation where a client is unhappy and you have to resolve it without escalating to leadership

**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**

If you want full ownership over a client portfolio at a fast-moving company where your decisions actually matter and your impact is directly visible, this role gives you the autonomy and the scope to do your best work.

**Application Process Overview**

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

* **Initial Application** - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
* **Video Introduction** - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
* **Role-Specific Assessment** - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
* **Recruitment Interview** - Initial screening with our talent team
* **Executive Interview** - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
* **Client Interview** - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
* **Background & Reference Check** - Professional reference verification
* **Job Offer** - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

This role plans, negotiates, executes, and optimizes publisher-direct placements - display, newsletter, native, custom content, event and print - and manages a secondary book of programmatic and paid social buying. As ad serving moves in-house, this role is accountable for ad-serving hygiene and for the operational discipline behind the ad-serving vendor investment: clean placement structures, accurate tag implementation, retired trafficking sheets, and reconciled delivery counts. Specialist II coordinates with the Activation Senior Specialist on launch sequencing, with Marketing Technology and web teams on site tag implementation, and with publishers and ad-serving vendors on technical troubleshooting.

**Creative Trafficking & Ad Serving**  

* Traffics display, video, native, and rich media creative into the ad server and buying platforms, verifying specifications, click-through URLs, and third-party tag integrity.
* Builds and maintains ad server placement structures, creative assignments, and ad associations aligned to campaign taxonomy and naming standards.

* Generates and distributes trafficking sheets and ad tags to publishers and confirms correct implementation prior to launch.

**Tag & Pixel Management**  

* Implements and validates conversion pixels, floodlight tags, and event tracking in coordination with Marketing Technology and web teams.
* Audits tag placement across landing pages and site templates, identifying missing, duplicated, or misfiring tags.
* Maintains tag documentation mapping each tag to its campaign, conversion event, and owner.
* Coordinates tag requests with third-party vendors including verification, rich media, and measurement partners.

  
**Delivery Troubleshooting & Discrepancy Resolution**  

* Monitors delivery across ad servers, buying platforms, and publisher reporting, identifying impression, click, and conversion discrepancies.
* Investigates and resolves discrepancies with publishers, platforms, and ad-serving vendors, documenting root cause and resolution.
* Troubleshoots creative rendering, latency, and serving failures and executes corrective trafficking changes.
* Escalates unresolved technical issues with a clear summary of the investigation completed to date.
* Tracks recurring discrepancy patterns by publisher or platform and surface them for commercial follow-up.

  
**Ad-Serving Hygiene & Vendor Operations**  

* Owns ad-serving hygiene including retirement of completed placements, archiving of inactive creative, and removal of orphaned tags.
* Monitors ad-serving impression consumption against the contracted vendor commitment and flags pacing variances.
* Supports invoice validation for ad-serving costs by reconciling served impressions against vendor reporting.
* Maintains ad-serving configuration documentation including user access, naming standards, and trafficking procedures.
* Executes quality assurance checks covering rendering, click-through function, tracking, and creative accuracy before every launch.

  
**Reporting & Collaboration**  

* Pulls ad server delivery reporting and provides served impression, click, and rotation data to support campaign reporting.
* Coordinates with the Activation Sr Specialist and respective teams on logistics, execution, and metrics for each launch.
* Designs and develops trafficking status views giving the team visibility into what is built, what is pending, and what is blocked.
* Stays current on ad serving standards, creative formats, privacy and signal-loss developments affecting tag-based measurement.

* Inclusive parental leave policies, plus comprehensive fertility coverage and adoption assistance.

**Who You Are**  
  
**Minimum:**  

* Bachelor's degree in related discipline and 2 years' experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master's degree and up to 2 years' experience; or 6 years' experience in a related field.

**What we’re looking for**

* 0–2 years of experience in sales, customer success, recruiting, fundraising, hospitality, or another role where you had to build relationships and hit goals (internships count).
* Comfortable with outbound outreach (calls + email) and willing to practice, iterate, and get better fast.
* Tech savvy: experience using Salesforce (or another CRM) and confidence learning new tools quickly.

* Ability to travel up to 30% (some events require on-site time).

**Success Metrics**

* You will be measured on pipeline created, qualified opportunities, conversion, target account penetration, activity effectiveness.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Gong, ZoomInfo, sales engagement tools, or list-building tools.
* Comfort with light data analysis (Excel/Google Sheets) to track activity and results.
* Interest in events, media, marketing, or B2B communities—and curiosity about how businesses grow.

**What success looks like (first 90 days)**

*First 30 Days*

* Learn markets, messaging, systems, and outreach standards.

*60 Days*

* Consistently execute outbound cadence and generate qualified meetings.

*90 Days*

* Create repeatable pipeline contribution and begin influencing targeting and messaging.

At Emerald, we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive community. We actively recruit and champion candidates who bring new perspectives from varied professional backgrounds and experiences, and we are intentional about ensuring a positive hiring experience for everyone. Our job postings don’t contain experience inflation, and most don’t require college degrees. Instead, they’re crafted to focus on outcomes and transferable experiences that are assessed in a structured interview process carried out by trained hiring teams.

Target Compensation: $60,000 plus Sales Incentive Plan eligible

Please note that this range reflects a reasonable estimate of the target compensation for this position. This range may ultimately vary based on a candidate’s qualifications and may be higher where required by applicable law.

jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**

At ERC Pathlight, we're on a mission to change lives—and we're looking for people who feel called to do the same.

As one of the nation's leading treatment providers for eating disorders and mood, anxiety, and trauma-related conditions, we bring innovative, evidence-based, and deeply compassionate care to patients across the country. With multiple locations nationwide and extensive virtual programming, we meet patients exactly where they are and help them move toward lasting recovery.

Founded in 2008 by renowned psychiatrists and psychologists, ERC Pathlight now supports more than 6,000 patients each year. And as the need for world-class mental health care continues to rise, our commitment is stronger than ever: to expand access, elevate the standard of care, and empower every patient to rebuild their life with dignity and hope.

### **Why Join Us**

When you join ERC Pathlight, you become part of a team that shows up every day to make a real difference. You'll work alongside passionate clinicians, dedicated support staff, and mission-driven leaders who believe in collaboration, growth, and doing the right thing—always.

Here, your work matters. Your ideas matter. **You** matter.

If you're energized by purpose, motivated by impact, and ready to help transform the future of mental health treatment, you belong here.

**Come build hope. Come save lives. Come grow with us.**

**What you'll be doing:**

Schedule: Full time FT 6:30am-7:00pm Monday, Wednesday, Thursday

The Program Coordinator (PC I, PC II, PC III) is responsible for the direct care of inpatient, residential, and partial hospitalization patients by providing patient supervision and support. The PCs provide structure and boundaries for our patients. They provide bathroom and milieu support as well as contribute to the implementation of therapeutic programming which may include care delivery and program documentation. The PCs provide mealtime support, supporting patients with their dietary needs, and supervising patients at meals and snacks.

The PC should be able to:

* Be willing and able to work at all ERC Pathlight local sites as assigned

* Be compliant with certification and regulatory requirements for each practice location

* Maintain a flexible schedule to meet organizational staffing needs

* Be available to work weekends and holidays as required

* Be available to work on-call shifts based on business needs, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local labor laws

**Essential duties and responsibilities:**

* Milieu Management, including (but not limited to) the following:

* Maintains daily program structure by following program schedule

* Completes observation rounds and safety checks as ordered by physician

* Works with patients on de-escalation and implementing coping skills per treatment plan

* Conducts room searches and luggage searches

* Takes patients out on fresh air breaks and mindful movement exposures

* Provides ongoing bathroom monitoring

* Take patient vital signs, weights, urine Specific Gravity (may vary by location and program)

* Group Facilitation

* Participates in group facilitation

* Compliant with documentation in EHR for group facilitation

* Supports group outings

* Meal Support, including (but not limited to) the following:

* Participates in all meals and snacks with patients as needed per facility

* Provides meal support through coaching and skills per treatment team at eating disorder treatment locations (when not assigned to an eating disorder treatment location, performs other duties as assigned based on program and operational needs)

* Provides administrative support as needed around mealtimes

* Ensures adherence to allergy-safety system

* Administrative Support

* Complete all appropriate documentation as needed in compliance with standards (some indicated above) including but not limited to patient observations, meals, and events that occur during shift

* Provides patient transportation as needed for medical appointments (may vary by location and program)

* Supports additional transportation needs, including but not limited to outings, grocery shopping, or other facility needs

* May provide support for additional food procurement as needed once per week

* Distributes mail and packages daily

**Must haves:**

Program Coordinator I (PC I)

* High School Diploma or GED (required)

* Valid driver's license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (required)

* Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (required)

* ServSafe certification may be required depending on state and local licensing regulations (required)

* Mental Health/Psych Tech or CNA certification (preferred)

Program Coordinator II (PC II)

* Minimum of one (1) year of direct patient care experience (required)

* Valid driver's license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (required)

The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type.

jobs.title: Event Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.

Powered by **LOIS**, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

### **About The Role**

The Event Operations Coordinator is the engine behind every field event we run. You're responsible for two things that matter most before the doors open: **getting the right people in the room** and **making sure every logistical detail is locked and ready**.

This is a high-ownership, detail-driven role that sits at the intersection of outreach, operations, and vendor coordination. You'll work closely with the Sr. Manager of Field Marketing to identify and secure the ideal attendee mix for every event, then execute every pre-event motion required to make it happen: registration, websites, campaigns, communications, and vendor follow-through.

You won't be on-site, but your fingerprints are on everything that makes the on-site experience possible.

### **What You'll Own**

### **High-Quality Attendance**

* Partner with Sales Operations and the Field Marketing Manager to build targeted invite lists with the right mix of customers, in-pipe prospects, and net-new leads for each event
* Drive RSVPs and ticket confirmations through structured email cadences and direct outreach (phone, LinkedIn, etc.) to hit the goal every time
* Maintain minimum registration and attendance rates
* Quality matters as much as quantity. The goal isn't a full room, it's the *right* full room

### **Outreach & Registration**

* Execute multi-touch outreach campaigns (email, phone, etc.) to drive RSVPs against event-specific targets
* Manage registration lists and ensure accurate, up-to-date attendee records throughout the pre-event cycle
* Coordinate with Sales to ensure reps are actively supporting outreach efforts for their accounts and prospects

### **Pre-Event Logistics**

* Own pre-event operational details so that the Field Marketing Manager can focus on strategy, on-site experience, and sales conversion including:

  + Ensure attendee travel is booked and act as liaison between attendees and travel agency as needed
  + Build and maintain event websites where applicable
  + Create and manage registration pages in **Cvent**
  + Build **Salesforce campaigns** for every event and ensure proper tracking throughout
  + Create and deploy all necessary UTMs, web links, and landing pages as needed

### **Vendor Coordination**

* Once the Field Marketing Manager has selected and contracted vendors (swag, activations, venues, etc.), take ownership of all follow-through
* Manage day-to-day vendor communication to ensure deliverables are on time and meet expectations
* Escalate issues to the Field Marketing Manager as needed
* Track and process vendor invoices to ensure timely payment

### **Attendee Communications**

* Draft and deploy all transactional attendee communications in partnership with the Field Marketing Manager, including:

  + Know Before You Go (KBYG)
  + Event updates and logistics changes
  + Post-event surveys
* Ensure every attendee has the information they need to show up prepared and engaged

### **Post-Event Follow-Up**

* Execute post-event email cadences to support conversion efforts
* Ensure all attendee and response data is accurately logged in Salesforce for pipeline tracking
* Secure survey responses and share this information with the broader leadership team for consideration and analysis

### **What We're Looking For**

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail; you will catch things before they become problems
* Proven ability to run multi-touch outreach campaigns that drive real response rates, not just sends
* Experience with **Cvent**, **Salesforce**, and marketing operations fundamentals (UTMs, landing pages, campaign tracking)
* Comfortable managing vendor relationships and holding external partners accountable to timelines
* Strong written and oral communicator; you can write a crisp, effective outreach email and are energized by following up via phone and social media
* Self-directed and proactive; you don't wait to be told something needs to happen. You see it and own it.
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment managing multiple events simultaneously
* Prior experience in event coordination, marketing operations, or inside sales outreach preferred

*The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. The total compensation package for this position will be determined by each individual’s location, qualifications, education, work experience, skills and performance. We believe in the importance of pay equity - the range listed is just one component of Filevine’s total compensation package for employees. This position is also eligible for a paid time off policy, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.*

**Work Location Expectation:**This position is based out of our **San Francisco, Chicago, Salt Lake City or New York** offices. Candidates residing in or near these metro areas are expected to work on a hybrid (2-3 days in-office/week) or fully onsite basis.

* Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (for full-time employees)

**About the Role****:** Responsible for IOA Benefits Account Management activities under Producer direction. Responsibilities include client service and communication, team leadership, directing daily tasks and work activities of Account Coordinators, team and individual productivity, quality, and service levels, implementation of client benefits administrative processes, tracking, renewals, new client setup, data management/entry, Producer communication, team and individual professional development, identification of sales opportunities, and upholding IOA core values.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Client Management:** Manage an assigned book of business, ensuring performance requirements are met and no liability occurs.

* **Client Service:** Deliver outstanding service, anticipate client needs, maintain professional communication, and respond quickly to requests.

* **Team Leadership:** Lead the account team with a strong work ethic, positive attitude, and willingness to assist others.

* **Daily Activities:** Direct daily activities of Account Coordinator(s), assign tasks, communicate expectations, monitor execution, and recommend corrective actions.

* **Business Growth:** Identify and act on sales opportunities to grow IOA business.

* **New Business Setup:** Manage new business setup, including data gathering, client file creation, communication, AOR notifications, carrier rates, internal services setup, compliance audits, client education, and employee meetings.

* **Client Relationships:** Build and improve client relationships, seek feedback, and implement improvements.

* **Intermediary Role:** Advocate for clients and carriers to ensure mutually beneficial outcomes.

* **Value-Added Solutions:** Identify and implement value-added solutions for clients.

* **Professional Development**: Support team training and development, promote a positive work environment, and seek continuous improvement.

* **Communication**: Maintain transparent communication with Producers and team members.

* **Compliance**: Ensure adherence to company policies and industry standards.

* Champion IOA core values and demonstrate integrity and leadership.

**Ideal Candidate****Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of industry experience

* Required active licensing

* Exceptional customer service and communication skills

* Strong organizational, delegation, and decision-making skills

* High accuracy in handling large work volumes

* Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)

* High School Diploma (or equivalent)

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salaries and bonus potential

* Company-paid health insurance

* Paid holidays, vacations, and sick time

* 401K with employer match

* Professional growth and career progression opportunities

* Respectful culture and work/family life balance

* Community service commitment

* Supportive teammates and a rewarding work environment

**What****to Expect****(Application Process)****:**

* 30-Minute Phone Screen, Online Assessments, and Interview(s)

**Salary Range**

*The expected pay range for this position is 70-90K annually, depending on experience, relevant skills, and geographic location.*

You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

**Job Description:**

**Opportunity: Grow Your Career**

Responsible for executing receiving and merchandising standards while ensuring Associates are processing efficiently and effectively, and working as a team. Ensures an excellent customer experience by engaging and interacting with all customers, and maintaining a clean and organized store. Role models exceptional customer service.

* Orchestrates truck delivery, prioritizing the processing of merchandise onto the sales floor

* Ensures merchandise is properly tagged, hung, secured, and coded
* Communicates with the Coordinator on Duty to ensure efficient flow of goods to sales floor
* Ensures Associates complete tasks and activities according to store plan; prioritizes as needed
* Monitors productivity of team and coaches as necessary
* Organizes and rotates back stock for easy replenishment
* Maintains and upholds merchandising philosophy and signage standards
* Maintains all organizational, cleanliness and recovery standards for the backroom area
* Ensures compliance with recycling and, where applicable, hazardous waste programs
* Communicates accurately and effectively with management and Associates when setting and addressing priorities; provides progress updates
* Provides and accepts recognition and constructive feedback
* Partners with Management on Associate training needs to increase effectiveness
* Ensures adherence to all labor laws, policies, and procedures
* Promotes credit and loyalty programs
* Supports and participates in store shrink reduction goals and programs
* Promotes safety awareness and maintains a safe environment
* Other duties as assigned

**Who We’re Looking For: You.**

* Able to work a flexible schedule, including nights and weekends
* Superior communication and organizational skills with attention to detail
* Capable of multi-tasking
* Able to respond appropriately to changes in direction or unexpected situations
* Team player, working effectively with peers and supervisors
* Capable of lifting heavy objects with or without reasonable accommodation
* Able to train others
* 1 year retail and 6 months of leadership experience

jobs.title: LN Concerts, Regional Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

**WHO ARE WE?**

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com .

**WHO ARE YOU?**

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

**THE JOB**

We are currently looking for a Coordinator of Regional Marketing. In this role, under the guidance of the Regional Marketing Management Team, you’ll be responsible for multiple marketing efforts including artist and audience research, coordination, and delivery of marketing assets to marketing partners, invoice coding and payment and event marketing recap reports.

**WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO**

* Perform a range of administrative and marketing support duties for the Regional Marketing Management Team
* Coordinate the delivery of promotional tickets with applicable marketing partners throughout the region
* Compile advertising settlement recap reports for locally booked events
* Code and process incoming advertising invoices
* Research audience and artist demographic info to help shape marketing plans
* Research media performance statistics to inform marketing strategy
* Work with internal teams to create impactful marketing campaigns on various digital platforms
* Assist with any grassroots marketing campaigns (ordering flyers/posters, shipping materials)
* Assist the local sponsorship team with annual local sponsorship marketing recaps
* Assist the local PR team in compiling press requests to coordinate event media coverage
* Ensure all necessary show marketing information is input into Live Nation proprietary marketing tools
* Day of show event coverage as necessary
* Ability to work extended hours, including weekends and evenings is required (as dictated by show dates, deadlines, etc.)

Assist in additional duties as needed  



**WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing or a related field preferred, but not required
* 1+ years of prior experience in event assisting/planning or marketing experience within an entertainment, sports or public assembly facility setting

jobs.description:
We're looking for an **Internal Account Manager** to own client relationships at Hire Overseas, a fast-moving offshore staffing and HR platform placing vetted global talent into U.S. companies. You will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of clients, keeping placements on track, resolving issues before they escalate, and ensuring clients stay engaged and satisfied long after the initial hire.

This is a small business. There is no large team behind you and no playbook for every situation. You will have a high degree of ownership and autonomy, which means you make real decisions, handle real problems, and have a direct impact on whether clients stay and grow. If you are a confident communicator who takes ownership instinctively, moves fast when something needs attention, and wants a role where your judgment actually matters, this role is a strong fit.

**Why You'll Want to Join**

* **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive
* This role requires availability during **US business hours**
* Work directly with founders at a growing offshore staffing company with real traction and a strong client base
* High-ownership role with full autonomy over how you manage and grow your client portfolio

**What You'll Work On**

**Client Relationship Management**

* Own a portfolio of client accounts as the primary point of contact from placement through ongoing engagement
* Build strong, trust-based relationships that make clients feel supported and well-served
* Conduct regular check-ins and proactively surface any issues, risks, or opportunities before they become problems
* Keep clients informed, engaged, and confident in their placements without waiting for them to reach out first

**Issue Resolution and Escalation**

* Handle client concerns quickly and professionally, taking ownership of resolution rather than routing everything to someone else
* Identify patterns in client feedback and flag systemic issues to leadership with recommended fixes
* Coordinate internally across recruiting, operations, and leadership to resolve complex client situations
* Make judgment calls on when to escalate and when to handle directly

**Retention and Growth**

* Drive client retention by delivering a consistently high-quality account management experience
* Identify opportunities to expand relationships including additional placements, new roles, or expanded scope
* Track account health and flag at-risk clients early with a clear plan of action

**Reporting and Communication**

* Maintain accurate and current records of all client interactions, account status, and open items
* Provide regular internal updates on portfolio health, client sentiment, and key risks
* Communicate clearly and professionally in writing and on calls across all client and internal interactions

**What You Bring**

* Proven experience in account management, client success, or a similar client-facing role in a B2B environment
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills with a professional and responsive style
* High ownership mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes rather than passing problems up or sideways
* Comfortable operating with autonomy in a small business environment where processes are still being built and the answers are not always obvious
* Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously without losing track of anything
* Proactive and fast-moving with a bias toward action over deliberation when clients need support

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in staffing, recruiting, HR services, or workforce management
* Background working at a small business, startup, or founder-led company
* Familiarity with offshore or global hiring and the dynamics of remote contractor placements
* Experience with CRM tools for tracking client interactions and account health

**How to Apply**

Please include:

* Your **updated resume**
* A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your account management or client success experience, and walking through how you handle a situation where a client is unhappy and you have to resolve it without escalating to leadership

**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**

If you want full ownership over a client portfolio at a fast-moving company where your decisions actually matter and your impact is directly visible, this role gives you the autonomy and the scope to do your best work.

**Application Process Overview**

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

* **Initial Application** - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
* **Video Introduction** - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
* **Role-Specific Assessment** - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
* **Recruitment Interview** - Initial screening with our talent team
* **Executive Interview** - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
* **Client Interview** - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
* **Background & Reference Check** - Professional reference verification
* **Job Offer** - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

With a consultative sales approach, you’ll build relationships with existing customers by understanding their key business drivers and executing system assurance programs. * Receive a company vehicle and cell phone
* Opportunity for a long term, advancing career path in service, sales or management

* Supporting condenser and heat-exchanger performance, biological and scale control, corrosion management, lake/raw-water management, and other site-specific water applications.
* Participating in periodic plant outages, inspections, technical reviews, KPI meetings, and business reviews.
* Maintaining strong procedural adherence, human-performance practices, and a safety-first mindset appropriate for highly regulated nuclear generating facilities.

* This position is based in the Chicago suburbs
* Territory covers **Dresden, LaSalle, Clinton IL.**
* Targeted accounts are within the **nuclear power industries**
* <25% overnight travel required

This territory covers a regional portfolio of power generation facilities across northern and central Illinois, primarily supporting the **nuclear power industry**, within approximately a 100-mile radius of Joliet, IL. This is a remote, field-based position. While the ideal candidate would be located in the western or southern suburbs of Chicago to provide convenient access to the territory, location flexibility may be considered, the greater distance from the territory may affect required travel and work life balance.

  

Because the assigned facilities are located within a defined regional footprint, the position will require regular travel between customer sites and a strong field presence. Training programs are held in the field and at Nalco Water Headquarters in Naperville, IL; travel arranged and paid for by Nalco Water. Based on your skill level, topics covered may include technology, product, service, business and industry acumen, direct coaching and mentoring, management and leadership, classroom training and certifications.

In a world with increasing water shortage and contamination challenges, Nalco Water, an Ecolab company, helps customers conserve more than 161 billion gallons of water each year. We are looking for a resourceful, self-directed Executive Assistant and House Manager to support the professional activities of a commercial real estate executive and a busy family. This is a hybrid role. Roughly half the work is household management, family logistics, and personal administration. The remaining half supports various real estate related activities.

The person who thrives here is entrepreneurial. You see what needs doing before being asked. You are comfortable calling a vendor, a title company, a contractor, or a customer service line and staying on the phone until you have a real answer. You do not wait for a perfect set of instructions. You take a partial brief, figure out the rest, and come back with the problem solved and a short summary of how you solved it.

If you like variety and take satisfaction in being the person who keeps everything moving, this role will fit.

**Household Operations**

· Oversee day-to-day household running and keep common areas organized

· Potentially plan simple, healthy meals around family preferences and schedules

· Manage grocery lists, shopping, and pantry and fridge inventory

· Occasionally family laundry and general household upkeep

· Manage household purchases and online orders

**Family Coordination**

· Coordinate cleaners, babysitters, and other household help, including scheduling and follow-up

· Manage kids' activity schedules, appointments, and related logistics

· Occasionally serve as the point of contact for service providers, activity organizers

· Run local errands (post office, returns, dry cleaning, pharmacy, and similar)

**Personal Administration and Bookkeeping**

· Pay household and property bills and track due dates

· Maintain basic bookkeeping records, categorize expenses, and reconcile statements

· Organize receipts and documentation for accountant handoff

· Manage shared calendars across family and professional commitments

**Travel**

· Plan and book flights, hotels, and ground transportation

· Build itineraries and packing lists, handle pre-trip preparation

· Resolve changes and disruptions in real time

**Real Estate and Property Support**

· Coordinate maintenance, repairs, and vendor scheduling for personal properties

· Track leases, renewals, insurance, and property-related paperwork (leveraging existing software)

· Communicate with tenants, property managers, and service providers as needed

· Property management experience is a strong plus, not a requirement

**Business Development Support**

· Research and organize data sources to identify prospective clients

· Build and maintain accurate contact records in the CRM (working with an in-place team)

· Execute outreach and follow-up campaigns as directed

· Track responses, report results, and flag what is working

· Proofread and edit correspondence and marketing materials

**What Makes Someone Successful Here**

· **Initiative.** You act on incomplete information and ask sharp questions rather than waiting for direction.

· **Phone confidence.** You would rather call than email when calling gets the answer faster, and you follow up until the loop is closed.

· **Judgment.** You know which decisions are yours to make and which need to be escalated.

· **Multi-tasking.** You can hold several projects and deadlines at once without dropping threads.

· **Discretion.** You will have access to family, financial, and confidential business information. Impeccable integrity is non-negotiable.

· **Follow-through.** Tasks get finished, and the person who assigned them knows they were finished.

**Qualifications**

· 2+ years in a house manager, executive assistant, personal assistant, nanny, or similar support role

· Strong organizational and time-management skills

· Strong written and verbal communication, including proofreading and editing

· Comfort with technology: shared calendars, Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, online ordering, and CRM or database tools

· Basic bookkeeping or bill-pay experience (not required but helpful)

· Real estate license, property management, or commercial real estate exposure is a plus but not required (desire to attain a real estate license is a plus)

· Valid driver's license and reliable transportation

· Bachelor's degree preferred

**Details**

· Approximately 25 to 30+ hours per week, schedule to be agreed upon

· Mix of on-site work and remote administrative work

· Occasional flexibility outside standard hours for time-sensitive items

· References preferred

Pay: $28.00 - $38.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic, versatile, and customer-focused professional to join our team in a hybrid role that combines in-store sales and customer service with essential office and administrative responsibilities.

The ideal candidate will be a motivated and results-oriented sales professional with strong organizational and administrative skills. This individual should be comfortable working directly with customers on the sales floor while efficiently managing office responsibilities and supporting day-to-day store operations.

The successful candidate will be able to seamlessly transition between customer service, sales, and administrative tasks, while maintaining a professional demeanor, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to providing excellent service.

Office & Administrative Responsibilities

* Bookkeeping Support: Assist with basic bookkeeping tasks, including processing invoices, and tracking daily sales.
* Inventory Management: Order, monitor, and maintain inventory of store merchandise and office supplies to ensure adequate stock levels.
* Administrative Support: Assist store management with preparing reports, maintaining records, and completing other administrative duties as needed.

Qualifications

* Retail Sales Experience: 3–4 years of proven retail sales experience, preferably in the beauty industry.
* Bilingual: Fluent in both English and Spanish.
* Customer Service: Friendly, approachable, and professional demeanor with a strong customer-first attitude.
* Professional Appearance: Well-groomed and maintains a professional appearance.
* Administrative Experience: Previous experience in an administrative or office support role.
* Technical Skills: Proficient in POS systems and Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, and Excel
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and team members.
* Organization and Time Management: Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and balance retail sales and administrative responsibilities.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $18.00 - $20.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: FP Movement Associate Community Manager
new_jobs.description:
Role Summary:

We’re looking for an energetic, highly organized **Associate Community Manager** to help bring our community strategy to life across events, ambassador programming, and community activations.

This person will be a key day-to-day partner to the Associate Director of Community + Special Events, helping turn ideas into thoughtful, strategic experiences that deepen relationships with our community. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable coordinating the details behind the scenes and representing the brand on the ground IRL.

You’ll help manage community touchpoints ranging from run days and walk clubs to ambassador programming, special events, and other grassroots activations across the US and beyond.

Role Responsibilities:

**Community Programming**
-------------------------

* ### Support the planning and execution of a strategic community programming calendar, including run days, walk clubs, ambassador activations, special events, and other community experiences.
* ### Own the community programming budget, including planning, forecasting, allocation, vendor management, and tracking spend against program goals.
* ### Coordinate event logistics, vendors, supplies, timelines, and staffing support plans across Marketing/ Retail/ Social, and other cross-functional partners.
* ### Partner closely with cross-functional teams to ensure broader brand priorities, product launches, campaigns, and cultural moments are thoughtfully integrated into community programming in an authentic way.
* ### Be hands-on at events and activations, ensuring every detail of the experience feels intentional, elevated, and on-brand.
* ### Analyze participation, engagement, attendance, and other program performance data to understand what is working, where there are opportunities for growth, and how we should strategically evolve our programming.
* ### Identify opportunities to expand the reach and impact of community programming, using data, audience insights, and emerging trends to inform where and how we invest.
* ### Continuously challenge the community strategy to make programming more engaging, inclusive, relevant, and impactful.

**Ambassador Program**
----------------------

* ### Help build and evolve a robust, scalable ambassador program that strengthens relationships with key community leaders and creates meaningful brand advocacy.
* ### Support the day-to-day management of the ambassador community, including communications, activations, gifting, events, and ongoing engagement.
* ### Help develop and execute ambassador recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and retention strategies.
* ### Cultivate strong, authentic relationships with ambassadors and serve as a trusted point of contact and extension of the brand.
* ### Track and analyze ambassador participation, engagement, performance, and program deliverables to understand impact and identify opportunities for growth.
* ### Use program insights and community data to continuously refine the ambassador experience and strengthen the overall program strategy.
* ### Identify emerging community leaders, creators, and advocates who can help expand our reach and deepen our connection within priority communities.
* ### Partner with Social, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for ambassadors to authentically support larger brand initiatives, product moments, storytelling, and launches.

Role Qualifications:

* 2–4 years of experience in community, events, experiential marketing, partnerships, hospitality, fitness/wellness, or a related field
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through
* Naturally outgoing, warm, and relationship-oriented
* Comfortable interacting with a wide range of people and building authentic relationships
* Able to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
* Willingness to work occasional evenings and weekends for community events
* A genuine interest in movement, wellness, culture, and building community

### **Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Community programming runs smoothly, consistently, and thoughtfully
* Ambassadors feel connected, supported, and engaged
* Events feel authentic to the brand rather than simply promotional
* Community members increasingly recognize the brand as a place they belong
* The Associate Director has a strong operational partner who can take an idea and independently move it toward execution

This role is based in Los Angeles, CA.

The wage range for this role is $75,000 - $80,000. Wages are based on several factors including but not limited to experience, education, geographic location, etc

* Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university or equivalent experience

We’re hiring 8–10 motivated Sales Representatives to join our growing team. No prior sales experience is necessary — we provide comprehensive training and ongoing support to help you succeed.

- $400–$500 per sale

- Average performers can earn $1,500–$2,500+ per week

- Uncapped earning potential

- Opportunities for advancement

**The Role:**

As a Home Security Sales Representative, you’ll visit residential neighborhoods and speak directly with homeowners about our home security systems and monitoring services.

Our sales process is straightforward, and appointments with homeowners can often take less than 60 minutes.

You’ll have access to a variety of products, promotions, and offers backed by a trusted leader in the security industry. With strong training, support, and an uncapped commission structure, your earning potential is in your hands.

For more than 15 years, our Skyline management team has trained thousands of sales representatives.

We take pride in providing excellent customer service, helping homeowners protect what matters most, and delivering quality security products and monitoring.

Each day begins with a 30–45 minute sales training meeting, followed by heading into assigned areas to canvass neighborhoods and meet with homeowners.

You’ll be trained and supported by experienced sales professionals and managers who are committed to helping you succeed.

Monday–Friday: 11:00 AM–8:00 PM

Saturday & Sunday: OFF

**Are You a Good Fit?**

We’re looking for people who can confidently answer yes to these five questions:

Do you have a strong work ethic?

Do you have a positive attitude?

Are you coachable, resilient, and willing to learn?

Are you dependable, reliable, and self-motivated?

Are you competitive and driven to earn six figures through commissions?

If that sounds like you, **we want you on our team!**

We’ll provide the training, support, and team culture you need to reach your full potential and make this your highest-earning year yet.

Apply today! We’re actively hiring, and qualified candidates can potentially start within the week.

This is a great time to get into security sales. Our team has had tremendous success this year, and homeowners continue to need reliable security solutions.

We look forward to speaking with you!

Pay: $60,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
TIMEPROOFUSA was founded by some of the home remodeling industry's most respected leaders. We have quickly become America's fastest-growing home improvement company—providing premium **roofing, bathroom remodeling, and siding solutions** to homeowners across the country. Our rapid growth is driven by one mission: to deliver uncompromising quality, dependable service, and lasting peace of mind to every customer we serve.

As an Outside Sales Representative, you'll run pre-set, qualified appointments, educate homeowners on our roofing, bathroom remodeling, or siding solutions and close projects in-home.

**$4,000 SIGN-ON BONUS**

**What You'll Do**

* Run pre-set, qualified appointments with homeowners—no cold calling or lead generation required.
* Conduct professional in-home design consultations, design custom showers using proprietary rendering software, provide same-day estimates, and execute a one-sit close.
* Partner with your Sales Manager and team for ongoing coaching, joint appointments, weekly meetings, and skill development.

**What's In It for You**

* 100% commission W-2 role with uncapped earnings + monthly bonuses.
* On target earnings between $150K–$320K+ annually.
* Pre-set qualified leads—focus on closing, not prospecting.
* 4 weeks paid training at $1,000/week, plus earn full commission — not a draw.
* Full benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k).
* $4,000 Sign-On Bonus.
* Monthly car allowance
* Cell phone allowance & company provided iPad

**What It Takes To Succeed**

* Resilience and ability to handle rejection without being discouraged.
* Ability to drive 100 miles a day on average.
* Availability to work evenings and weekends.
* Comfortable working in a commission-based role.
* Technological proficiency in using an iPad.
* Submit to a background screening.
* Valid driver's license and vehicle insurance.

**More About TIMEPROOFUSA**

TIMEPROOFUSA is redefining the future of roofing. With fire-safe materials, sustainable technology, and a leadership team backed by decades of success in home remodeling, we're building smarter, safer homes that stand the test of time.

Our core values—People First, Innovation, Customer Obsession, Integrity & Craftsmanship, and Profit Fuels Our Future—aren't just words on a wall. They drive how we build, lead, and win together.

If you're the kind of person who thrives on challenge, takes pride in excellence, and wants to be part of a team that's changing the industry, this is your moment.

Apply today, take the next step in your career, and let's build something extraordinary together.

new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
Introduction:

Since 1973, East West Bank has served as a pathway to success. With over 110 locations across the U.S. and Asia, we are the premier financial bridge between the East and West. Our teams of experienced, multi-cultural professionals help guide businesses and community members on both sides of the Pacific looking to explore new markets and create new opportunities, and our sustained growth and expertise in industries like real estate, entertainment and media, private equity and venture capital, and high-tech help build sustainable businesses and expand our associates’ potential for career advancement.

Headquartered in California, East West Bank (Nasdaq: EWBC) is a top-performing commercial bank with a strong foundation, an enterprising spirit and a commitment to absolute integrity. East West Bank gives people the confidence to reach further.

Overview:

The Social Media & Digital Engagement Manager will lead the Bank’s enterprise social media strategy, governance, content, creator partnerships, and engagement across English and Chinese-language platforms. This strategic, hands-on leader will use owned and external channels to strengthen brand equity, customer relationships, executive visibility, and business growth.

The role will manage a social media team and collaborate with Brand Marketing, Public Relations, Media & Advertising, Business Lines, Legal, Compliance, Risk Management, and Executive Leadership. English and Mandarin Chinese bilingual proficiency is highly desirable.

Responsibilities:

**Social Media Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and execute an enterprise social media strategy across English and Chinese-language platforms, with clear channel priorities, governance, performance goals, and alignment to brand and business objectives.
* Lead key platforms, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, WeChat, RedNote, and emerging channels, with culturally relevant and consistent content.
* Develop the social media team and manage agency and vendor partners while building audience engagement, affinity, and customer relationships.

**Brand Storytelling & Content Strategy**

* Lead content planning and editorial strategy across social channels, ensuring alignment with the Bank’s brand voice, values, and priorities.
* Develop content that highlights expertise, customer impact, community involvement, sponsorships, culture, and thought leadership.
* Build and manage a creator strategy aligned with the Bank’s brand, audiences, and business objectives to extend campaign reach, strengthen credibility, and support customer acquisition and conversion.

**Executive Visibility & Thought Leadership**

* Amplify executive perspectives, company achievements, business initiatives, community engagement, and corporate milestones to strengthen thought leadership across social platforms.

**Reputation Management**

* Monitor conversations, sentiment, reputation, risks, and opportunities across social channels.
* Develop response and escalation protocols with Corporate Communications, Legal, Compliance, and Risk Management.

**Revenue Support & Demand Generation**

* Partner with business line and media teams to align organic and paid social efforts that support awareness, consideration, customer growth, and campaign performance.

**Employee Advocacy & Social Governance**

* Establish social media policies, governance, and employee education covering brand standards, regulatory requirements, and appropriate practices.
* Partner with Enterprise Risk Management, Compliance, Legal, Human Resources, and Public Relations to mitigate reputational and regulatory risk.

**Analytics & Performance Optimization**

* Define KPIs and monitor audience growth, engagement, sentiment, share of voice, reputation, and business performance.
* Provide executive insights and use performance trends to optimize content, channels, and engagement.

Qualifications:

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Business, or related field.

* 10+ years of progressive experience in social media, digital or brand marketing, corporate communications, or related disciplines, including 3+ years of people leadership.
* Demonstrated success building enterprise social strategies and executive thought leadership programs.
* Strong knowledge of social platforms, content strategy, audience engagement, analytics, and reputation management.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, analytical, strategic planning, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience in a highly regulated industry, preferably financial services.

**Preferred**

* Bilingual in English and Chinese (Mandarin preferred).
* Experience managing WeChat, RedNote, and multicultural marketing initiatives.
* Experience within banking, financial services, wealth management, fintech, or related industries.
* Experience with social listening and social media management platforms such as Sprinklr, Brand watch, Meltwater, Sprout Social, or similar tools.
* Experience managing agency partners and external vendors, with preference for candidates who have worked at a creator agency, talent or creator management firm, social platform, or brand-side influencer marketing program.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Compensation: The base pay range for this position is USD $100,000.00/Yr. - USD $135,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

new_jobs.description:

new_jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator I : Research Cancer
new_jobs.description:
**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

Reporting to the Clinical Research Supervisor, Clinical Research Manager, or Director of Clinical Research Operations, the Clinical Research Coordinator I (CRC-I) is responsible for all aspects of clinical research activities and works in close cooperation with study physicians, inter- and intradepartmental stakeholders, and sponsors. The CRC-I provides support, coordination for FDA regulated research including data, blood and tissue collection studies that may involve industry-sponsored, government funded and/or investigator initiated clinical research trials.

The CRC-I is involved in all aspects of research clinical process including, but not limited to protocol review, preparation and administration of the informed consent, completion of study related visit forms, ensuring protocol required assessments are completed per study guidelines, processing of lab samples per IATA standards, regular communication with study sponsors and their collaborators, and data entry into study systems within study required timeframes.

The CRC I will ensure accurate completion of case report forms (CRFs), adverse event/serious adverse event (SAE) reporting, scheduled subject follow-up, and maintenance of regulatory binders. Discusses research study with potential study subjects and answers any questions (may refer questions to Principal Investigator or Sub-Investigator when appropriate) while obtaining informed consent as well as assisting in scheduling follow-up visits for enrolled subjects.

Responsible for development of study flow sheets, prepare study source documentation, gather study data, and assess subject for study eligibility (inclusion/exclusion). In addition, the CRC-I will record protocol specific assessments and ensure collection and shipment of samples, complete study forms to submit to sponsors and/or appropriate agencies, collect, enters and clean data into study database while maintaining data quality. He/she will host study team meetings, attend site initiation visits (SIVs) and perform other duties as assigned. Performs other duties as assigned.

Must be knowledgeable of Good Clinical Practices, protection of human subjects in research practices, and FDA regulatory guidelines regarding clinical research.

  

**Education and Experience**

* High School Diploma with sufficient experience and demonstrated skills to successfully perform the assigned duties and responsibilities; and/or equivalent experience/training.
* Excellent verbal and written communications and presentation skills; excellent organizational skills; and excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively in a diverse team.
* Attention to details.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Windows.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-based environment; project management and coordination skills; ability to prioritize tasks and meet multiple deadlines on concurrent projects.
* Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with patients, co-workers, & physicians.

**Preferred:**

* Medical terminology required. Working knowledge of FDA, NIH and OHRP regulatory requirements and ICH GCP guidelines.
* Understanding of clinical trial methodologies and experience filing Institutional Review Board documents.
* Ability to abstract data from medical records and transfer it to data collection forms or directly into databases.
* International Air Transport Association (IATA) Certification
* Current ACRP or SoCRA Certification.
