new_jobs.title: Global Workplace Business Operations Lead
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

The Workplace Experience team powers and connects the workday for all Perplexity employees across our global offices.

We are hospitality and experience-driven at the core. We are made up of People people, meaning that we love supporting each other and all of the People in our workplace. We take on the good and the bad with optimism and with a positive, kind approach to solving problems, dealing with the obstacles handed to us, and proactively creating good around us. We think about each moment through the lens of our colleagues (our customers) so that we can create thoughtful and memorable experiences no matter what task we have at hand.

As our Global Workplace Business Operations Lead, you will manage the business operations and cross-functional program delivery that enable our global Workplace Experience team to scale. In collaboration with the Head of Workplace Experience, you will set the operating framework for your areas, make decisions within agreed priorities and approval limits, and remain hands-on in delivering results. You will own the effectiveness of portfolio operating processes and internal project delivery.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Own the Workplace operating framework:** Lead annual and quarterly planning for your areas, translate team strategy into priorities and resource plans, and establish clear decision rights, delivery commitments and measures of success. Resolve sequencing and capacity trade-offs within agreed parameters and recommend when to add people, vendors or technology.
* **Lead internal capital-project delivery:** Take accountability for integrated delivery plans across office openings, refreshes and other capital initiatives. Direct the work of external PMs within agreed scopes, align internal workstreams, resolve delivery issues and hold partners accountable for schedule, cost, quality and operational readiness.
* **Own portfolio controls and insight:** Establish dependable lease administration, obligation tracking, space and occupancy information, and portfolio reporting. Set data and control standards, ensure actions have owners, and turn trends and risks into recommendations before deadlines or capacity constraints become problems.
* **Drive financial planning and performance:** Own the processes and quality of operating and capital forecasts, commitments, actuals and variance analysis in partnership with Finance. Challenge assumptions, recommend corrective actions and investment trade-offs, and give the Head of Workplace Experience a reliable basis for budget and commitment decisions.
* **Set the systems and reporting roadmap:** Own business requirements, governance and improvement priorities for workplace tools such as Envoy. Establish useful performance measures, improve data quality, and automate repeatable work while maintaining appropriate controls and keeping processes practical for the team.
* **Lead EHS program governance:** Establish a risk-based plan, clear responsibilities and a review cadence with qualified vendors and internal teams. Drive follow-through on assessed obligations and remediation across offices and remote populations, maintain evidence of completion, and escalate material risks without substituting for specialist advice.
* **Set standards for delivery and handover:** Own the development and use of project playbooks, planning processes and operational-readiness criteria. Bring together design standards and occupancy requirements, and ensure completed projects transfer to local operations with the documentation, training, vendor arrangements and issue ownership needed to run well.
* **Serve as a senior operating partner:** Lead cross-functional operating and project reviews, surface decisions with clear recommendations, and represent your areas with internal and external partners. Drive resolution within your authority, escalate material changes with options, and build accountability without adding unnecessary layers.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* **Senior functional leadership:** 8+ years in workplace business operations, corporate real estate, facilities programs or a closely related field, with increasing responsibility for complex, multi-site programs and their outcomes. You have operated with substantial autonomy, not only administered plans set by others.
* **Project and program management expertise:** You are a project manager at the core. You are quick and agile, but methodical when it comes to planning for, organizing, tracking, and executing on a project in a way that keeps everything and everyone aligned and on task.
* **Relevant delivery depth:** You have a record of delivering office buildouts, relocations or capital improvements as an internal owner, with accountability for scope, financial performance, schedules, change control and external delivery partners.
* **Strong financial and analytical judgment:** You have experience driving forecasting and reporting processes, challenging assumptions and translating portfolio data into resource or investment recommendations; strong spreadsheet and analytical skills.
* **Experience building an operating framework:** You have established planning, governance, performance measures and systems that helped a growing function deliver more predictably. You know when structure improves execution and when it becomes unnecessary process.
* **Leadership across organizational boundaries:** You can secure commitments, challenge constructively and resolve competing priorities across teams and vendors. You communicate risks and recommendations credibly to senior leaders and know which decisions to make independently and which to escalate.
* **Hands-on ownership and sound judgment:** You can move between portfolio-level trade-offs and project details, deliver through others without losing accountability, handle sensitive information responsibly, and maintain a kind, service-oriented approach under pressure.

**Join GardaWorld as a Security Client Services Manager – Where Service Excellence Meets Impact!**

As a Security Client Services Manager, you’ll be the trusted link between our clients and our organization, ensuring they receive an exceptional experience that reflects GardaWorld’s reputation as the industry’s premier security partner. In this role, you’ll champion service quality, strengthen client relationships, and help drive account success through proactive communication, problem-solving, and operational insight.

We’re looking for a leader who not only understands numbers but also understands people, who can interpret financial reports, build credibility quickly, and consistently demonstrate honesty, reliability, and professionalism. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact and elevate the standard of client service, this is your opportunity to do it with a global industry leader.

**What’s in it for You**

* Competitive Salary: $85,000.00 / year + $750.00 / monthly auto allowance
* Work Site Location: San Jose, CA
* Set Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. To 5:00 p.m. This position may require working long hours and on weekends.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, 401(k) with employer matching contributions, paid time off (PTO) policy, paid holidays, disability coverage, and life insurance options.
* Career Growth: Career growth opportunities at GardaWorld
* Travel: Daily in-person visits to various client sites throughout the market.

**Your Responsibilities as Client Services Manager**

* Supervise the day-to-day security service provided to the facilities and ensure service is of the highest standards
* Develop and maintain effective relationships with clients and employees and serve as the liaison between GardaWorld, our clients, and our assigned staff
* Meet regularly with clients to address problems and offer solutions, provide status updates, communicate needs, and ensure contract compliance and complete customer satisfaction
* Participate in the recruitment, selection, orientation, training, and continual development of staff assigned to the accounts
* Routinely visit and inspect supervisors and security officers assigned to accounts within the business unit, including but not limited to reviewing reports, providing training & guidance, evaluating proficiency ensuring compliance to contract specifications as well as GardaWorld policy, providing assistance when necessary, and initiating corrective action as required
* Maintain thorough knowledge and understanding of post specifications, post orders, instructions, patrol areas, zones, emergency procedures, staffing requirements/priorities, client policies and procedures, and any other information necessary for the effective and efficient operation within the business unit
* Assist in the development and implementation of staffing schedules, budgets, payroll, and other reports

* Ensure 100% compliance with all contracts and collective bargaining agreements in assigned accounts.
* Recommend new approaches, policies, and procedures to effect continual improvements in efficiency of the department and services performed.
* Ensure progressive discipline is followed on all corrective actions.
* Perform other duties as assigned. (Must always be included)

* Authorized to work in the United States
* A college degree in business or a related field, or equivalent work experience
* A valid driver's license and maintain a driving record that meets company vehicle and insurance eligibility standards.
* Minimum 1 year management experience; 3 years preferred
* Must have experience overseeing multiple sites
* Must have leadership experience

* Operational Oversight & Accountability
* Client-Centric Communication & Relationship Building
* Team Leadership & Performance Management
* Attention to Detail & Situational Awareness
* Administrative & Analytical Proficiency

new_jobs.title: Sales Representative (Entry-Level B2B)
new_jobs.description:
ADP is hiring a **Sales Representative, Small Business Services.**

* *Are you ready to build a rewarding future? Uncapped commissions, lavish incentive trips, and career advancement are some of the ways.*
* *Do you want to join a Fortune 250 company with industry-leading sales training and the latest sales technology to help you achieve success**?*
* *Are you looking to join a fast-paced, inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?*

If so, this may be the opportunity you've been searching for. Read on and decide for yourself.

In this role, you will work within a defined geographic territory that targets clients and prospects with 1-49 employees. You will identify and sign new clients for payroll, tax, human resources, benefits, and more and sell additional solutions to existing clients. Daily, you will cultivate relationships, set appointments, gather leads from established business partners, assess client or prospect needs to present the best ADP solutions, and spend your time in the field closing business. Don't worry if you have no prior sales experience; we are known for our high-quality sales training and will teach you how to use the latest sales technology to set you up for success.

Integrity, resilience, positivity, and a refuse to lose attitude are must-haves in this job. As with any role in sales, you will experience ebbs and flows. However, challenges should ignite your determination and invigorate you to thrive, not weigh you down. In return, you'll be rewarded with uncapped commissions, incentive trips, and opportunities to advance your career in a fun and friendly environment - all while gaining serious credibility as part of an industry-leading sales team in a stable and highly respected tech company.

Ready to #MakeYourMark? **Apply now!**

**To learn more about Sales at ADP**, watch here: http://adp.careers/Sales\_Videos

**What you'll do:** *Responsibilities*

* **Grow Our Business While Growing Yours.** You will work independently and collaboratively as part of various teams within your assigned geography to close sales, win business, and reach sales goals.
* **Turn Prospects into Loyal Clients and Raving Fans.** You will implement a sales strategy targeted to decision-makers and business owners to build a network and capture new business.
* **Deepen** **Relationships Across the ADP Family.** In addition to selling cloud-based human resources solutions, you will strategically cultivate additional business within existing accounts. But it's not all business; you will make life-long friendships here.
* **Collaborate** **Daily.** You will serve as a trusted advisor, partner, and ADP ambassador to your clients, internal partners, and overall network while demonstrating grace under pressure and the highest ethical standards.

**TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE****:** *Required Qualifications*

* **Positive Self-Starter****.** You have an upbeat, persistent style and the ability to cold call without fear of rejection, manage your time well, and can present your ideas in a clear professional manner on paper, in-person, and over the phone.
* **Agile Solution Seeker****.** You're a problem solver who can find an answer, or a solution, even in times of fast-paced change.
* **Continuous Learner****.** You're always learning, growing, and questioning how things were done in the past to make them even better.

A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include:

* One to two years of prior work experience or internships in Retail, Marketing, Business Development, Food Service, Insurance Sales, or another relevant industry, OR
* Military experience We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.

**Bonus points for these:** *Preferred Qualifications*

* Prior quota-carrying experience
* Ability to successfully build a network and effectively use social media for sales

**YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:**

* **Be yourself** in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
* **Belong** by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
* **Grow your career** in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
* **Continuously learn** through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities.
* **Be your healthiest.** Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
* **Balance work and life.** Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
* **Focus on your mental health and well-being.** We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
* **Join a company committed to giving back** and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
* **Get paid to pay it forward.** Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.

What are you waiting for? **Apply today!**

**#LI-AB1**

Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity or commissions. new_jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator**
=======================

* DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION

Posted on

09/21/2026

* Full-time

Location

QUEENS

* Exam may be required

Department

Trf Control & Eng Admin

Salary range: $85,175.00 – $124,426.00

Save

**Job Description**
-------------------

In order to be considered for this position candidate must be serving permanently in the title, or reachable on the civil service list.
  
  
As part of the City's Cycling and Micromobility Network Expansion Program, Traffic Control & Engineering is seeking a City Planner Level III to support the planning, development, and implementation of projects that expand and improve New York City's protected bike lane and micromobility network. The selected candidate will manage complex transportation planning projects, conduct research and data analysis, evaluate corridor and neighborhood-level improvements, and develop planning recommendations that advance the City's Streets Plan goals. Responsibilities include coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, preparing technical reports, presentations, and planning documents, identifying and evaluating transportation policies and design alternatives, supporting the implementation of protected bike lane and micromobility initiatives, and supervising subordinate staff as required. The candidate will also develop and coordinate work programs, oversee data collection and analysis efforts, and provide technical guidance on transportation planning initiatives and policy development. The candidate will be expected to lead collaboratively and inclusively, seeking to cultivate continued professional development, develop a strong team, and to effectively communicate through verbal and written forms with all stakeholders. This is an opportunity to work with a team dedicated to improving safety, accessibility and mobility throughout New York City.
  
  
The Department of Transportation’s (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents. DOT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to recruiting and maintaining a diverse workforce in an open and inclusive environment. Transportation Planning and Management (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
Traffic Control & Engineering is responsible for administration, engineering and operations related to the installation, manufacturing, maintenance and removal of signs, flexible bollards, moveable barriers, in-house traffic sign production and other traffic control devices. The office draws on the expertise and talents of engineers, sign designers, planners, inspectors, IT experts, analysts and others to help the agency achieve Vision Zero and other city goals.
  
  
CITY PLANNER - 22122

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  
  

1. A master’s degree from an accredited college or university in city planning, urban planning, urban design, architecture, landscape architecture, transportation engineering, public administration, economic development or a related field; or
  
  
2. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university and one year of satisfactory full-time experience in city planning such as in the review and
  
development of housing, transportation, environmental, and city-owned land planning projects; or
  
  
3. A satisfactory combination of education and/or experience that is equivalent to "1" above. Graduate education in city planning, urban planning, urban design, architecture, landscape architecture, transportation engineering, public administration, economic development or related fields may be substituted for experience on the basis of 30 graduate semester credits from an accredited college or university for one year of experience. However, all candidates must have a baccalaureate degree.
  
  
4. To be eligible for placement in Assignment Level III, individuals must have, after meeting the minimum requirements, two additional years of professional experience as described in "2" above.

  
  

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

  
Preference will be given to candidate who possess a driver's license valid in the state of New York with no restrictions. This license must be maintained throughout the duration of employment in this position. Comprehensive knowledge of traffic engineering principles and standards. Demonstrated ability to plan and develop projects, implement strategies, and articulate, concise reports. Proficiency in the Department of Transportation’s Sign Information Management System (SIMS).
  

**55a Program**
---------------

  
This position is also open to qualified persons with a disability who are eligible for the 55-a Program. Please indicate at the top of your resume and cover letter that you would like to be considered for the position through the 55-a Program.

new_jobs.title: Program Coordinator, CSTEP
new_jobs.description:
NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.
  
  
*For more information, go to* *med.nyu.edu*, and interact with us on *LinkedIn*, *Glassdoor*, *Indeed*, *Facebook*, *X* *and* *Instagram*.

  

**Position Summary:**

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Program Coordinator. The Office of Professional Development at NYU Grossman School of Medicine seeks a Program Coordinator to coordinate and execute student engagement, recruitment, and professional development initiatives funded through the New York State Collegiate Science and Technology Entry Program (CSTEP).

This student-facing role manages day-to-day program operations, student organization coordination, conference funding, and event execution. The coordinator will collaborate with faculty, administrators, and student leaders to deliver programs that strengthen community and professional development across the medical school. This role is responsible for delivering programs that enhance student experience, retention, and professional readiness This role also offers the opportunity to collaborate across departments and gain experience in program development within academic medicine. The Program Coordinator reports to the Senior Program Manager for Engagement, Mentoring, and Professional Development (CSTEP Director).

  

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Recruitment and Outreach:**

* Independently manage logistics for recruitment events, webinars, fairs, and campus visits

* Implement outreach efforts to prospective medical students and trainees and advise on engagement approaches to enhance pathway programs

* Maintain and update tracking systems for accurate records of outreach activities, attendance, and expenses

* Respond to inquiries from prospective students, providing information about educational opportunities and pathways at NYUGSOM

* Manage and execute logistics of major recruitment events, including welcome receptions, virtual open houses, and second-look programs

* Develop, maintain, and continuously update a comprehensive alumni tracking system for NYU Grossman School of Medicine OPD graduates, ensuring accurate records and ongoing engagement initiatives

  

**Student Engagement and Programming:**

* Serve as the first point of contact and primary liaison for 13 OPD-supported student organizations, providing advisement on event planning, policies, and operational processes

* Independently manage scheduling and facilitation monthly meetings with student leaders of OPD-funded student organizations and oversee implementation of student-led initiatives throughout the academic year

* Co-lead the development and delivery of student organization and student leadership training during orientation

* Partner with the Senior Program Manager planning and logistics for student participation in national and regional student conferences

Manage and execute logistics of highly-visible initiatives and major community-building events aimed at fostering a sense of community across the medical school

Luckin Coffee US is looking for a highly creative, hands-on Social Media Manager and Content Creator to lead our Instagram and TikTok presence. You will turn product launches, everyday coffee occasions and NYC culture into content that makes people want to discover and try Luckin.

Creativity is central to this role. We want someone who brings original campaign ideas, writes compelling hooks and knows how to make a product relevant to our audience. You will own social campaigns from the first idea to the final post and use performance insights to improve what comes next.

You should be proactive, organized and quick to act. You can manage overlapping launches and content deadlines, make clear priority decisions and move projects forward without waiting for step-by-step direction.

**What you will do**

**Creative strategy and product launches**

* Own the social planning for product launches from concept and briefing through production, publishing and post-launch review. Align messaging and timing with the integrated marketing lead.
* Develop original social campaign concepts that connect product benefits to customer interests, NYC culture and occasions such as the morning commute or afternoon treat.
* Build launch sequences and recurring content series on social media that give people reasons to try new products and revisit core favorites.

* Develop hooks, scripts and shot lists; film and edit short-form videos for Instagram and TikTok, including captions, audio and graphics.

Please share content you personally conceived and produced, one product or brand campaign, and one creative experiment. Explain your contribution, the insight behind the work, the results and what you changed afterward.

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing/Communications Specialist II: Paid Media Trafficking — Ad Serving, Tagging & Creative Rotation
new_jobs.description:
* **This position is remote/work from home. You need to reside within the Eastern or Central Time Zones (Atlanta is preferred). If you live near any of the office locations listed, the role will be hybrid.**

  
The **Digital Marketing / Communications Specialist II** owns ad serving and trafficking operations for paid media. This role traffics creative and tags into the ad server and buying platforms, manages creative rotation and weighting across flights, and resolves delivery and impression discrepancies between the ad server, publishers, and buying platforms. Every paid media campaign depends on this work being correct before launch and monitored after it.  
  
As ad serving moves in-house, this role is accountable for ad-serving hygiene and for the operational discipline behind the ad-serving vendor investment: clean placement structures, accurate tag implementation, retired trafficking sheets, and reconciled delivery counts. Specialist II coordinates with the Activation Senior Specialist on launch sequencing, with Marketing Technology and web teams on site tag implementation, and with publishers and ad-serving vendors on technical troubleshooting.  
  
**What You'll Do**  
  
**Creative Trafficking & Ad Serving**  

* Traffics display, video, native, and rich media creative into the ad server and buying platforms, verifying specifications, click-through URLs, and third-party tag integrity.
* Builds and maintains ad server placement structures, creative assignments, and ad associations aligned to campaign taxonomy and naming standards.
* Manages creative rotation and weighting across flights, executing scheduled swaps, sequencing, and dayparting as directed by the campaign plan.
* Generates and distributes trafficking sheets and ad tags to publishers and confirms correct implementation prior to launch.
* Retrieves, versions, and stores creative assets so the correct materials are in market at all times.

  
**Tag & Pixel Management**  

* Implements and validates conversion pixels, floodlight tags, and event tracking in coordination with Marketing Technology and web teams.
* Audits tag placement across landing pages and site templates, identifying missing, duplicated, or misfiring tags.
* Maintains tag documentation mapping each tag to its campaign, conversion event, and owner.
* Coordinates tag requests with third-party vendors including verification, rich media, and measurement partners.

  
**Delivery Troubleshooting & Discrepancy Resolution**  

* Monitors delivery across ad servers, buying platforms, and publisher reporting, identifying impression, click, and conversion discrepancies.
* Investigates and resolves discrepancies with publishers, platforms, and ad-serving vendors, documenting root cause and resolution.
* Troubleshoots creative rendering, latency, and serving failures and executes corrective trafficking changes.
* Escalates unresolved technical issues with a clear summary of the investigation completed to date.
* Tracks recurring discrepancy patterns by publisher or platform and surface them for commercial follow-up.

  
**Ad-Serving Hygiene & Vendor Operations**  

* Owns ad-serving hygiene including retirement of completed placements, archiving of inactive creative, and removal of orphaned tags.
* Monitors ad-serving impression consumption against the contracted vendor commitment and flags pacing variances.
* Supports invoice validation for ad-serving costs by reconciling served impressions against vendor reporting.
* Maintains ad-serving configuration documentation including user access, naming standards, and trafficking procedures.
* Executes quality assurance checks covering rendering, click-through function, tracking, and creative accuracy before every launch.

  
**Reporting & Collaboration**  

* Pulls ad server delivery reporting and provides served impression, click, and rotation data to support campaign reporting.
* Coordinates with the Activation Sr Specialist and respective teams on logistics, execution, and metrics for each launch.

new_jobs.title: Technical Sales Representative - Nuclear Power Industries
new_jobs.description:
As the industry leader in water technology, we’re growing and need talented people like you to help us continue to protect the world’s most vital resource.

Nalco Water, an Ecolab Company, is seeking a **Technical Sales Representative** to join its industry leading sales team. You’ll be responsible for revenue and profit growth of programs and services in targeted accounts. With a consultative sales approach, you’ll build relationships with existing customers by understanding their key business drivers and executing system assurance programs. With strong account leadership, you’ll also convert strategic competitive accounts and sell new technologies to current customers.

**What’s in it For You:**

* You will join a growth company offering a competitive base salary, bonus structure and benefits
* Receive a company vehicle and cell phone
* Opportunity for a long term, advancing career path in service, sales or management
* Access to the industry’s most innovative training programs
* Support from a dedicated technical service team
* Culture that values safety first, including training and personal protection
* Feel proud each day to work for a company that provides clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments

**What You Will Do:**

* Supporting industrial water treatment programs that are critical to safe, reliable, and efficient power generation.
* Monitoring and optimizing cooling-water and related treatment programs, chemical feed systems, water chemistry, and digital monitoring/control technologies.
* Performing routine field testing, equipment inspection, calibration, troubleshooting, chemical inventory management, and program-performance reporting.
* Working closely with station chemistry, operations, maintenance, and other customer stakeholders to identify risks, resolve treatment challenges, and improve plant reliability and thermal performance.
* Supporting condenser and heat-exchanger performance, biological and scale control, corrosion management, lake/raw-water management, and other site-specific water applications.
* Participating in periodic plant outages, inspections, technical reviews, KPI meetings, and business reviews.
* Maintaining strong procedural adherence, human-performance practices, and a safety-first mindset appropriate for highly regulated nuclear generating facilities.
* Developing strong customer relationships while identifying opportunities to deliver measurable operational, reliability, sustainability, and economic value.

**Territory/Location Information:**

* This position is based in the Chicago suburbs
* Territory covers **Dresden, LaSalle, Clinton IL.**
* Targeted accounts are within the **nuclear power industries**
* <25% overnight travel required

**Position Details:**

This territory covers a regional portfolio of power generation facilities across northern and central Illinois, primarily supporting the **nuclear power industry**, within approximately a 100-mile radius of Joliet, IL. This is a remote, field-based position. While the ideal candidate would be located in the western or southern suburbs of Chicago to provide convenient access to the territory, location flexibility may be considered, the greater distance from the territory may affect required travel and work life balance.

  

Because the assigned facilities are located within a defined regional footprint, the position will require regular travel between customer sites and a strong field presence. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working independently across multiple locations while collaborating closely with the broader Power team and technical resources.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Three years of technical sales or field sales support experience
* Possess a valid Driver's License and acceptable Motor Vehicle Record
* Immigration sponsorship is not available for this role

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (chemical, mechanical, industrial) or life sciences (biology, chemistry, etc.)
* Experience in **power generation, nuclear operations, industrial water treatment, chemistry, engineering, or other highly regulated industrial environments**.
* Water treatment or specialty chemical industry experience
* Working knowledge of OR operations, wet end chemistry, pulp mill operations>

As a trusted partner, your customers will rely on you for their success. Nalco Water is committed to seeing you succeed and provides several exceptional technical training programs to ensure you’re prepared to solve any customer problem.

Training programs are held in the field and at Nalco Water Headquarters in Naperville, IL; travel arranged and paid for by Nalco Water. Based on your skill level, topics covered may include technology, product, service, business and industry acumen, direct coaching and mentoring, management and leadership, classroom training and certifications.

  
  

**About Nalco Water:**

In a world with increasing water shortage and contamination challenges, Nalco Water, an Ecolab company, helps customers conserve more than 161 billion gallons of water each year. We work with customers across the world in the light industry (institutional, food & beverage, transportation and manufacturing), heavy industry (chemical, power and primary metals industries), paper and mining operations to reduce, reuse, and recycle their water while protecting their systems and equipment. Nalco Water provides the unique opportunity to work with a broad suite of technologies to deliver automated monitoring systems, data analysis and deep technical expertise to increase efficiency, sustainability and performance for our customers.

**Annual or Hourly Compensation Range**

The total Compensation range for this position is $93,800-$140,600 which includes base pay and target incentive based on performance, per plan terms. Many factors are taken into consideration when determining compensation, such as experience, education, training,

new_jobs.title: Call Center Representative/Inside Sales
new_jobs.description:
We are looking for a Call Center Representative at our Fair Oaks Ford Lincoln in Naperville. This is a full-time position 40 hour a week position with full benefits including:

· Health, dental, and vision benefits

· Career training & development

· 401K

· Monthly bonuses

ABOUT FAIR OAKS FORD LINCOLN

Fair Oaks Ford Lincoln is a family owned and operated group of car dealerships which has been in business for over 35 years in Chicagoland and Northwest Indiana. We pride ourselves in creating a working environment that is fun, fast paced and rewarding. The great majority of our Managers, across all departments, started off in entry level positions and have been promoted into their current managerial roles. To make this happen for you, we will give you all the training and tools necessary to succeed. Longevity in our dealerships is something we pride ourselves in and this is evident in the number of employees who have been working for us for 20-30 years. In addition, we are a high-volume dealership and with a large, and busy Service Departments. What does that mean for you? You will always be put in a position to earn great compensation and customers will always be coming in the doors.

A DAY IN THE LIFE OF A CALL CENTER REPRESENTATIVE

When you begin your day in the Business Development Center (BDC), you will have many warm leads to contact. These are customers who have inquired about a specific vehicle in our inventory and who would like to come and test drive or schedule a finance meeting. These customers found our vehicles on our website, or from our digital, radio and TV advertising. You are not selling a vehicle; you are selling an appointment to visit our dealership. Do not worry if you do not know much about cars! We will give you all the tools necessary to succeed. This includes phone training when you are hired and product knowledge so that you can have meaningful conversation with our customers about the car, truck or SUV they are interested in. You will learn how to quickly and effectively ask for an appointment and will be put in the best position to succeed in your new role.

QUALIFICATIONS FOR CALL CENTER REPRESENTATIVE

· Maintain a professional attitude.

· Ability and desire to make customers happy.

· Feel comfortable building new relationships, understanding customer needs quickly and asking for the appointment.

· Comfortable using the internet, social media and computers.

· Excellent phone and grammar skills.

WORK SCHEDULE

This is a 40 hour a week job, with a mixture of days and evenings. We are closed on Sunday and there is potential to also have rotating Saturday's off as well.

ARE YOU READY TO JOIN OUR TEAM?

Apply today! If you are a good fit, you will get a call from Zana or Krystal and will set up a time for an interview.

We are an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. All applicants must be able to demonstrate ability to pass pre-employment testing to include background checks, MVR, drug test, credit report, and valid driver license.

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid training
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
